# No translation happens — by design, and it's the right choice

Both sides already agree on a convention, so nothing gets converted at any layer. Let me trace the actual path so you can verify it yourself.

## The convention on both sides

The playground stores each bbox as `{x, y, w, h}` in **normalized `[0,1]` space**, where:

- `x`, `y` are fractions of image width/height, top-left origin
- `x + w`, `y + h` are the bottom-right corner, so `x2 > x1`, `y2 > y1`

The `pg_panel.js` `_buildPayload()` does the only "transform" in the whole pipeline — a same-space reshape from `{x,y,w,h}` to `[x1,y1,x2,y2]`:

```js
const toWire = (list) => list.map(b => [b.x, b.y, b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h]);
```

That's it. From there, the values are normalized `[x1,y1,x2,y2]` on the wire, stored unchanged by `layout_server.py`'s `_normalize_state`, returned unchanged by `/state`, and read unchanged by `DrawatoonSetIP._fetch_layout()`.

## What the model expects — confirmed by the trained weights

In `IPAdapter.embed_text` → `RBFEmbedding.forward`:

```python
self.means = nn.Parameter(torch.linspace(0, 1, num_kernels))
...
x = box.unsqueeze(-1) - self.means
```

The RBF kernels are centered at `[0, 1]`. If the model were trained on pixel coordinates, those centers would be `linspace(0, 1024, 32)` or similar. They're `[0, 1]` — **the model was trained on normalized coordinates**.

The author's own default bboxes confirm the convention:

```python
text_bboxes = [[[0.10, 0.02, 0.90, 0.12]]]         # caption strip, near top
character_bboxes = [[[0.30, 0.15, 0.70, 0.90]]]    # center-ish, tall
```

Both are normalized `[x1,y1,x2,y2]` with `y` increasing downward. Exactly what your playground produces.

## Why no translation is needed

```
Playground draw         [x1,y1,x2,y2] normalized [0,1]
    ↓ (toWire)
Browser POST /state     [[x1,y1,x2,y2], ...] normalized [0,1]
    ↓ (server passthrough)
/state response         [[x1,y1,x2,y2], ...] normalized [0,1]
    ↓ (node _fetch_layout)
DrawatoonSetIP          ip_adapter([text_bboxes], [character_bboxes], ...)
    ↓ (RBFEmbedding)
Model input             torch tensor, values in [0,1] — what the kernels expect
```

Every hop uses the same units. Any translation between normalized and pixel space would actually be a **bug** — it would feed the model values outside the range its RBF kernels were trained on.

## The one thing that *is* implicit — and worth knowing

Since bboxes are normalized, they don't carry absolute pixel size or aspect. That means:

- **If the playground image and the sampler's latent have the same aspect ratio** (e.g. you displayed the Krita composite at 512×512 and generate at 512×512): positions and shapes match exactly.
- **If the aspect ratios differ** (e.g. playground shows a 1088×896 Krita canvas, but `PixArtResolutionSelect` generates at 512×512): bboxes are still *positioned* correctly in normalized space (a box at x=0.8 is at 80% of the width on both sides), but a bbox's *shape* changes — a square drawn in the playground becomes a rectangle in the generated image.

This is why the layout playground autosyncs the canvas from the Krita composite: as long as the composite is what the workflow will crop to before submission, the aspect ratio matches and everything lines up. The `@thelayout` slot exists precisely to make that alignment a single click.

If you ever want to **see** the difference, draw a deliberately square bbox in the playground, generate at a very different aspect ratio, and note where the subject appears — it'll be in the correct *region* but stretched to fill a rectangle.

## Should you be worried?

No. The current setup is correct: normalized-in, normalized-out. The `image_dims` field is sent on `/state` only as a diagnostic — the node doesn't read it, and doesn't need to. The model works in normalized space; the playground emits normalized space; nothing in between distorts that.

If a future playground wanted pixel coords for some reason, the translation would go **there**, in that playground's `_buildPayload` — not in the node, not in the docker. Keeping the node dumb (accepts `[0,1]` bboxes, nothing else) means one convention across the whole system, which is what makes it work now.

Found 16 web pages

drawatoon-v1 is a **pure text-to-image model**. It paints from scratch (from noise) and does **not** expect you to provide an image to encode or inpaint. This is confirmed both by the model card and by the author’s own description.

### 🎨 What the model actually does

The Hugging Face model listing explicitly categorises `fumeisama/drawatoon-v1` under the **“Text-to-Image”** task[reference:0]. In the author’s announcement, the entire workflow is described as generating manga **from text prompts**: “a lightweight manga image generation model… can generate pretty decent black-and-white manga art from text prompts”[reference:1]. There is no mention of image encoding, masking, or inpainting anywhere in the training or inference description.

### 🔍 Why it is not an inpainting model

The model is a fine-tune of **PixArt-Σ**, which is a **latent diffusion transformer** trained for text-to-image generation[reference:2]. The drawatoon fine-tune added two extra conditioning paths — **layout bboxes** and **MAGI character embeddings** — but these are *additional* conditioning signals stacked on top of the text prompt. They are not a replacement for the input latent.

An inpainting model needs to be trained on *masked image + target image* pairs so it learns to respect the unmasked context. drawatoon was trained on **20 million raw manga images** with text captions and layout annotations[reference:3]. There is no evidence of any masked-image training signal. The `DrawatoonMS` architecture you ported has no mask-latent input path; it takes a noise latent, a timestep, text embeddings, and the ip-adapter tokens. That is the standard text-to-image forward pass.

### ⚙️ What this means for your workflow

The pipeline you have — `EmptyLatentImage → KSampler → VAEDecode` — is exactly correct. You are starting from pure noise, and the model denoises it from scratch using your prompt, your bboxes, and (eventually) your character embeddings.

You **could** technically plug drawatoon into a standard ComfyUI inpainting workflow (masked latent + `denoise < 1.0`), because latent diffusion samplers are architecture-agnostic. But since drawatoon was never trained to respect an unmasked context, the results would be unreliable — it would have no learned prior for “keep this region unchanged.” The author’s own suggested workflow for comics is **panel-by-panel generation**, not inpainting: generate a panel from scratch, then use the MAGI embedding to keep the character consistent in the *next* panel[reference:4].

If you ever need true inpainting with a manga model, the correct approach is to use a base model that was actually trained for it (or train a dedicated inpainting fine-tune). drawatoon is not that model.

> ## Key design decisions
> 
> 1. Bboxes stored viewer-relative (normalized [0,1] within viewer)
> 2. Viewer stored canvas-normalized (x, y, w, h in [0,1] of canvas)
> 3. Viewer aspect ratio determined by selected ratio
> 4. Changing ratio resets viewer to fit-in-canvas at new aspect
> 5. Changing model resets ratio list, and viewer to default
> 6. Node PlaygroundResolutionSelect fetches /state, reads viewer.model + viewer.ratio, looks up table
> 7. Playground serves /resolution_options with the table
> 
> ## Coordinate math
> 
> Viewer position on canvas:
> - `viewer.x`, `viewer.y`: top-left, normalized [0,1] of canvas
> - `viewer.w`, `viewer.h`: size, normalized [0,1] of canvas
> 
> Viewer pixel dims on canvas:
> - `viewer_px_w = viewer.w * canvas_width`
> - `viewer_px_h = viewer.h * canvas_height`
> 
> Aspect ratio constraint:
> - `viewer_px_w / viewer_px_h = target_aspect`
> 
> So:
> - `viewer.w * canvas_width / (viewer.h * canvas_height) = target_aspect`
> - `viewer.w / viewer.h = target_aspect * canvas_height / canvas_width`
> 
> When user drags a corner to resize, we preserve target_aspect. Let me say:
> - User drags SE corner
> - New `viewer_px_w` = `(mouse_x - viewer.x_px)` (in canvas pixels)
> - New `viewer_px_h` = `viewer_px_w / target_aspect`
> - Or clamp to fit
> 
> When user moves viewer, position changes but size stays.
> 
> Bbox in viewer-relative coords (bx, by, bw, bh in [0,1] of viewer) maps to canvas coords:
> - `canvas_x1 = viewer.x + bx * viewer.w`
> - `canvas_y1 = viewer.y + by * viewer.h`
> - `canvas_x2 = viewer.x + (bx + bw) * viewer.w`
> - `canvas_y2 = viewer.y + (by + bh) * viewer.h`
> 
> Inverse: if user drags a bbox handle, convert mouse position (canvas coords) to viewer coords:
> - `viewer_coord_x = (canvas_x - viewer.x) / viewer.w`
> - `viewer_coord_y = (canvas_y - viewer.y) / viewer.h`
> 
> Then do bbox handle math in viewer space, storing result in viewer-relative.

> - Therefore: `v.w / v.h = r * imageHeight / imageWidth`

# Viewer rectangle — implementation

Eight files. The viewer is client-side (playground state), the resolution lookup is server-side via a new V3 node. Bboxes are now viewer-normalized; viewer is canvas-normalized. Nothing else in the pipeline changes — the node still fetches `/state` and reads `text_bboxes` / `character_bboxes` as normalized `[0,1]` values that happen to now be "of the frame".

Bboxes are preserved across layer refreshes (only reset on fresh image loads). Viewer auto-fits on image load and on ratio change.

---

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/layout_server.py`

```python
"""HTTP routes for the layout playground.

  POST /state                  set (from browser) or get (from node)
  POST /version                version only (for IS_CHANGED and daemon sweep)
  POST /import_image           fetch active document composite from Krita
  POST /krita_status           daemon reachable?
  POST /active_state           daemon comfy_status + playground registry
  POST /resource_image         resolve a {source, layer_name} spec to a PNG
  POST /upload_image           raw body (image file)
  POST /playground_reregister  single-shot re-register with the daemon

Lock discipline
===============
`_state_lock` is an `RLock`.  The canonical accessor is
`_read_state_snapshot()`, which acquires the lock once and returns a
plain dict copy.  Handlers build their response from the copy; no
handler holds `_state_lock` while calling another function that might
also want it.

State shape
===========
The `/state` payload includes the generation frame (`viewer`): its
position and size in canvas-normalized coords, plus the model/ratio
the sampler workflow should use.  Bboxes are normalized to the
viewer, not the canvas — that is what `DrawatoonSetIP` consumes.
"""

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import threading
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from io import BytesIO
from urllib.parse import unquote

from PIL import Image

from . import krita_client, playground_registry


PLAYGROUND_ID   = "layout"
PLAYGROUND_NAME = "Layout Editor"
PLAYGROUND_PORT = 8777

LAYER_SLOTS = [
    {
        "id":                "@thelayout",
        "auto_select_layer": "thelayout",
    },
]

SLOT_ID = "@thelayout"

_DEFAULT_VIEWER = {
    "x": 0.05, "y": 0.05, "w": 0.9, "h": 0.9,
    "model": "PixArtMS_Sigma_XL_2_512",
    "ratio": "1.00",
}

_state_lock = threading.RLock()
_state      = None
_version    = ""


def _log(msg):
    print(f"[layout] {msg}", flush=True)


def _default_state():
    return {
        "text_bboxes":          [],
        "character_bboxes":     [],
        "reference_embeddings": [],
        "image_dims":           [0, 0],
        "viewer":               dict(_DEFAULT_VIEWER),
    }


def _read_state_snapshot():
    with _state_lock:
        if _state is None:
            return _default_state(), _version
        return dict(_state), _version


def _safe_bbox(raw):
    if not isinstance(raw, (list, tuple)) or len(raw) != 4:
        return None
    try:
        x1, y1, x2, y2 = (float(v) for v in raw)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    x1 = max(0.0, min(1.0, x1))
    y1 = max(0.0, min(1.0, y1))
    x2 = max(0.0, min(1.0, x2))
    y2 = max(0.0, min(1.0, y2))
    if x2 <= x1 or y2 <= y1:
        return None
    return [x1, y1, x2, y2]


def _normalize_viewer(raw):
    raw = raw if isinstance(raw, dict) else {}
    try:
        vx = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(raw.get("x", _DEFAULT_VIEWER["x"]))))
        vy = max(0.0, min(1.0, float(raw.get("y", _DEFAULT_VIEWER["y"]))))
        vw = max(0.01, min(1.0, float(raw.get("w", _DEFAULT_VIEWER["w"]))))
        vh = max(0.01, min(1.0, float(raw.get("h", _DEFAULT_VIEWER["h"]))))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        vx, vy, vw, vh = (
            _DEFAULT_VIEWER["x"], _DEFAULT_VIEWER["y"],
            _DEFAULT_VIEWER["w"], _DEFAULT_VIEWER["h"],
        )
    if vx + vw > 1.0:
        vw = max(0.01, 1.0 - vx)
    if vy + vh > 1.0:
        vh = max(0.01, 1.0 - vy)
    model = str(raw.get("model") or _DEFAULT_VIEWER["model"])
    ratio = str(raw.get("ratio") or _DEFAULT_VIEWER["ratio"])
    return {"x": vx, "y": vy, "w": vw, "h": vh,
            "model": model, "ratio": ratio}


def _normalize_state(raw):
    text_bboxes = [_safe_bbox(b) for b in (raw.get("text_bboxes") or [])]
    text_bboxes = [b for b in text_bboxes if b is not None]

    char_bboxes = [_safe_bbox(b) for b in (raw.get("character_bboxes") or [])]
    char_bboxes = [b for b in char_bboxes if b is not None]

    refs_raw = raw.get("reference_embeddings") or []
    refs = []
    for r in refs_raw:
        if r is None:
            refs.append(None)
        elif isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) and len(r) == 768:
            try:
                refs.append([float(v) for v in r])
            except (TypeError, ValueError):
                refs.append(None)
        else:
            refs.append(None)

    while len(refs) < len(char_bboxes):
        refs.append(None)
    if len(refs) > len(char_bboxes):
        refs = refs[:len(char_bboxes)]

    try:
        w, h = raw.get("image_dims") or [0, 0]
        dims = [max(0, int(w)), max(0, int(h))]
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        dims = [0, 0]

    return {
        "text_bboxes":          text_bboxes,
        "character_bboxes":     char_bboxes,
        "reference_embeddings": refs,
        "image_dims":           dims,
        "viewer":               _normalize_viewer(raw.get("viewer")),
    }


def _compute_version(state):
    canonical = json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  /state, /version, /playground_reregister
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def handle_state(payload):
    global _state, _version
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {"success": False, "message": "expected a JSON object"}

    if payload.get("op") == "set":
        raw = payload.get("state") or {}
        normalized = _normalize_state(raw)
        new_version = _compute_version(normalized)
        with _state_lock:
            _state = normalized
            _version = new_version
        v = normalized["viewer"]
        _log(f"state set: text={len(normalized['text_bboxes'])} "
             f"char={len(normalized['character_bboxes'])} "
             f"viewer={v['ratio']}@{v['model']} "
             f"v{new_version[:8]}")
        return {"success": True, "version": new_version}

    state_snapshot, version_snapshot = _read_state_snapshot()
    return {
        "success": True,
        "version": version_snapshot,
        **state_snapshot,
    }


def handle_version(_payload):
    with _state_lock:
        version = _version
    return {"success": True, "version": version}


def handle_playground_reregister(_payload):
    url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{PLAYGROUND_PORT}"
    ok = playground_registry.reregister_once(
        PLAYGROUND_ID, PLAYGROUND_NAME, url, PLAYGROUND_PORT,
        layer_slots=LAYER_SLOTS,
    )
    return {"success": bool(ok)}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Krita proxies
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _fetch_active_state():
    try:
        resp = krita_client.send({"type": "comfy_status"}, timeout=10.0)
    except Exception as e:
        return None, str(e)
    if not isinstance(resp, dict):
        return None, "bad daemon response"
    if resp.get("status") != "success":
        return None, resp.get("message") or "daemon rejected comfy_status"
    return resp.get("data") or {}, None


def handle_active_state(_payload):
    data, err = _fetch_active_state()
    if err is not None:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "daemon_reachable": False,
            "message": err,
        }
    return {
        "success": True,
        "daemon_reachable": True,
        "data": data,
    }


def handle_krita_status(_payload):
    return {"success": True, "reachable": krita_client.is_reachable()}


def handle_import_image(payload):
    name = (payload or {}).get("name") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
    cmd = {"type": "get_document_composite_b64"}
    if name:
        cmd["name"] = name

    response = krita_client.send(cmd, timeout=60.0)
    if response.get("status") != "success":
        return {"success": False,
                "message": response.get("message") or "daemon rejected"}

    data = response.get("data") or {}
    data_url = data.get("data_url")
    if not data_url:
        return {"success": False, "message": "daemon returned no data_url"}
    if not data_url.startswith("data:image/png;base64,"):
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"unexpected data_url prefix: {data_url[:30]!r}"}

    try:
        png_bytes = base64.b64decode(data_url.split(",", 1)[1])
        img = Image.open(BytesIO(png_bytes))
        w, h = img.size
    except Exception as e:
        return {"success": False, "message": f"decode failed: {e}"}

    hash_hex = hashlib.sha256(png_bytes).hexdigest()[:16]
    return {
        "success":   True,
        "hash":      hash_hex,
        "width":     w,
        "height":    h,
        "data_url":  data_url,
        "filename":  data.get("name") or "krita_composite",
    }


def handle_resource_image(payload):
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {"success": False, "message": "expected a JSON object"}

    source = payload.get("source", "active")
    layer_name = payload.get("layer_name")

    if source == "active":
        return handle_import_image({})
    if source == "layer":
        if not layer_name:
            return {"success": False,
                    "message": "layer_name is required when source=layer"}
        response = krita_client.send(
            {"type": "get_layer_pixels_b64", "name": str(layer_name)},
            timeout=30.0,
        )
        if response.get("status") != "success":
            return {"success": False,
                    "message": response.get("message") or "daemon rejected"}
        data = response.get("data") or {}
        data_url = data.get("data_url")
        if not data_url:
            return {"success": False,
                    "message": "daemon returned no data_url for layer"}
        return {
            "success": True,
            "hash": "layer_" + str(layer_name),
            "width": data.get("width"),
            "height": data.get("height"),
            "data_url": data_url,
            "filename": str(layer_name),
        }
    return {
        "success": False,
        "message": f"source={source!r} cannot be displayed as an image.",
    }


def handle_upload_image(headers, body):
    if not body:
        return {"success": False, "message": "empty upload"}

    raw_filename = (headers.get("X-Filename", "")
                    or headers.get("x-filename", ""))
    filename = unquote(raw_filename) if raw_filename else "image"

    try:
        img = Image.open(BytesIO(body))
        w, h = img.size
    except Exception as e:
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"could not decode image: {e}"}

    if img.format and img.format.upper() != "PNG":
        buf = BytesIO()
        img.save(buf, "PNG")
        png_bytes = buf.getvalue()
    else:
        png_bytes = body

    hash_hex = hashlib.sha256(png_bytes).hexdigest()[:16]
    data_url = ("data:image/png;base64,"
                + base64.b64encode(png_bytes).decode("ascii"))
    return {
        "success":  True,
        "hash":     hash_hex,
        "width":    w,
        "height":   h,
        "data_url": data_url,
        "filename": filename,
    }


ROUTES = {
    "/state":                  handle_state,
    "/version":                handle_version,
    "/import_image":           handle_import_image,
    "/krita_status":           handle_krita_status,
    "/active_state":           handle_active_state,
    "/resource_image":         handle_resource_image,
    "/playground_reregister":  handle_playground_reregister,
}

RAW_ROUTES = {
    "/upload_image": handle_upload_image,
}

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/pg_state.py`

```python
"""Layout state: image, viewer, bboxes, view, drags.

Leaf module — no imports from other project modules.

Coordinate systems
==================
  · Canvas image pixels     — what `screenToImage()` returns. Range [0, W]×[0, H].
  · Canvas-normalized       — [0, 1] of canvas image (x / W, y / H).
  · Viewer-normalized       — [0, 1] of the viewer rectangle. What the model receives.

The viewer is stored as `{x, y, w, h}` in canvas-normalized coords.
Bboxes are stored as `{x, y, w, h}` in viewer-normalized coords. So
dragging the viewer carries all bboxes with it (their canvas position
is `viewer.pos + bbox.pos * viewer.size`); dragging a bbox moves it
within the frame while the frame stays put.

Image loading has two paths:
  · `setImage` — full reset. Clear bboxes, reset viewer to fit, reset
    view. Used when the user explicitly loads a new image (pick file,
    import from Krita).
  · `applyCanvasImage` — partial update. Preserve bboxes, reset viewer
    only when image dims change, preserve view. Used by autosync and
    the manual "Refresh @thelayout" button.
"""

STATE_JS = r"""
import {
  VIEW_ZOOM_MIN, VIEW_ZOOM_MAX, VIEW_PAN_MARGIN,
} from "./pg_tuning.js";

export const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
export const ctx    = canvas.getContext("2d");

let _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

export const view = { zoom: 1, panX: 0, panY: 0 };

export function resetView() {
  view.zoom = 1;
  view.panX = 0;
  view.panY = 0;
}

export function clampPan() {
  if (!board.imageWidth || !board.imageHeight) return;
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  const pad = 40;
  const sx = (cw - 2 * pad) / board.imageWidth;
  const sy = (ch - 2 * pad) / board.imageHeight;
  const s = Math.min(sx, sy) * view.zoom;
  const w = board.imageWidth  * s;
  const h = board.imageHeight * s;
  const baseX = (cw - w) / 2;
  const baseY = (ch - h) / 2;
  const m = VIEW_PAN_MARGIN;
  view.panX = Math.max(m - baseX - w, Math.min(cw - m - baseX, view.panX));
  view.panY = Math.max(m - baseY - h, Math.min(ch - m - baseY, view.panY));
}

export function zoomAt(sx, sy, nz) {
  const r0 = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r0) return;
  const ix = (sx - r0.x0) / r0.s;
  const iy = (sy - r0.y0) / r0.s;
  view.zoom = Math.max(VIEW_ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(VIEW_ZOOM_MAX, nz));
  const r1 = fittedImageRect();
  view.panX += sx - (r1.x0 + ix * r1.s);
  view.panY += sy - (r1.y0 + iy * r1.s);
  clampPan();
}

/* ============================================================
   Board
   ============================================================ */

export const board = {
  imageHash:    null,
  imageWidth:   0,
  imageHeight:  0,
  imageEl:      null,
  imageDataUrl: null,

  // Viewer rectangle: normalized [0, 1] of canvas.
  viewer: {
    x: 0.05, y: 0.05, w: 0.9, h: 0.9,
    model: "PixArtMS_Sigma_XL_2_512",
    ratio: "1.00",
  },

  // Bboxes are normalized [0, 1] OF VIEWER, not of canvas.
  textBboxes:          [],
  characterBboxes:     [],
  referenceEmbeddings: [],

  selectedKind:  null,
  selectedIdx:   -1,
  hoveredKind:   null,
  hoveredIdx:    -1,

  dragActive:    false,
  dragHandle:    null,
  dragKind:      null,
  dragIdx:       -1,
  dragStartBbox: null,
  dragStartIx:   0,
  dragStartIy:   0,

  viewerDragActive:  false,
  viewerDragHandle:  null,
  viewerDragStart:   null,
  viewerDragStartIx: 0,
  viewerDragStartIy: 0,

  mouse: { x: 0, y: 0, inside: false },
};

/* ============================================================
   Viewer aspect / fit helpers
   ============================================================ */

export function viewerAspect() {
  const r = parseFloat(board.viewer.ratio);
  return (isFinite(r) && r > 0) ? r : 1.0;
}

export function resetViewerToFit() {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const r = viewerAspect();
  const cw = board.imageWidth;
  const ch = board.imageHeight;
  if (!cw || !ch) return;

  // Try 90% of the height first; fall back to 90% of width if too wide.
  const targetPxH_fromH = 0.9 * ch;
  const targetPxW_fromH = targetPxH_fromH * r;
  if (targetPxW_fromH <= 0.9 * cw) {
    v.h = 0.9;
    v.w = targetPxW_fromH / cw;
  } else {
    v.w = 0.9;
    v.h = (0.9 * cw) / (r * ch);
  }
  v.x = (1 - v.w) / 2;
  v.y = (1 - v.h) / 2;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Image loading
   ============================================================ */

export function setImage(hash, dataUrl, width, height) {
  board.imageHash    = hash;
  board.imageDataUrl = dataUrl;
  board.imageWidth   = width;
  board.imageHeight  = height;
  board.imageEl      = null;

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload  = () => { board.imageEl = img;  _scheduleDraw(); };
  img.onerror = () => { board.imageEl = null; _scheduleDraw(); };
  img.src = dataUrl;

  resetView();
  board.textBboxes          = [];
  board.characterBboxes     = [];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx  = -1;
  board.hoveredKind  = null;
  board.hoveredIdx   = -1;
  resetViewerToFit();
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function applyCanvasImage(hash, dataUrl, width, height) {
  const dimsMatch = (
    board.imageWidth === width && board.imageHeight === height
  );

  board.imageHash    = hash;
  board.imageDataUrl = dataUrl;
  board.imageWidth   = width;
  board.imageHeight  = height;

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => {
    board.imageEl = img;
    if (!dimsMatch) {
      // New aspect/size invalidates viewer position; reset it.
      resetViewerToFit();
    }
    _scheduleDraw();
  };
  img.onerror = () => { board.imageEl = null; _scheduleDraw(); };
  img.src = dataUrl;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function clearImage() {
  board.imageHash    = null;
  board.imageDataUrl = null;
  board.imageWidth   = 0;
  board.imageHeight  = 0;
  board.imageEl      = null;
  resetView();
  board.textBboxes          = [];
  board.characterBboxes     = [];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx  = -1;
  board.hoveredKind  = null;
  board.hoveredIdx   = -1;
  resetViewerToFit();
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Bbox CRUD
   ============================================================ */

function _listFor(kind) {
  return kind === 'text' ? board.textBboxes : board.characterBboxes;
}

export function addBbox(kind, bbox) {
  const list = _listFor(kind);
  list.push({ ...bbox });
  if (kind === 'character') board.referenceEmbeddings.push(null);
  _scheduleDraw();
  return list.length - 1;
}

export function deleteBbox(kind, idx) {
  const list = _listFor(kind);
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= list.length) return false;
  list.splice(idx, 1);
  if (kind === 'character') board.referenceEmbeddings.splice(idx, 1);
  if (board.selectedKind === kind && board.selectedIdx === idx) {
    board.selectedKind = null;
    board.selectedIdx = -1;
  } else if (board.selectedKind === kind && board.selectedIdx > idx) {
    board.selectedIdx -= 1;
  }
  if (board.hoveredKind === kind && board.hoveredIdx === idx) {
    board.hoveredKind = null;
    board.hoveredIdx = -1;
  } else if (board.hoveredKind === kind && board.hoveredIdx > idx) {
    board.hoveredIdx -= 1;
  }
  _scheduleDraw();
  return true;
}

export function setBbox(kind, idx, bbox) {
  const list = _listFor(kind);
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= list.length) return false;
  list[idx] = { ...bbox };
  _scheduleDraw();
  return true;
}

export function clearAllBboxes() {
  board.textBboxes          = [];
  board.characterBboxes     = [];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx = -1;
  board.hoveredKind = null;
  board.hoveredIdx = -1;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function seedDefault() {
  board.textBboxes = [{ x: 0.10, y: 0.02, w: 0.80, h: 0.10 }];
  board.characterBboxes = [{ x: 0.30, y: 0.15, w: 0.40, h: 0.75 }];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [null];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx = -1;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function selectBbox(kind, idx) {
  if (kind !== 'text' && kind !== 'character') {
    board.selectedKind = null;
    board.selectedIdx = -1;
  } else {
    board.selectedKind = kind;
    board.selectedIdx = idx;
  }
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Coordinate conversions
   ============================================================ */

/* canvas image pixels → viewer-normalized [0,1] */
export function canvasPxToViewerNorm(cx, cy) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vPxX = v.x * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxY = v.y * board.imageHeight;
  const vPxW = v.w * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxH = v.h * board.imageHeight;
  if (!vPxW || !vPxH) return [0, 0];
  return [(cx - vPxX) / vPxW, (cy - vPxY) / vPxH];
}

/* viewer-normalized [0,1] → canvas image pixels */
export function viewerNormToCanvasPx(vnx, vny) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vPxX = v.x * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxY = v.y * board.imageHeight;
  const vPxW = v.w * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxH = v.h * board.imageHeight;
  return [vPxX + vnx * vPxW, vPxY + vny * vPxH];
}

/* ============================================================
   Image-fit rect — memoized
   ============================================================ */

let _firKey = null;
let _firVal = null;

export function fittedImageRect() {
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  if (!board.imageWidth || !board.imageHeight) return null;

  const key = cw + "," + ch + "," + board.imageWidth + ","
            + board.imageHeight + "," + view.zoom + ","
            + view.panX + "," + view.panY;
  if (key === _firKey) return _firVal;

  const pad = 40;
  const sx = (cw - 2 * pad) / board.imageWidth;
  const sy = (ch - 2 * pad) / board.imageHeight;
  const s = Math.min(sx, sy) * view.zoom;
  const w = board.imageWidth  * s;
  const h = board.imageHeight * s;
  const x0 = (cw - w) / 2 + view.panX;
  const y0 = (ch - h) / 2 + view.panY;

  _firKey = key;
  _firVal = { x0, y0, w, h, s };
  return _firVal;
}

export function imageToScreen(x, y) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [x, y];
  return [r.x0 + x * r.s, r.y0 + y * r.s];
}

export function screenToImage(sx, sy) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [0, 0];
  return [(sx - r.x0) / r.s, (sy - r.y0) / r.s];
}

/* ============================================================
   Draw scheduling
   ============================================================ */

let _drawScheduled = false;
let _drawFn = null;

export function _setDraw(fn) { _drawFn = fn; }

export function _scheduleDraw() {
  if (_drawScheduled) return;
  _drawScheduled = true;
  const fire = () => {
    _drawScheduled = false;
    if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
  };
  if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === "function") requestAnimationFrame(fire);
  else setTimeout(fire, 16);
}

export function resize() {
  _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width  = Math.round(cw * _dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(ch * _dpr);
  canvas.style.width  = cw + "px";
  canvas.style.height = ch + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(_dpr, 0, 0, _dpr, 0, 0);
  clampPan();
  if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
"""
```

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/pg_viewer.py` (new)

```python
"""Viewer rectangle: hit testing, drag, resize.

The viewer is a rectangle on the @thelayout canvas that defines the
region that will actually be generated. It is:
  · sized by the selected ratio (aspect-ratio-locked)
  · draggable from its interior
  · resizable from any of its four corners
  · always containing the bboxes (bboxes are viewer-normalized)

All functions operate on `board.viewer` (canvas-normalized coords) and
the viewer drag state (`board.viewerDrag*`). Rendering lives in
`pg_view_image.py`; dispatch wiring lives in `pg_dispatch.py`.
"""

VIEWER_JS = r"""
import { board, viewerAspect } from "./pg_state.js";

export const VIEWER_HANDLE_TOL_PX = 10;
export const VIEWER_MIN_SIZE = 0.05;

export function getViewerHandles() {
  const v = board.viewer;
  return [
    { name: 'nw', x: v.x,       y: v.y },
    { name: 'ne', x: v.x + v.w, y: v.y },
    { name: 'sw', x: v.x,       y: v.y + v.h },
    { name: 'se', x: v.x + v.w, y: v.y + v.h },
  ];
}

export function viewerCursorFor(handle) {
  if (handle === 'move') return 'move';
  if (handle === 'nw' || handle === 'se') return 'nwse-resize';
  if (handle === 'ne' || handle === 'sw') return 'nesw-resize';
  return 'default';
}

/* sx, sy are screen pixels; r is fittedImageRect(). */
export function hitTestViewerHandle(sx, sy, r) {
  if (!r) return null;
  const tol = VIEWER_HANDLE_TOL_PX;
  for (const h of getViewerHandles()) {
    const hpx = r.x0 + h.x * r.w;
    const hpy = r.y0 + h.y * r.h;
    if (Math.abs(sx - hpx) <= tol && Math.abs(sy - hpy) <= tol) {
      return h.name;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* cx, cy are canvas image pixels. */
export function hitTestViewerInterior(cx, cy) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const x1 = v.x * board.imageWidth;
  const y1 = v.y * board.imageHeight;
  const x2 = (v.x + v.w) * board.imageWidth;
  const y2 = (v.y + v.h) * board.imageHeight;
  return cx >= x1 && cx <= x2 && cy >= y1 && cy <= y2;
}

/* Move the viewer by (dxNorm, dyNorm) in canvas-normalized coords. */
export function applyViewerMove(dxNorm, dyNorm) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const start = board.viewerDragStart;
  v.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - v.w, start.x + dxNorm));
  v.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - v.h, start.y + dyNorm));
}

/* Resize from a corner handle. Aspect ratio is preserved. */
export function applyViewerResize(handle, mouseCx, mouseCy) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const r = viewerAspect();
  const cw = board.imageWidth;
  const ch = board.imageHeight;
  if (!cw || !ch) return;

  const mx = mouseCx / cw;
  const my = mouseCy / ch;

  let anchorX, anchorY, rawW, rawH;
  if (handle === 'se') {
    anchorX = v.x;       anchorY = v.y;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, mx - anchorX);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, my - anchorY);
  } else if (handle === 'nw') {
    anchorX = v.x + v.w; anchorY = v.y + v.h;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorX - mx);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorY - my);
  } else if (handle === 'ne') {
    anchorX = v.x;       anchorY = v.y + v.h;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, mx - anchorX);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorY - my);
  } else if (handle === 'sw') {
    anchorX = v.x + v.w; anchorY = v.y;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorX - mx);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, my - anchorY);
  } else {
    return;
  }

  // Aspect constraint: rawW * cw / (rawH * ch) = r
  // Choose the dimension that keeps both within the user's drag.
  const newH_by_w = rawW * cw / (r * ch);
  let newW, newH;
  if (newH_by_w <= rawH) {
    newW = rawW;
    newH = newH_by_w;
  } else {
    newH = rawH;
    newW = rawH * r * ch / cw;
  }

  // Compute new position from anchor + size
  let newX, newY;
  if (handle === 'se')      { newX = v.x;      newY = v.y; }
  else if (handle === 'nw') { newX = anchorX - newW; newY = anchorY - newH; }
  else if (handle === 'ne') { newX = v.x;      newY = anchorY - newH; }
  else /* sw */             { newX = anchorX - newW; newY = v.y; }

  // Clamp position to canvas; if clamped, shrink proportionally.
  if (newX < 0) {
    newW = anchorX;
    newH = newW * cw / (r * ch);
    newX = 0;
    newY = (handle === 'sw') ? v.y : anchorY - newH;
  }
  if (newY < 0) {
    newH = anchorY;
    newW = newH * r * ch / cw;
    newY = 0;
    newX = (handle === 'ne') ? v.x : anchorX - newW;
  }
  if (newX + newW > 1) {
    newW = 1 - newX;
    newH = newW * cw / (r * ch);
  }
  if (newY + newH > 1) {
    newH = 1 - newY;
    newW = newH * r * ch / cw;
  }

  v.x = Math.max(0, newX);
  v.y = Math.max(0, newY);
  v.w = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, newW);
  v.h = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, newH);
}
"""
```

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/pg_dispatch.py`

```python
"""Mouse handling and drag math.

Bbox drags operate in viewer-normalized coords. Viewer drags operate
in canvas-normalized coords. Hit priority is:
  1. Viewer corner handle      → viewer resize
  2. Selected bbox corner      → bbox resize
  3. Bbox interior             → bbox drag
  4. Viewer interior           → viewer drag
  5. Nothing                   → deselect

Pan (space / middle mouse) and zoom (wheel) behave as before.
"""

DISPATCH_JS = r"""
import {
  canvas, board, view,
  screenToImage, fittedImageRect, imageToScreen,
  clampPan, zoomAt, resetView,
  setBbox, selectBbox,
  canvasPxToViewerNorm,
} from "./pg_state.js";
import {
  hitTestViewerHandle, hitTestViewerInterior,
  viewerCursorFor, applyViewerMove, applyViewerResize,
} from "./pg_viewer.js";
import { BBOX_MIN_SIZE, HANDLE_TOL_PX } from "./pg_tuning.js";

/* ============================================================
   Public helpers
   ============================================================ */

export function bboxScreenRect(bbox) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return null;
  const v = board.viewer;
  return {
    x0: r.x0 + (v.x + bbox.x * v.w)          * r.w,
    y0: r.y0 + (v.y + bbox.y * v.h)          * r.h,
    x1: r.x0 + (v.x + (bbox.x + bbox.w) * v.w) * r.w,
    y1: r.y0 + (v.y + (bbox.y + bbox.h) * v.h) * r.h,
  };
}

export function bboxHandles(bbox) {
  const rect = bboxScreenRect(bbox);
  if (!rect) return null;
  const { x0, y0, x1, y1 } = rect;
  return [
    { name: 'nw', x: x0, y: y0 },
    { name: 'ne', x: x1, y: y0 },
    { name: 'sw', x: x0, y: y1 },
    { name: 'se', x: x1, y: y1 },
    { name: 'n',  x: (x0 + x1) / 2, y: y0 },
    { name: 's',  x: (x0 + x1) / 2, y: y1 },
    { name: 'w',  x: x0, y: (y0 + y1) / 2 },
    { name: 'e',  x: x1, y: (y0 + y1) / 2 },
  ];
}

function _bboxCursorFor(name) {
  switch (name) {
    case 'nw': case 'se': return 'nwse-resize';
    case 'ne': case 'sw': return 'nesw-resize';
    case 'n':  case 's':  return 'ns-resize';
    case 'e':  case 'w':  return 'ew-resize';
    case 'move':          return 'move';
    default:              return 'default';
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Hit-testing (bbox side)
   ============================================================ */

function _hitBboxHandleOfSelected(sx, sy) {
  if (board.selectedKind === null) return null;
  const list = board.selectedKind === 'text'
    ? board.textBboxes : board.characterBboxes;
  const bbox = list[board.selectedIdx];
  if (!bbox) return null;
  const hs = bboxHandles(bbox);
  if (!hs) return null;
  const tol = HANDLE_TOL_PX;
  for (const h of hs) {
    if (Math.abs(sx - h.x) <= tol && Math.abs(sy - h.y) <= tol) {
      return h.name;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function _hitAnyBbox(vnx, vny) {
  for (let i = board.characterBboxes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = board.characterBboxes[i];
    if (vnx >= b.x && vnx <= b.x + b.w && vny >= b.y && vny <= b.y + b.h) {
      return { kind: 'character', idx: i };
    }
  }
  for (let i = board.textBboxes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const b = board.textBboxes[i];
    if (vnx >= b.x && vnx <= b.x + b.w && vny >= b.y && vny <= b.y + b.h) {
      return { kind: 'text', idx: i };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* ============================================================
   Bbox drag math (operates in viewer-normalized space)
   ============================================================ */

function _applyBboxDrag(bbox, handle, dxNorm, dyNorm) {
  let x1 = bbox.x, y1 = bbox.y;
  let x2 = bbox.x + bbox.w, y2 = bbox.y + bbox.h;

  if (handle === 'move') {
    const w = x2 - x1, h = y2 - y1;
    x1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - w, x1 + dxNorm));
    y1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - h, y1 + dyNorm));
    return { x: x1, y: y1, w, h };
  }

  if (handle.includes('w')) x1 += dxNorm;
  if (handle.includes('e')) x2 += dxNorm;
  if (handle.includes('n')) y1 += dyNorm;
  if (handle.includes('s')) y2 += dyNorm;

  x1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x1));
  x2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, x2));
  y1 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y1));
  y2 = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, y2));

  if (x1 > x2) [x1, x2] = [x2, x1];
  if (y1 > y2) [y1, y2] = [y2, y1];

  if (x2 - x1 < BBOX_MIN_SIZE) {
    if (handle.includes('w')) x1 = Math.max(0, x2 - BBOX_MIN_SIZE);
    else                     x2 = Math.min(1, x1 + BBOX_MIN_SIZE);
  }
  if (y2 - y1 < BBOX_MIN_SIZE) {
    if (handle.includes('n')) y1 = Math.max(0, y2 - BBOX_MIN_SIZE);
    else                     y2 = Math.min(1, y1 + BBOX_MIN_SIZE);
  }

  return { x: x1, y: y1, w: x2 - x1, h: y2 - y1 };
}

/* ============================================================
   Pan state
   ============================================================ */

let _panActive = false;
let _panStartSx = 0, _panStartSy = 0;
let _panStartX = 0, _panStartY = 0;
let _spaceDown = false;

/* ============================================================
   Mousedown
   ============================================================ */

canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  const active = document.activeElement;
  if (active && active !== canvas
      && (active.tagName === "INPUT"
          || active.tagName === "TEXTAREA"
          || active.tagName === "SELECT")) {
    active.blur();
  }

  if (e.button === 1 || (e.button === 0 && _spaceDown)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    _panActive = true;
    _panStartSx = e.clientX;
    _panStartSy = e.clientY;
    _panStartX = view.panX;
    _panStartY = view.panY;
    canvas.style.cursor = "grabbing";
    return;
  }

  if (e.button !== 0) return;
  if (!board.imageEl) return;

  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx = e.clientX - rect.left, sy = e.clientY - rect.top;
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return;
  const [cx, cy] = screenToImage(sx, sy);

  // 1) Viewer corner handle
  const viewerHandle = hitTestViewerHandle(sx, sy, r);
  if (viewerHandle) {
    board.viewerDragActive = true;
    board.viewerDragHandle = viewerHandle;
    board.viewerDragStart  = { ...board.viewer };
    board.viewerDragStartIx = cx;
    board.viewerDragStartIy = cy;
    canvas.style.cursor = viewerCursorFor(viewerHandle);
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }

  // 2) Selected bbox handle
  const bboxHandle = _hitBboxHandleOfSelected(sx, sy);
  if (bboxHandle) {
    const list = board.selectedKind === 'text'
      ? board.textBboxes : board.characterBboxes;
    const bbox = list[board.selectedIdx];
    board.dragActive = true;
    board.dragHandle = bboxHandle;
    board.dragKind = board.selectedKind;
    board.dragIdx = board.selectedIdx;
    board.dragStartBbox = { ...bbox };
    board.dragStartIx = cx;
    board.dragStartIy = cy;
    canvas.style.cursor = _bboxCursorFor(bboxHandle);
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }

  // 3) Any bbox interior
  const [vnx, vny] = canvasPxToViewerNorm(cx, cy);
  const hit = _hitAnyBbox(vnx, vny);
  if (hit) {
    selectBbox(hit.kind, hit.idx);
    const list = hit.kind === 'text'
      ? board.textBboxes : board.characterBboxes;
    const bbox = list[hit.idx];
    board.dragActive = true;
    board.dragHandle = 'move';
    board.dragKind = hit.kind;
    board.dragIdx = hit.idx;
    board.dragStartBbox = { ...bbox };
    board.dragStartIx = cx;
    board.dragStartIy = cy;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'move';
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }

  // 4) Viewer interior
  if (hitTestViewerInterior(cx, cy)) {
    board.viewerDragActive = true;
    board.viewerDragHandle = 'move';
    board.viewerDragStart  = { ...board.viewer };
    board.viewerDragStartIx = cx;
    board.viewerDragStartIy = cy;
    canvas.style.cursor = 'move';
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }

  // 5) Nothing: deselect
  selectBbox(null, -1);
});

canvas.addEventListener("contextmenu", (e) => e.preventDefault());

/* ============================================================
   Mousemove
   ============================================================ */

canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx = e.clientX - rect.left, sy = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (_panActive) {
    view.panX = _panStartX + (e.clientX - _panStartSx);
    view.panY = _panStartY + (e.clientY - _panStartSy);
    clampPan();
    canvas.style.cursor = "grabbing";
    _scheduleDraw();
    return;
  }

  if (_spaceDown) {
    canvas.style.cursor = "grab";
    return;
  }

  if (!board.imageEl) { canvas.style.cursor = "default"; return; }

  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return;
  const [cx, cy] = screenToImage(sx, sy);

  if (board.viewerDragActive) {
    if (board.viewerDragHandle === 'move') {
      const dx = (cx - board.viewerDragStartIx) / board.imageWidth;
      const dy = (cy - board.viewerDragStartIy) / board.imageHeight;
      applyViewerMove(dx, dy);
    } else {
      applyViewerResize(board.viewerDragHandle, cx, cy);
    }
    _scheduleDraw();
    return;
  }

  if (board.dragActive) {
    const dxCanvasNorm = (cx - board.dragStartIx) / board.imageWidth;
    const dyCanvasNorm = (cy - board.dragStartIy) / board.imageHeight;
    const dxViewerNorm = dxCanvasNorm / board.viewer.w;
    const dyViewerNorm = dyCanvasNorm / board.viewer.h;
    const next = _applyBboxDrag(
      board.dragStartBbox, board.dragHandle, dxViewerNorm, dyViewerNorm,
    );
    setBbox(board.dragKind, board.dragIdx, next);
    canvas.style.cursor = _bboxCursorFor(board.dragHandle);
    return;
  }

  // Hover state (priority order matches mousedown)
  const viewerHandle = hitTestViewerHandle(sx, sy, r);
  if (viewerHandle) {
    canvas.style.cursor = viewerCursorFor(viewerHandle);
    return;
  }
  const bboxHandle = _hitBboxHandleOfSelected(sx, sy);
  if (bboxHandle) {
    canvas.style.cursor = _bboxCursorFor(bboxHandle);
    return;
  }
  const [vnx, vny] = canvasPxToViewerNorm(cx, cy);
  const hit = _hitAnyBbox(vnx, vny);
  if (hit) {
    if (board.hoveredKind !== hit.kind || board.hoveredIdx !== hit.idx) {
      board.hoveredKind = hit.kind;
      board.hoveredIdx = hit.idx;
      _scheduleDraw();
    }
    canvas.style.cursor = "move";
    return;
  }
  if (board.hoveredKind !== null || board.hoveredIdx !== -1) {
    board.hoveredKind = null;
    board.hoveredIdx = -1;
    _scheduleDraw();
  }
  if (hitTestViewerInterior(cx, cy)) {
    canvas.style.cursor = "move";
    return;
  }
  canvas.style.cursor = "crosshair";
});

canvas.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left, my = e.clientY - rect.top;
  const dy = e.deltaY * (e.deltaMode === 1 ? 16
                       : e.deltaMode === 2 ? 100
                       : 1);
  const factor = Math.exp(-dy * 0.0015);
  zoomAt(mx, my, view.zoom * factor);
  _scheduleDraw();
}, { passive: false });

/* ============================================================
   Mouseup / Keyup
   ============================================================ */

window.addEventListener("mouseup", () => {
  if (_panActive) {
    _panActive = false;
    canvas.style.cursor = _spaceDown ? "grab" : "crosshair";
  }
  if (board.viewerDragActive) {
    board.viewerDragActive = false;
    board.viewerDragHandle = null;
    board.viewerDragStart  = null;
    canvas.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    if (window._layoutOnDragEnd) window._layoutOnDragEnd();
  }
  if (board.dragActive) {
    board.dragActive = false;
    board.dragHandle = null;
    board.dragKind = null;
    board.dragIdx = -1;
    board.dragStartBbox = null;
    canvas.style.cursor = "crosshair";
    if (window._layoutOnDragEnd) window._layoutOnDragEnd();
  }
});

window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
    _spaceDown = false;
    if (!_panActive) canvas.style.cursor = "crosshair";
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => {
  board.mouse.inside = false;
  if (board.hoveredKind !== null) {
    board.hoveredKind = null;
    board.hoveredIdx = -1;
    _scheduleDraw();
  }
});

/* ============================================================
   Keyboard
   ============================================================ */

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const t = e.target;
  if (t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA"
            || t.tagName === "SELECT")) return;

  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!_spaceDown) {
      _spaceDown = true;
      if (!_panActive) canvas.style.cursor = "grab";
    }
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "Home" || e.key === "0") {
    e.preventDefault();
    resetView();
    _scheduleDraw();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectBbox(null, -1);
    return;
  }
});

import { _scheduleDraw } from "./pg_state.js";
"""
```

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/pg_view_image.py`

```python
"""The loaded image, the viewer mask, bboxes, and the viewer frame.

Render order:
  1. Image
  2. Dim outside viewer (4 rects in canvas margin + viewer exterior)
  3. Bboxes (inside viewer, so never dimmed)
  4. Viewer outline + corner handles
  5. Image border
"""

VIEW_IMAGE_JS = r"""
import { ctx, board, viewerAspect } from "./pg_state.js";
import { bboxScreenRect, bboxHandles } from "./pg_dispatch.js";

const COLORS = {
  text: {
    normal:  "rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.70)",
    hover:   "rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.90)",
    selected: "rgba(120, 220, 255, 1.00)",
    fill:    "rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.06)",
  },
  character: {
    normal:  "rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.70)",
    hover:   "rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.90)",
    selected: "rgba(255, 200, 90, 1.00)",
    fill:    "rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.06)",
  },
};

function _drawOneBbox(kind, idx, bbox, isSelected, isHovered) {
  const r = bboxScreenRect(bbox);
  if (!r) return;
  const pal = COLORS[kind];
  const stroke = isSelected ? pal.selected
              : isHovered  ? pal.hover
              : pal.normal;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = pal.fill;
  ctx.fillRect(r.x0, r.y0, r.x1 - r.x0, r.y1 - r.y0);

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.85)";
  ctx.lineWidth = isSelected ? 6.0 : 3.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(r.x0, r.y0, r.x1 - r.x0, r.y1 - r.y0);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
  ctx.lineWidth = isSelected ? 2.8 : 2.0;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(r.x0, r.y0, r.x1 - r.x0, r.y1 - r.y0);
  ctx.stroke();

  const label = (kind === 'text' ? 'TEXT ' : 'CHAR ') + (idx + 1);
  ctx.font = "700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = stroke;
  ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText(label, r.x0 + 3, r.y0 - 3);

  if (isSelected) {
    const hs = bboxHandles(bbox);
    if (hs) {
      for (const h of hs) {
        const HS = 7;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.85)";
        ctx.fillRect(h.x - HS - 2, h.y - HS - 2, (HS + 2) * 2, (HS + 2) * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = stroke;
        ctx.fillRect(h.x - HS, h.y - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.strokeRect(h.x - HS, h.y - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
      }
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function _dimOutsideViewer(r) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vx0 = r.x0 + v.x * r.w;
  const vy0 = r.y0 + v.y * r.h;
  const vx1 = r.x0 + (v.x + v.w) * r.w;
  const vy1 = r.y0 + (v.y + v.h) * r.h;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6, 8, 12, 0.55)";

  // Top strip (canvas area above viewer)
  if (vy0 > r.y0) {
    ctx.fillRect(r.x0, r.y0, r.w, vy0 - r.y0);
  }
  // Bottom strip
  if (vy1 < r.y0 + r.h) {
    ctx.fillRect(r.x0, vy1, r.w, r.y0 + r.h - vy1);
  }
  // Left strip (between viewer top and bottom)
  if (vx0 > r.x0) {
    ctx.fillRect(r.x0, vy0, vx0 - r.x0, vy1 - vy0);
  }
  // Right strip
  if (vx1 < r.x0 + r.w) {
    ctx.fillRect(vx1, vy0, r.x0 + r.w - vx1, vy1 - vy0);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function _drawViewerFrame(r) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vx0 = r.x0 + v.x * r.w;
  const vy0 = r.y0 + v.y * r.h;
  const vx1 = r.x0 + (v.x + v.w) * r.w;
  const vy1 = r.y0 + (v.y + v.h) * r.h;

  ctx.save();

  // Halo stroke
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.85)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(vx0, vy0, vx1 - vx0, vy1 - vy0);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Bright stroke
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.0;
  ctx.setLineDash([10, 5]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(vx0, vy0, vx1 - vx0, vy1 - vy0);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Corner handles
  const HS = 8;
  const corners = [
    [vx0, vy0], [vx1, vy0],
    [vx0, vy1], [vx1, vy1],
  ];
  for (const [hx, hy] of corners) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.9)";
    ctx.fillRect(hx - HS - 2, hy - HS - 2, (HS + 2) * 2, (HS + 2) * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 1.0)";
    ctx.fillRect(hx - HS, hy - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.strokeRect(hx - HS, hy - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
  }

  // Frame label
  ctx.font = "700 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  const ratio = v.ratio;
  ctx.fillText("FRAME " + ratio + ":1", vx0 + 4, vy0 - 16);

  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawImageLayer(r) {
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
  ctx.drawImage(board.imageEl, r.x0, r.y0, r.w, r.h);

  _dimOutsideViewer(r);

  for (let i = 0; i < board.textBboxes.length; i++) {
    _drawOneBbox('text', i, board.textBboxes[i],
                 board.selectedKind === 'text' && board.selectedIdx === i,
                 board.hoveredKind === 'text' && board.hoveredIdx === i);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < board.characterBboxes.length; i++) {
    _drawOneBbox('character', i, board.characterBboxes[i],
                 board.selectedKind === 'character' && board.selectedIdx === i,
                 board.hoveredKind === 'character' && board.hoveredIdx === i);
  }

  _drawViewerFrame(r);

  // Faint canvas border on top
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e2836";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(r.x0 + 0.5, r.y0 + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1);
}
"""
```

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/pg_panel.py`

```python
"""Panel: bbox list, buttons, Generation Frame dropdowns, state sync."""

PANEL_JS = r"""
import {
  board, setImage, applyCanvasImage, clearImage,
  addBbox, deleteBbox, clearAllBboxes, seedDefault, selectBbox,
  resetViewerToFit,
} from "./pg_state.js";
import {
  uploadImageFile, importFromKrita, checkKritaStatus,
  fetchActiveState, fetchResourceImage,
} from "./pg_client.js";
import { fetchSelectedLayer } from "./pg_autosync.js";
import { flashStatus } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";
import { pgkitNotifyAll } from "./pgkit/remote_client.js";

const PLAYGROUND_ID = "layout";
const SLOT_ID       = "@thelayout";

// Mirror of pixart_res table keys.  Kept in sync with
// kritomatic_nodes/PixArt/conf.py — node uses exact dims, this list
// is only used to populate the dropdown and compute display aspect
// via float(ratio).
const RATIO_KEYS = [
  "0.25", "0.26", "0.27", "0.28",
  "0.32", "0.33", "0.35", "0.40",
  "0.42", "0.48", "0.50", "0.52",
  "0.57", "0.60", "0.68", "0.72",
  "0.78", "0.82", "0.88", "0.94",
  "1.00", "1.07", "1.13", "1.21",
  "1.29", "1.38", "1.46", "1.67",
  "1.75", "2.00", "2.09", "2.40",
  "2.50", "2.89", "3.00", "3.11",
  "3.62", "3.75", "3.88", "4.00",
];

/* ============================================================
   State sync
   ============================================================ */

let _syncTimer = null;
let _lastStateSnapshot = "";

function _stateSnapshot() {
  return JSON.stringify({
    t: board.textBboxes,
    c: board.characterBboxes,
    r: board.referenceEmbeddings,
    d: [board.imageWidth, board.imageHeight],
    v: board.viewer,
  });
}

function _buildPayload() {
  const toWire = (list) => list.map(b => [
    b.x, b.y, b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h,
  ]);

  return {
    op: "set",
    state: {
      text_bboxes:          toWire(board.textBboxes),
      character_bboxes:     toWire(board.characterBboxes),
      reference_embeddings: board.referenceEmbeddings.map(r => r || null),
      image_dims:           [board.imageWidth, board.imageHeight],
      viewer: {
        x: board.viewer.x,
        y: board.viewer.y,
        w: board.viewer.w,
        h: board.viewer.h,
        model: board.viewer.model,
        ratio: board.viewer.ratio,
      },
    },
  };
}

function _scheduleStateSync() {
  if (_syncTimer) clearTimeout(_syncTimer);
  _syncTimer = setTimeout(_doStateSync, 250);
}

async function _doStateSync() {
  _syncTimer = null;
  const snap = _stateSnapshot();
  if (snap === _lastStateSnapshot) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch("/state", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(_buildPayload()),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      _lastStateSnapshot = snap;
      const v = (data.version || "").slice(0, 8);
      const el = document.getElementById("stateVersion");
      if (el) el.textContent = v || "—";
      const sl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
      if (sl) {
        sl.textContent = "synced \u00b7 v" + v;
        sl.className = "ok";
      }
    } else {
      const sl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
      if (sl) {
        sl.textContent = "sync failed: " + (data.message || "unknown");
        sl.className = "bad";
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    const sl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
    if (sl) {
      sl.textContent = "sync failed: " + e.message;
      sl.className = "bad";
    }
  }
  pgkitNotifyAll();
}

window._layoutOnDragEnd = _scheduleStateSync;

/* ============================================================
   Bbox list
   ============================================================ */

function _renderBboxList() {
  const list = document.getElementById("bboxList");
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = "";

  if (board.textBboxes.length === 0 && board.characterBboxes.length === 0) {
    const e = document.createElement("div");
    e.className = "empty";
    e.textContent = board.imageEl
      ? "no bboxes yet \u2014 click + Text region or + Character"
      : "load an image first";
    list.appendChild(e);
    return;
  }

  const _row = (kind, idx, bbox) => {
    const isSel = board.selectedKind === kind && board.selectedIdx === idx;
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "bboxRow" + (isSel ? " selected" : "");
    if (isSel) {
      row.style.borderColor = kind === 'text'
        ? "rgba(120,220,255,0.85)"
        : "rgba(255,200,90,0.85)";
    }

    const sw = document.createElement("span");
    sw.className = "bboxSwatch";
    sw.style.background = kind === 'text'
      ? "rgb(120,220,255)"
      : "rgb(255,200,90)";
    row.appendChild(sw);

    const lbl = document.createElement("span");
    lbl.className = "bboxLabel";
    lbl.textContent = (kind === 'text' ? "Text " : "Char ") + (idx + 1);
    row.appendChild(lbl);

    const dims = document.createElement("span");
    dims.className = "bboxDims";
    // Show % of the generation frame (meaningful regardless of which
    // model/ratio is selected).
    const pctW = Math.round(bbox.w * 100);
    const pctH = Math.round(bbox.h * 100);
    dims.textContent = pctW + "% \u00d7 " + pctH + "%";
    row.appendChild(dims);

    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.className = "bboxDel";
    del.textContent = "\u00d7";
    del.title = "Remove bbox";
    del.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      deleteBbox(kind, idx);
      _renderBboxList();
      _scheduleStateSync();
    });
    row.appendChild(del);

    row.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectBbox(kind, idx);
      _renderBboxList();
    });

    list.appendChild(row);
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < board.textBboxes.length; i++) {
    _row('text', i, board.textBboxes[i]);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < board.characterBboxes.length; i++) {
    _row('character', i, board.characterBboxes[i]);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Panel sync
   ============================================================ */

export function syncPanelFields() {
  const e = {
    imageInfo:      document.getElementById("imageInfo"),
    addText:        document.getElementById("addTextBboxBtn"),
    addChar:        document.getElementById("addCharacterBboxBtn"),
    seed:           document.getElementById("seedDefaultBtn"),
    clear:          document.getElementById("clearBboxesBtn"),
    viewerModel:    document.getElementById("viewerModel"),
    viewerRatio:    document.getElementById("viewerRatio"),
  };

  if (e.imageInfo) {
    const text = board.imageEl
      ? board.imageWidth + " \u00d7 " + board.imageHeight
        + "   [" + String(board.imageHash).slice(0, 8) + "\u2026]"
      : "No image loaded";
    if (e.imageInfo.textContent !== text) e.imageInfo.textContent = text;
  }

  if (e.viewerModel && document.activeElement !== e.viewerModel) {
    if (e.viewerModel.value !== board.viewer.model) {
      e.viewerModel.value = board.viewer.model;
    }
  }
  if (e.viewerRatio && document.activeElement !== e.viewerRatio) {
    if (e.viewerRatio.value !== board.viewer.ratio) {
      e.viewerRatio.value = board.viewer.ratio;
    }
  }

  const hasImage = !!board.imageEl;
  if (e.addText) e.addText.disabled = !hasImage;
  if (e.addChar) e.addChar.disabled = !hasImage;
  if (e.seed)    e.seed.disabled    = !hasImage;
  if (e.clear)   e.clear.disabled   =
    !(board.textBboxes.length + board.characterBboxes.length);
}

/* ============================================================
   Buttons
   ============================================================ */

function _pickImageAction() {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  input.accept = "image/*";
  input.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const file = input.files && input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    flashStatus("uploading\u2026", "");
    try {
      const info = await uploadImageFile(file);
      const dataUrl = await _fileToDataUrl(file);
      setImage(info.hash, dataUrl, info.width, info.height);
      flashStatus("image loaded", "ok");
      _scheduleStateSync();
      _renderBboxList();
    } catch (e) {
      flashStatus("upload failed: " + e.message, "bad");
    }
  });
  input.click();
}

function _fileToDataUrl(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ""));
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("could not read file"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function _clearImageAction() {
  clearImage();
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

async function _importImageFromKritaAction() {
  flashStatus("importing from Krita\u2026", "");
  const res = await importFromKrita({});
  if (!res.success) {
    flashStatus("import failed: " + (res.message || "unknown"), "bad");
    return;
  }
  setImage(res.hash, res.data_url, res.width, res.height);
  flashStatus("imported " + res.width + "\u00d7" + res.height, "ok");
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

async function _refreshCanvasAction() {
  flashStatus("refreshing " + SLOT_ID + "\u2026", "");
  const state = await fetchActiveState();
  if (!state || state.daemon_reachable === false) {
    flashStatus(SLOT_ID + " refresh failed: daemon unreachable", "bad");
    return;
  }
  const playgrounds = (state.data && state.data.playgrounds) || [];
  const entry = playgrounds.find(p => p.id === PLAYGROUND_ID);
  const slots = (entry && entry.layer_slots) || [];
  const slot = slots.find(s => s.id === SLOT_ID);
  if (!slot) {
    flashStatus(SLOT_ID + " not registered", "warn");
    return;
  }
  const selector = slot.selector
    || { source: "active", layer_name: null };
  await fetchSelectedLayer(selector);
}

function _addTextBboxAction() {
  if (!board.imageEl) return;
  const n = board.textBboxes.length;
  addBbox('text', {
    x: 0.10,
    y: Math.min(0.85, 0.02 + n * 0.15),
    w: 0.80,
    h: 0.10,
  });
  selectBbox('text', board.textBboxes.length - 1);
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

function _addCharacterBboxAction() {
  if (!board.imageEl) return;
  const n = board.characterBboxes.length;
  addBbox('character', {
    x: Math.max(0.05, 0.30 - n * 0.05),
    y: 0.15,
    w: 0.40,
    h: 0.75,
  });
  selectBbox('character', board.characterBboxes.length - 1);
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

function _seedDefaultAction() {
  if (!board.imageEl) return;
  seedDefault();
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

function _clearAllAction() {
  clearAllBboxes();
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

async function _kritaStatusAction() {
  const res = await checkKritaStatus();
  const el = document.getElementById("kritaStatus");
  if (!el) return;
  if (res.reachable) {
    el.textContent = "\u2713 reachable";
    el.className = "ok";
  } else {
    el.textContent = "\u2717 not reachable";
    el.className = "bad";
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Install
   ============================================================ */

function _showDropOverlay(on) {
  const el = document.getElementById("dropOverlay");
  if (el) el.classList.toggle("visible", on);
}

function _installDropOverlay() {
  if (document.getElementById("dropOverlay")) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.id = "dropOverlay";
  el.textContent = "Drop an image";
  document.body.appendChild(el);
}

function _installViewerDropdowns() {
  const ratioSel = document.getElementById("viewerRatio");
  const modelSel = document.getElementById("viewerModel");
  if (!ratioSel || !modelSel) return;

  // Populate ratio dropdown once.
  if (ratioSel.options.length === 0) {
    for (const k of RATIO_KEYS) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = k;
      opt.textContent = k;
      ratioSel.appendChild(opt);
    }
  }
  ratioSel.value = board.viewer.ratio;
  modelSel.value = board.viewer.model;

  ratioSel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    board.viewer.ratio = ratioSel.value;
    resetViewerToFit();
    _scheduleStateSync();
    _renderBboxList();
  });

  modelSel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    board.viewer.model = modelSel.value;
    _scheduleStateSync();
  });
}

export function installPanelBindings() {
  const ids = {
    pickImage:  "pickImageBtn",
    clearImage: "clearImageBtn",
    importImg:  "importImageBtn",
    refresh:    "refreshCanvasBtn",
    addText:    "addTextBboxBtn",
    addChar:    "addCharacterBboxBtn",
    seed:       "seedDefaultBtn",
    clearAll:   "clearBboxesBtn",
    kritaCheck: "kritaCheckBtn",
  };
  const el = {};
  for (const k in ids) el[k] = document.getElementById(ids[k]);

  if (el.pickImage)   el.pickImage.addEventListener("click", _pickImageAction);
  if (el.clearImage)  el.clearImage.addEventListener("click", _clearImageAction);
  if (el.importImg)   el.importImg.addEventListener("click", _importImageFromKritaAction);
  if (el.refresh)     el.refresh.addEventListener("click", _refreshCanvasAction);
  if (el.addText)     el.addText.addEventListener("click", _addTextBboxAction);
  if (el.addChar)     el.addChar.addEventListener("click", _addCharacterBboxAction);
  if (el.seed)        el.seed.addEventListener("click", _seedDefaultAction);
  if (el.clearAll)    el.clearAll.addEventListener("click", _clearAllAction);
  if (el.kritaCheck)  el.kritaCheck.addEventListener("click", _kritaStatusAction);

  _installViewerDropdowns();
  _installDropOverlay();
  let _dragDepth = 0;
  window.addEventListener("dragenter", () => {
    _dragDepth++;
    _showDropOverlay(true);
  });
  window.addEventListener("dragleave", () => {
    _dragDepth--;
    if (_dragDepth <= 0) _showDropOverlay(false);
  });
  window.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => e.preventDefault());
  window.addEventListener("drop", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    _dragDepth = 0;
    _showDropOverlay(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files
                 && e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file && file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
      flashStatus("uploading\u2026", "");
      try {
        const info = await uploadImageFile(file);
        const dataUrl = await _fileToDataUrl(file);
        setImage(info.hash, dataUrl, info.width, info.height);
        _renderBboxList();
        _scheduleStateSync();
      } catch (e) {
        flashStatus("upload failed: " + e.message, "bad");
      }
    }
  });

  _bootPull().catch(() => {});
}

async function _bootPull() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/state", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: "{}",
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      const v = (data.version || "").slice(0, 8);
      const el = document.getElementById("stateVersion");
      if (el) el.textContent = v || "—";
      _lastStateSnapshot = _stateSnapshot();
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
}

export function layoutBootSync() {
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
  _kritaStatusAction();
}

export function onDrawComplete() {
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
}
"""

## 📄 `playgrounds/layout/pg_autosync.py`

```python
"""Layer-slot autosync — preserves viewer + bboxes on layer refresh."""

AUTOSYNC_JS = r"""
import { board, applyCanvasImage } from "./pg_state.js";
import { fetchActiveState, fetchResourceImage } from "./pg_client.js";
import { flashStatus } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS      = 500;
const PLAYGROUND_ID         = "layout";
const SLOT_ID               = "@thelayout";
const DAEMON_DOWN_WARN      = 3;
const REREGISTER_ON_MISSING = true;

let _lastSelectorKey = null;
let _bootstrapped = false;
let _running = false;
let _timer = null;
let _daemonDownStreak = 0;
let _lastReregisterAt = 0;

function _selectorKey(sel) {
  if (!sel || typeof sel !== "object") return "";
  return (sel.source || "active") + ":" + (sel.layer_name || "");
}

export async function fetchSelectedLayer(selector) {
  flashStatus("refreshing layer\u2026", "");
  const spec = {
    source:     selector.source || "active",
    layer_name: selector.layer_name || null,
  };
  const img = await fetchResourceImage(spec);
  if (!img || !img.success || !img.data_url) {
    flashStatus(
      "layer refresh failed: " + ((img && img.message) || "unknown"),
      "bad",
    );
    return;
  }
  applyCanvasImage(
    img.hash || ("layer_" + Date.now()),
    img.data_url, img.width, img.height,
  );
  const label = spec.source === "layer"
    ? spec.layer_name
    : spec.source;
  flashStatus("layer \u2192 " + label, "ok");
  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
}

async function _reregisterIfMissing() {
  if (!REREGISTER_ON_MISSING) return;
  const now = Date.now();
  if (now - _lastReregisterAt < 2000) return;
  _lastReregisterAt = now;
  try {
    await fetch("/playground_reregister", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: "{}",
    });
  } catch (_) {}
}

async function _poll() {
  _timer = null;
  if (_running) return;
  _running = true;
  try {
    const resp = await fetchActiveState();

    if (!resp || resp.daemon_reachable === false) {
      _daemonDownStreak += 1;
      if (_daemonDownStreak === DAEMON_DOWN_WARN) {
        flashStatus(
          "daemon unreachable \u2014 playground will exit",
          "bad",
        );
      }
      return;
    }
    _daemonDownStreak = 0;

    const playgrounds = (resp.data && resp.data.playgrounds) || [];
    const entry = playgrounds.find(p => p.id === PLAYGROUND_ID);
    if (!entry) {
      flashStatus("not registered with daemon \u2014 re-registering", "warn");
      await _reregisterIfMissing();
      return;
    }

    const slots = entry.layer_slots || [];
    const slot = slots.find(s => s.id === SLOT_ID);
    if (!slot) {
      flashStatus(
        "slot " + SLOT_ID + " missing from registered entry",
        "warn",
      );
      await _reregisterIfMissing();
      return;
    }

    const selector = slot.selector || { source: "active", layer_name: null };
    const key = _selectorKey(selector);

    if (!_bootstrapped) {
      _bootstrapped = true;
      _lastSelectorKey = key;
      if (!board.imageHash) {
        await fetchSelectedLayer(selector);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (key === _lastSelectorKey) return;
    _lastSelectorKey = key;
    await fetchSelectedLayer(selector);
  } finally {
    _running = false;
    _schedule();
  }
}

function _schedule() {
  if (document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
  if (_timer !== null) clearTimeout(_timer);
  _timer = setTimeout(_poll, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
}

export function startAutosync() {
  if (_timer !== null) return;
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    if (_timer !== null) { clearTimeout(_timer); _timer = null; }
    if (!_running) _poll();
  });
  _timer = setTimeout(_poll, 200);
}
"""
```
