```python
"""Panel button handlers, pgkit actions, mask list levels, and the
boot-sync routine.

Operations exposed by this playground:
  - Load image (file, drop; autosync from @thecanvas)
  - Load masks (import from Krita, pick a PNG file)
  - Select / delete masks
  - Rotate the playground view (single scrub input)
  - Materialise the context rectangle as a mask
  - Manual "Sync now" (re-push state)
  - ComfyUI / Krita status checks

Not present: Inpaint button, Cancel button, prompt field, interceptor
routing.  Generation is triggered by the docker's Run button; the
playground's job is to push state into Krita scratch layers so that
run finds the right canvas / mask / context rectangle.

SYNC TRIGGERS
=============
Every user-facing state mutation below calls `scheduleSync()` after
updating the model.  Image loads and mask imports go through the
debounced path; rotation changes bypass the debounce (handled in
`pg_panel_scrubs.js`).  Autosync from @thecanvas does NOT schedule a
push — pushing back what was just pulled would be wasteful.

MANUAL @thecanvas REFRESH
=========================
`_refreshCanvasAction` uses `applyCanvasImage`, which preserves the
mask stack and the context rectangle when the new image's dims
match.  (A full-dims mismatch clears the context rect, since its
coords referred to the old dims, but masks keep their pixel data.)"""

PANEL_BINDINGS_JS = r"""
import { board, setImage, clearImage, applyCanvasImage,
         _scheduleDraw, view, _applyRotation } from "./pg_state.js";
import {
  setMasks, addMaskFromB64,
  selectedMask, selectedMaskIdx,
  replaceMaskSelection,
} from "./pg_masks.js";
import { buildMaskFromContextRectB64 } from "./pg_inpaint.js";
import { syncMaskList } from "./pg_panel_lists.js";
import { syncPanelFields } from "./pg_panel_fields.js";
import { scheduleSync, syncNow } from "./pg_sync.js";
import { uploadImageFile, fetchStatus } from "./pg_comfy_client.js";
import {
  checkKritaStatus, importKritaMasks, fetchActiveState,
  fetchResourceImage,
} from "./pg_krita_client.js";
import {
  pgkitRegisterAction, pgkitRegisterLevel, pgkitNotifyAll,
} from "./pgkit/remote_client.js";
import { flashStatus } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";

/* ============================================================
   File picking / drop
   ============================================================ */

function _showDropOverlay(on) {
  const el = document.getElementById("dropOverlay");
  if (el) el.classList.toggle("visible", on);
}

function _installDropOverlay() {
  if (document.getElementById("dropOverlay")) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.id = "dropOverlay";
  el.textContent = "Drop an image";
  document.body.appendChild(el);
}

async function _handleDroppedFile(file) {
  flashStatus("uploading " + file.name + "\u2026", "");
  try {
    const info = await uploadImageFile(file);
    const dataUrl = await _fileToDataUrl(file);
    setImage(info.hash, dataUrl, info.width, info.height);
    flashStatus("image loaded: " + file.name, "ok");
    syncPanelFields();
    syncMaskList();
    pgkitNotifyAll();
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    flashStatus("upload failed: " + e.message, "bad");
  }
}

function _fileToDataUrl(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ""));
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("could not read file"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function _pickImageAction() {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  input.accept = "image/*";
  input.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const file = input.files && input.files[0];
    if (file) _handleDroppedFile(file);
  });
  input.click();
}

function _pickMaskAction() {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  input.accept = "image/png,image/*";
  input.addEventListener("change", () => {
    const file = input.files && input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => {
      const dataUrl = String(reader.result || "");
      const b64 = dataUrl.replace(/^data:image\/[^;]+;base64,/, "");
      const newIdx = addMaskFromB64(b64);
      board.selectedMaskIndices = [newIdx];
      syncMaskList();
      syncPanelFields();
      pgkitNotifyAll();
      scheduleSync();
      import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
    };
    reader.onerror = () => flashStatus("could not read mask file", "bad");
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
  input.click();
}

function _clearImageAction() {
  clearImage();
  const rotEl = document.getElementById("viewRotation");
  if (rotEl) rotEl.value = "0";
  syncPanelFields();
  syncMaskList();
  pgkitNotifyAll();
  scheduleSync();
  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
}

/* ============================================================
   Manual @thecanvas refresh
   ============================================================ */

async function _refreshCanvasAction() {
  flashStatus("refreshing @thecanvas\u2026", "");
  let state;
  try {
    state = await fetchActiveState();
  } catch (e) {
    flashStatus("@thecanvas refresh failed: " + e.message, "bad");
    return;
  }
  if (!state || !state.success) {
    flashStatus(
      "@thecanvas refresh failed: "
        + ((state && state.message) || "no active state"),
      "bad",
    );
    return;
  }
  const cfg = (state.data && state.data.config) || null;
  const res = (cfg && cfg.resources) || {};
  const spec = res["@thecanvas"];
  if (!spec || typeof spec !== "object") {
    flashStatus("@thecanvas not set in daemon config", "warn");
    return;
  }
  const normalized = {
    source: spec.source || "active",
    layer_name: spec.layer_name || null,
  };

  let img;
  try {
    img = await fetchResourceImage(normalized);
  } catch (e) {
    flashStatus("@thecanvas refresh failed: " + e.message, "bad");
    return;
  }
  if (!img || !img.success) {
    flashStatus(
      "@thecanvas refresh failed: "
        + ((img && img.message) || "unknown"),
      "bad",
    );
    return;
  }
  if (!img.data_url) {
    flashStatus("@thecanvas refresh: no data_url", "bad");
    return;
  }

  applyCanvasImage(
    img.hash || ("thecanvas_" + Date.now()),
    img.data_url,
    img.width,
    img.height,
  );

  const label = normalized.source === "layer"
    ? normalized.layer_name
    : normalized.source;
  flashStatus("@thecanvas \u2192 " + label, "ok");

  syncPanelFields();
  syncMaskList();
  pgkitNotifyAll();
  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
}

/* ============================================================
   Mask from context rectangle
   ============================================================ */

function _maskFromRectAction() {
  if (!board.imageHash) {
    flashStatus("Load an image first", "warn");
    return;
  }
  if (!board.inpaintEnabled) {
    flashStatus("Enable the context rectangle first", "warn");
    return;
  }
  const c = board.inpaintContext;
  if (!c || c.w <= 0 || c.h <= 0) {
    flashStatus("Draw the context rectangle first", "warn");
    return;
  }

  const b64 = buildMaskFromContextRectB64();
  if (!b64) {
    flashStatus("Could not build mask", "bad");
    return;
  }

  const idx = addMaskFromB64(b64);
  board.selectedMaskIndices = [idx];

  flashStatus("created mask " + (idx + 1) + " from context rectangle", "ok");
  syncMaskList();
  syncPanelFields();
  pgkitNotifyAll();
  scheduleSync();
  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
}

/* ============================================================
   Shared-selection hydration
   ============================================================ */

async function _hydrateSharedSelection() {
  if (board.masks.length > 0) return;

  let state;
  try {
    state = await fetchActiveState();
  } catch (_) {
    return;
  }
  if (!state || !state.success) return;
  const data = state.data || {};
  const cfg = data.config;
  if (!cfg || typeof cfg !== "object") return;
  const resources = cfg.resources || {};
  const spec = resources["@theselection"];
  if (!spec || typeof spec !== "object") return;
  if (spec.source !== "layer") return;
  const layerName = spec.layer_name;
  if (!layerName) return;

  let res;
  try {
    res = await importKritaMasks({ layerNames: [layerName] });
  } catch (_) {
    return;
  }
  if (!res || !res.success) return;
  const masks = res.masks || [];
  if (masks.length === 0) return;

  const addedIndices = [];
  for (const m of masks) {
    if (m && m.mask_b64) addedIndices.push(addMaskFromB64(m.mask_b64));
  }
  if (addedIndices.length === 0) return;

  board.selectedMaskIndices = [addedIndices[0]];

  syncMaskList();
  syncPanelFields();
  pgkitNotifyAll();
  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  flashStatus(
    "mask hydrated from @theselection ("
      + addedIndices.length + " layer(s))",
    ""
  );
}

/* ============================================================
   Status checks
   ============================================================ */

async function _checkStatusAction() {
  const s = await fetchStatus();
  if (!s.reachable) {
    flashStatus("ComfyUI unreachable: " + (s.message || ""), "bad");
    return;
  }
  flashStatus("ComfyUI \u2713", "ok");
}

function _kritaMarkReachable() {
  const el = document.getElementById("kritaStatus");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = "\u2713 reachable";
  el.className = "ok";
  el.title = "Kritomatic daemon at localhost:12346";
}

function _kritaMarkUnreachable(reason) {
  const el = document.getElementById("kritaStatus");
  if (!el) return;
  el.textContent = "\u2717 " + (reason || "not reachable");
  el.className = "bad";
  el.title = "Start Krita with the Kritomatic Daemon plugin enabled";
  try {
    console.error("[inpaint] krita:", reason || "not reachable");
  } catch (_) {}
}

async function _kritaStatusRefresh() {
  const s = await checkKritaStatus();
  if (s.reachable) _kritaMarkReachable();
  else             _kritaMarkUnreachable(s.message || "not reachable");
}

/* ============================================================
   Import masks from Krita
   ============================================================ */

async function _kritaImportMasksAction() {
  flashStatus("importing masks from Krita\u2026", "");
  try {
    const res = await importKritaMasks({ preferSelectionMaskChildren: true });
    if (!res.success) {
      flashStatus("import failed: " + (res.message || "unknown"), "bad");
      if (/unreachable|connect|refused|timeout/i.test(res.message || "")) {
        _kritaMarkUnreachable(res.message);
      }
      return;
    }

    const masks = res.masks || [];
    const skipped = res.skipped || [];
    const selectionPath = res.selection_path || "unknown";

    if (masks.length === 0) {
      const reason = skipped.length
        ? " (" + skipped.map(s => s.name + ": " + s.reason).join("; ") + ")"
        : "";
      flashStatus("no masks to import" + reason, "warn");
      _kritaMarkReachable();
      return;
    }

    let dimWarn = "";
    if (board.imageWidth && board.imageHeight) {
      const mism = masks.find(m =>
        m.width !== board.imageWidth || m.height !== board.imageHeight);
      if (mism) {
        dimWarn = " \u2014 mask '" + mism.name + "' is "
                  + mism.width + "\u00d7" + mism.height
                  + ", image is "
                  + board.imageWidth + "\u00d7" + board.imageHeight
                  + " (will scale)";
      }
    }

    const startIdx = board.masks.length;
    for (const m of masks) {
      addMaskFromB64(m.mask_b64);
    }
    board.selectedMaskIndices = masks.map((_, i) => startIdx + i);

    const skippedMsg = skipped.length
      ? " (" + skipped.length + " skipped)"
      : "";
    const multiMsg = (selectionPath === "active_only" && masks.length === 1)
      ? " (active layer only; multi-select unavailable)"
      : "";
    flashStatus(
      "imported " + masks.length + " mask(s)" + skippedMsg + multiMsg + dimWarn,
      dimWarn || multiMsg ? "warn" : "ok"
    );
    _kritaMarkReachable();

    syncMaskList();
    syncPanelFields();
    pgkitNotifyAll();
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  } catch (e) {
    flashStatus("import failed: " + e.message, "bad");
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Install buttons
   ============================================================ */

export function installPanelBindings() {
  const el = {};
  const ids = [
    "pickImageBtn", "clearImageBtn", "pickMaskBtn",
    "kritaImportMasksBtn",
    "kritaCheckBtn",
    "maskFromRectBtn",
    "refreshCanvasBtn",
    "syncNowBtn",
  ];
  for (const id of ids) el[id] = document.getElementById(id);

  if (el.pickImageBtn)   el.pickImageBtn.addEventListener("click", _pickImageAction);
  if (el.clearImageBtn)  el.clearImageBtn.addEventListener("click", _clearImageAction);
  if (el.pickMaskBtn)    el.pickMaskBtn.addEventListener("click", _pickMaskAction);
  if (el.kritaImportMasksBtn) el.kritaImportMasksBtn.addEventListener("click", _kritaImportMasksAction);
  if (el.kritaCheckBtn)  el.kritaCheckBtn.addEventListener("click", _kritaStatusRefresh);
  if (el.maskFromRectBtn) el.maskFromRectBtn.addEventListener("click", _maskFromRectAction);
  if (el.refreshCanvasBtn) el.refreshCanvasBtn.addEventListener("click", _refreshCanvasAction);
  if (el.syncNowBtn) el.syncNowBtn.addEventListener("click", syncNow);

  const statusEl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
  if (statusEl) {
    statusEl.style.cursor = "pointer";
    statusEl.title = "Click to re-check ComfyUI";
    statusEl.addEventListener("click", _checkStatusAction);
  }

  _installDropOverlay();
  let _dragDepth = 0;
  window.addEventListener("dragenter", () => {
    _dragDepth += 1;
    if (_dragDepth > 0) _showDropOverlay(true);
  });
  window.addEventListener("dragleave", () => {
    _dragDepth -= 1;
    if (_dragDepth <= 0) _showDropOverlay(false);
  });
  window.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => e.preventDefault());
  window.addEventListener("drop", (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    _dragDepth = 0;
    _showDropOverlay(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files
                 && e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file && file.type.startsWith("image/")) _handleDroppedFile(file);
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   Actions
   ============================================================ */

pgkitRegisterAction("action.clearImage", {
  label: "Clear image", scope: "global", run: _clearImageAction,
  meta: { variant: "plain" },
});
pgkitRegisterAction("action.refreshCanvas", {
  label: "Refresh @thecanvas", scope: "global", run: _refreshCanvasAction,
  meta: { variant: "plain",
          description: "Re-fetch the current @thecanvas from Krita." },
});
pgkitRegisterAction("action.syncNow", {
  label: "Sync now", scope: "global", run: syncNow,
  meta: { variant: "plain",
          description: "Re-push the current state into Krita scratch layers." },
});
pgkitRegisterAction("action.checkStatus", {
  label: "Check connection", scope: "global", run: _checkStatusAction,
  meta: { variant: "plain" },
});
pgkitRegisterAction("action.kritaCheck", {
  label: "Check Krita", scope: "global", run: _kritaStatusRefresh,
  meta: { variant: "plain" },
});
pgkitRegisterAction("action.kritaImportMasks", {
  label: "Import masks from Krita", scope: "global",
  run: _kritaImportMasksAction,
  meta: { variant: "plain" },
});
pgkitRegisterAction("action.maskFromRect", {
  label: "Mask from context rectangle", scope: "global",
  run: _maskFromRectAction,
  meta: { variant: "plain" },
});

/* ============================================================
   Masks level + row actions
   ============================================================ */

pgkitRegisterLevel("masks", {
  label: "Masks",
  items: () => board.masks.map((m, i) => ({
    name:  "mask." + i,
    label: "Mask " + (i + 1),
    extra: { size: m.w + "\u00d7" + m.h,
             selected: board.selectedMaskIndices.indexOf(i) >= 0 },
  })),
  selected: () => board.selectedMaskIndices.length > 0
    ? "mask." + board.selectedMaskIndices[0] : null,
  parent: () => null,
});

pgkitRegisterAction("action.selectMask", {
  label: "Select", scope: "row", level: "masks",
  appliesTo: () => true,
  run: (payload) => {
    const n = payload?.target?.name;
    if (typeof n !== "string" || !n.startsWith("mask.")) return;
    const idx = parseInt(n.slice(5), 10);
    if (!(idx >= 0 && idx < board.masks.length)) return;
    replaceMaskSelection(idx);
    syncMaskList();
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  },
  meta: { variant: "primary" },
});

pgkitRegisterAction("action.deleteMask", {
  label: "\u00d7", scope: "row", level: "masks",
  appliesTo: () => true,
  run: (payload) => {
    const n = payload?.target?.name;
    if (typeof n !== "string" || !n.startsWith("mask.")) return;
    const idx = parseInt(n.slice(5), 10);
    if (!(idx >= 0 && idx < board.masks.length)) return;
    board.masks.splice(idx, 1);
    const next = [];
    for (const i of board.selectedMaskIndices) {
      if (i < idx) next.push(i);
      else if (i > idx) next.push(i - 1);
    }
    board.selectedMaskIndices = next;
    if (board.hoveredMaskIdx === idx) board.hoveredMaskIdx = -1;
    else if (board.hoveredMaskIdx > idx) board.hoveredMaskIdx -= 1;
    syncMaskList();
    pgkitNotifyAll();
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  },
  meta: { variant: "danger" },
});

/* ============================================================
   pgkitHandleSelect
   ============================================================ */

export function pgkitHandleSelect(level, name) {
  if (typeof name !== "string") return false;
  if (level === "masks") {
    if (!name.startsWith("mask.")) return false;
    const idx = parseInt(name.slice(5), 10);
    if (!(idx >= 0 && idx < board.masks.length)) return false;
    replaceMaskSelection(idx);
    syncMaskList();
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

export function inpaintBootSync() {
  syncPanelFields();
  syncMaskList();
  pgkitNotifyAll();
  _checkStatusAction();
  _kritaStatusRefresh();
  (async () => {
    await _hydrateSharedSelection();
    if (board.imageHash) syncNow();
  })();
}

"""Per-frame panel sync: image info, mask count, mask-from-rect
enablement, context-rectangle checkbox and hint visibility, sync
status line.

Called once per frame from `pg_dispatch.draw()`.  Every DOM write is
guarded against the current DOM value so a steady-state frame touches
nothing.

The prompt field is gone.  The status line shows sync state instead of
inpaint state: `Synced HH:MM:SS · rotation N° · mask K/N · context on/off`,
or `Syncing…` / `Sync failed: …` / `No mask selected · workflow will
not inpaint`."""

PANEL_FIELDS_JS = r"""
import { board, view } from "./pg_state.js";
import { selectedMask, selectedMaskIdx } from "./pg_masks.js";

let _els = null;

function _get() {
  if (_els) return _els;
  _els = {
    imageInfo:       document.getElementById("imageInfo"),
    maskCount:       document.getElementById("maskCount"),
    statusLine:      document.getElementById("statusLine"),
    inpaintEnabled:  document.getElementById("inpaintEnabled"),
    inpaintRectHint: document.getElementById("inpaintRectHint"),
    syncNowBtn:      document.getElementById("syncNowBtn"),
    pickImageBtn:    document.getElementById("pickImageBtn"),
    clearImageBtn:   document.getElementById("clearImageBtn"),
    pickMaskBtn:     document.getElementById("pickMaskBtn"),
    kritaImportMasksBtn: document.getElementById("kritaImportMasksBtn"),
    maskFromRectBtn: document.getElementById("maskFromRectBtn"),
  };
  return _els;
}

function _fmtTime(ts) {
  try {
    return new Date(ts).toTimeString().slice(0, 8);
  } catch (_) {
    return "—";
  }
}

export function syncPanelFields() {
  const e = _get();

  if (e.imageInfo) {
    let text;
    if (!board.imageHash) {
      text = "No image loaded \u2014 drop one on the canvas";
    } else {
      text = board.imageWidth + " \u00d7 " + board.imageHeight
           + "   [" + board.imageHash.slice(0, 8) + "\u2026]";
    }
    if (e.imageInfo.textContent !== text) e.imageInfo.textContent = text;
  }

  if (e.maskCount) {
    const t = board.selectedMaskIndices.length
            + " / " + board.masks.length;
    if (e.maskCount.textContent !== t) e.maskCount.textContent = t;
  }

  if (e.inpaintEnabled && document.activeElement !== e.inpaintEnabled) {
    e.inpaintEnabled.checked = !!board.inpaintEnabled;
  }
  if (e.inpaintRectHint) {
    const want = board.inpaintEnabled ? "block" : "none";
    if (e.inpaintRectHint.style.display !== want) {
      e.inpaintRectHint.style.display = want;
    }
  }

  if (e.statusLine) {
    let text, cls = "";
    if (board.syncing) {
      text = "syncing\u2026"; cls = "ok";
    } else if (board.syncError) {
      text = "sync failed: " + board.syncError; cls = "bad";
    } else if (board.lastSync) {
      const maskLabel = board.selectedMaskIndices.length === 1
        ? String(board.selectedMaskIndices[0] + 1)
        : (board.selectedMaskIndices.length > 1
           ? board.selectedMaskIndices.length + " selected"
           : "none");
      const ctxLabel = board.inpaintEnabled ? "on" : "off";
      const rot = (view.rotation || 0).toFixed(1);
      text = "synced " + _fmtTime(board.lastSync)
           + " · rotation " + rot + "\u00b0"
           + " · mask " + maskLabel
           + " · context " + ctxLabel;
      cls = "ok";
    } else if (!board.imageHash) {
      text = "idle"; cls = "";
    } else if (board.selectedMaskIndices.length === 0) {
      text = "No mask selected · workflow will not inpaint"; cls = "warn";
    } else {
      text = "not yet synced"; cls = "warn";
    }
    if (e.statusLine.textContent !== text) e.statusLine.textContent = text;
    e.statusLine.className = cls;
  }

  const busy = board.syncing;

  // maskFromRectBtn: needs image, active rect, and checkbox on.
  const hasRect = !!(board.inpaintContext
                     && board.inpaintContext.w > 0
                     && board.inpaintContext.h > 0);
  if (e.maskFromRectBtn) {
    e.maskFromRectBtn.disabled =
      !board.imageHash || !board.inpaintEnabled || !hasRect || busy;
    if (!board.imageHash)          e.maskFromRectBtn.title = "Load an image first";
    else if (!board.inpaintEnabled) e.maskFromRectBtn.title = "Enable the context rectangle first";
    else if (!hasRect)              e.maskFromRectBtn.title = "Draw the context rectangle first";
    else                            e.maskFromRectBtn.title = "Create a new mask from the current context rectangle.";
  }

  if (e.pickImageBtn) e.pickImageBtn.disabled = busy;
  if (e.clearImageBtn) e.clearImageBtn.disabled = busy;
  if (e.pickMaskBtn) e.pickMaskBtn.disabled = busy;
  if (e.kritaImportMasksBtn) e.kritaImportMasksBtn.disabled = busy;
  if (e.syncNowBtn) e.syncNowBtn.disabled = busy;

  if (e.inpaintEnabled) e.inpaintEnabled.disabled = busy;
}

"""The mask list panel row renderer.

Rebuild-cache logic is unchanged from before: `syncMaskList` skips the
DOM rebuild when mask count, selection, and each mask's identity/
loaded/dims are unchanged.  That keeps `draw()` cheap on pan / hover /
zoom frames.

NEW: every mask-state mutation (row click for select, delete, ctrl/
shift-click modifiers) schedules a debounced sync so the pushed
`theselection` layer reflects the user's current selection."""

PANEL_LISTS_JS = r"""
import { board, maskColor } from "./pg_state.js";
import {
  isMaskSelected, toggleMaskSelection, addMaskToSelection,
  replaceMaskSelection,
} from "./pg_masks.js";
import { scheduleSync } from "./pg_sync.js";
import { pgkitNotifyEntities } from "./pgkit/remote_client.js";

/* ============================================================
   Rebuild cache
   ============================================================ */

let _lastMaskList = {
  count: -1,
  selection: null,
  entries: null,
};

function _maskListChanged() {
  const n = board.masks.length;
  const sel = board.selectedMaskIndices;

  if (_lastMaskList.count !== n) return true;
  if (_lastMaskList.selection === null) return true;
  if (_lastMaskList.selection.length !== sel.length) return true;
  for (let i = 0; i < sel.length; i++) {
    if (_lastMaskList.selection[i] !== sel[i]) return true;
  }

  if (_lastMaskList.entries === null) return true;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const m = board.masks[i];
    const c = _lastMaskList.entries[i];
    if (c === null) return true;
    if (c.entry !== m) return true;
    if (c.loaded !== (m.loaded ? 1 : 0)) return true;
    if (c.w !== m.w || c.h !== m.h) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function _cacheMaskList() {
  _lastMaskList = {
    count: board.masks.length,
    selection: board.selectedMaskIndices.slice(),
    entries: board.masks.map(m => ({
      entry: m,
      loaded: m.loaded ? 1 : 0,
      w: m.w,
      h: m.h,
    })),
  };
}

/* ============================================================
   Public API
   ============================================================ */

export function syncMaskList() {
  const list = document.getElementById("maskList");
  const count = document.getElementById("maskCount");
  if (!list) return;

  if (!_maskListChanged()) return;
  _cacheMaskList();

  list.innerHTML = "";
  if (count) {
    count.textContent =
      board.selectedMaskIndices.length + " / " + board.masks.length;
  }

  if (board.masks.length === 0) {
    const el = document.createElement("div");
    el.className = "empty";
    el.textContent = "no masks yet \u2014 import one below";
    list.appendChild(el);
    pgkitNotifyEntities();
    return;
  }

  for (let i = 0; i < board.masks.length; i++) {
    const m = board.masks[i];
    const isSel = isMaskSelected(i);
    const c = maskColor(i);

    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "maskRow" + (isSel ? " selected" : "");
    row.dataset.idx = String(i);
    if (isSel) {
      row.style.borderColor =
        "rgba(" + c.r + "," + c.g + "," + c.b + ", 0.85)";
      row.style.background =
        "rgba(" + c.r + "," + c.g + "," + c.b + ", 0.08)";
    }

    const sw = document.createElement("img");
    sw.className = "maskSwatch";
    sw.src = "data:image/png;base64," + m.b64;
    sw.alt = "";
    sw.style.borderColor = isSel
      ? "rgba(" + c.r + "," + c.g + "," + c.b + ", 1.0)"
      : "#34445a";
    row.appendChild(sw);

    const lb = document.createElement("span");
    lb.className = "maskLabel";
    lb.textContent = "Mask " + (i + 1);
    row.appendChild(lb);

    const meta = document.createElement("span");
    meta.className = "maskMeta";
    meta.textContent = m.w + "\u00d7" + m.h;
    row.appendChild(meta);

    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.className = "maskDel";
    del.textContent = "\u00d7";
    del.title = "Remove mask";
    del.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      board.masks.splice(i, 1);
      const next = [];
      for (const idx of board.selectedMaskIndices) {
        if (idx < i) next.push(idx);
        else if (idx > i) next.push(idx - 1);
      }
      board.selectedMaskIndices = next;
      if (board.hoveredMaskIdx === i) board.hoveredMaskIdx = -1;
      else if (board.hoveredMaskIdx > i) board.hoveredMaskIdx -= 1;
      syncMaskList();
      scheduleSync();
      import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(mm => mm.draw()).catch(() => {});
    });
    row.appendChild(del);

    row.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
      if (ev.ctrlKey || ev.metaKey)      toggleMaskSelection(i);
      else if (ev.shiftKey)              addMaskToSelection(i);
      else                                replaceMaskSelection(i);
      syncMaskList();
      scheduleSync();
      import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(mm => mm.draw()).catch(() => {});
    });

    list.appendChild(row);
  }

  pgkitNotifyEntities();
}
"""

"""Panel field wiring: the context-rectangle checkbox, the view-rotation
scrub input, and field registrations.

VIEW ROTATION — SCRUB INPUT
===========================
Same as before: one text field that behaves as both numeric input
(click to focus, type an angle) and scrub control (press and drag).
Drag rounds to whole degrees; typed input keeps decimals.

NEW: every rotation change schedules an *immediate* sync (bypassing the
debounce).  Rotation is a scalar field on the sync payload — the daemon
queries it back via `/rotation` on demand, so keeping it fresh is
cheap.  Immediate means a rotate-then-Run sequence has no measurable
stale window.

CONTEXT RECTANGLE CHECKBOX
==========================
Turning it on schedules a debounced sync (the pushed `thecontext`
changes from "untouched" to "white rect at user rect").  Turning it off
schedules a debounced sync that pushes all-white once — the ON→OFF
transition.  Further syncs while off do not touch `thecontext`; the
daemon reads that layer's own bbox or falls back to the whole canvas."""

PANEL_SCRUBS_JS = r"""
import { board, view, _applyRotation } from "./pg_state.js";
import { ensureDefaultContext } from "./pg_inpaint.js";
import { _installScrubInput } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";
import { scheduleSync, syncNow } from "./pg_sync.js";
import {
  pgkitRegisterField, pgkitNotifyLocal,
} from "./pgkit/remote_client.js";

/* ============================================================
   Context rectangle checkbox
   ============================================================ */

const inpaintEnabledEl = document.getElementById("inpaintEnabled");
if (inpaintEnabledEl) {
  inpaintEnabledEl.checked = !!board.inpaintEnabled;
  inpaintEnabledEl.addEventListener("change", () => {
    board.inpaintEnabled = !!inpaintEnabledEl.checked;
    if (board.inpaintEnabled) ensureDefaultContext();
    pgkitNotifyLocal("inpaint.enabled");
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  });
}

/* ============================================================
   Field registrations
   ============================================================ */

pgkitRegisterField("inpaint.enabled", {
  get: () => !!board.inpaintEnabled,
  set: (v) => {
    board.inpaintEnabled = !!v;
    const el = document.getElementById("inpaintEnabled");
    if (el && document.activeElement !== el) el.checked = board.inpaintEnabled;
    if (board.inpaintEnabled) ensureDefaultContext();
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  },
  meta: { kind: "bool", label: "Context rectangle" },
});

pgkitRegisterField("masks.selectedIndex", {
  get: () => board.selectedMaskIndices.length > 0
    ? board.selectedMaskIndices[0] : -1,
  set: (v) => {
    const n = parseInt(v, 10);
    if (!isFinite(n)) return;
    if (n < 0 || n >= board.masks.length) {
      import("./pg_masks.js").then(m => m.clearMaskSelection()).catch(() => {});
    } else {
      import("./pg_masks.js").then(m => m.replaceMaskSelection(n)).catch(() => {});
    }
    scheduleSync();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});

  meta: { kind: "number", label: "First selected mask" },
});

/* ============================================================
   View rotation
   ============================================================ */

const rotationEl = document.getElementById("viewRotation");

function _syncRotationWidget() {
  if (!rotationEl) return;
  if (document.activeElement === rotationEl) return;
  const rounded = Math.round((view.rotation || 0) * 10) / 10;
  const target = String(rounded);
  if (rotationEl.value !== target) rotationEl.value = target;
}

if (rotationEl) {
  rotationEl.value = String(Math.round((view.rotation || 0) * 10) / 10);
  _installScrubInput(rotationEl, {
    rate: 0.5,
    snapStep: 15,
    read: () => view.rotation || 0,
    write: (raw, drag) => {
      const v = parseFloat(raw);
      if (!isFinite(v)) return;

      const isDrag = !!drag;
      const value = isDrag ? Math.round(v) : v;

      let wrapped = value % 360;
      if (wrapped < 0) wrapped += 360;
      view.rotation = wrapped;

      if (document.activeElement !== rotationEl) {
        const displayed = isDrag
          ? Math.round(wrapped)
          : Math.round(wrapped * 10) / 10;
        rotationEl.value = String(displayed);
      }

      pgkitNotifyLocal("view.rotation");
      // Rotation → immediate sync.  Debounce would be visible here:
      // rotate-then-Run within 250 ms would race the daemon's
      // /rotation query.
      syncNow();
    },
  });
}

pgkitRegisterField("view.rotation", {
  get: () => view.rotation || 0,
  set: (v) => {
    const n = parseFloat(v);
    if (!isFinite(n)) return;
    _applyRotation(n);
    _syncRotationWidget();
    syncNow();
    import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
  },
  meta: { kind: "number", label: "Rotation (deg)", min: 0, max: 360 },
});

pgkitRegisterField("status.syncing", {
  get: () => !!board.syncing,
  set: () => {},
  meta: {
    kind: "bool",
    label: "Syncing",
    visible: false,
  },
});

"""Mask pixel access, hit test, bbox computation.

Pure queries over the mask image already loaded in the browser.  No
user-visible state is mutated, so no redraw hook is scheduled — the
callers (`pg_comfy_client`, `pg_dispatch`) already run inside a
`requestAnimationFrame` when they care about the visual."""

PIXELS_JS = r"""
import { board } from "./pg_state.js";
import { BBOX_PAD, BBOX_MIN_SIZE, POINT_BBOX_PAD } from "./pg_tuning.js";

/* ============================================================
   Pixel data
   ============================================================ */

function _maskPixelData(mask) {
  if (mask._pixels) return mask._pixels;
  const src = mask.rotatedCanvas || mask.img;
  if (!src) return null;
  const sw = mask.rotatedCanvas ? mask.rotatedW : mask.w;
  const sh = mask.rotatedCanvas ? mask.rotatedH : mask.h;
  if (!sw || !sh) return null;
  const off = document.createElement("canvas");
  off.width = sw;
  off.height = sh;
  const octx = off.getContext("2d");
  octx.drawImage(src, 0, 0);
  try {
    mask._pixels = octx.getImageData(0, 0, sw, sh).data;
    return mask._pixels;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

export function maskPixelData(mask) {
  return _maskPixelData(mask);
}

/* ============================================================
   Hit test
   ============================================================ */

/* Hit test a mask at a point given in image coordinates. Scales the
   point into the mask's own pixel grid so imported masks whose
   dimensions differ from the playground image still hit-test
   correctly. When m.img dimensions match board.image dimensions
   (the common case for Segment All masks) the scale factor is 1.0
   and the arithmetic reduces to the direct lookup it always was. */
export function hitTestMaskAtPoint(ix, iy) {
  if (ix < 0 || iy < 0) return -1;
  const imgW = board.imageWidth  || 1;
  const imgH = board.imageHeight || 1;
  for (let i = board.masks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const m = board.masks[i];
    if (!m || !m.loaded) continue;
    const src = m.rotatedCanvas || m.img;
    const srcW = m.rotatedCanvas ? m.rotatedW : m.w;
    const srcH = m.rotatedCanvas ? m.rotatedH : m.h;
    if (!src || !srcW || !srcH) continue;
    const mx = Math.floor(ix * srcW / imgW);
    const my = Math.floor(iy * srcH / imgH);
    if (mx < 0 || my < 0 || mx >= srcW || my >= srcH) continue;
    const px = _maskPixelData(m);
    if (!px) continue;
    const off = (my * srcW + mx) * 4;
    if (px[off] >= 128) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

/* ============================================================
   Bounding boxes
   ============================================================ */

export function computeMaskBBox(idx) {
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= board.masks.length) return null;
  const m = board.masks[idx];
  if (!m || !m.loaded) return null;
  if (m._bbox) return m._bbox;

  const px = _maskPixelData(m);
  if (!px) return null;

  const W = m.rotatedCanvas ? m.rotatedW : m.w;
  const H = m.rotatedCanvas ? m.rotatedH : m.h;
  let minX = W, minY = H, maxX = -1, maxY = -1;
  for (let y = 0; y < H; y++) {
    const rowBase = y * W * 4;
    for (let x = 0; x < W; x++) {
      if (px[rowBase + x * 4] >= 128) {
        if (x < minX) minX = x;
        if (y < minY) minY = y;
        if (x > maxX) maxX = x;
        if (y > maxY) maxY = y;
      }
    }
  }
  if (maxX < minX || maxY < minY) { m._bbox = null; return null; }

  minX = Math.max(0, minX - BBOX_PAD);
  minY = Math.max(0, minY - BBOX_PAD);
  maxX = Math.min(W - 1, maxX + BBOX_PAD);
  maxY = Math.min(H - 1, maxY + BBOX_PAD);

  const sx = board.imageWidth  / W;
  const sy = board.imageHeight / H;

  let bx = Math.round(minX * sx);
  let by = Math.round(minY * sy);
  let bw = Math.round((maxX - minX + 1) * sx);
  let bh = Math.round((maxY - minY + 1) * sy);

  if (bw < BBOX_MIN_SIZE) { bx -= Math.ceil((BBOX_MIN_SIZE - bw) / 2); bw = BBOX_MIN_SIZE; }
  if (bh < BBOX_MIN_SIZE) { by -= Math.ceil((BBOX_MIN_SIZE - bh) / 2); bh = BBOX_MIN_SIZE; }

  bx = Math.max(0, Math.min(board.imageWidth  - 1, bx));
  by = Math.max(0, Math.min(board.imageHeight - 1, by));
  bw = Math.max(1, Math.min(board.imageWidth  - bx, bw));
  bh = Math.max(1, Math.min(board.imageHeight - by, bh));

  m._bbox = { x: bx, y: by, w: bw, h: bh };
  return m._bbox;
}

export function computeEffectiveBBox(idx) {
  const bbox = computeMaskBBox(idx);
  const m = idx >= 0 ? board.masks[idx] : null;
  if (!m) return bbox;
  if (!bbox && m.points.length === 0) return null;

  let minX = bbox ? bbox.x : Infinity;
  let minY = bbox ? bbox.y : Infinity;
  let maxX = bbox ? bbox.x + bbox.w : -Infinity;
  let maxY = bbox ? bbox.y + bbox.h : -Infinity;

  for (const p of m.points) {
    if (!p.isPositive) continue;
    if (p.x - POINT_BBOX_PAD < minX) minX = p.x - POINT_BBOX_PAD;
    if (p.y - POINT_BBOX_PAD < minY) minY = p.y - POINT_BBOX_PAD;
    if (p.x + POINT_BBOX_PAD > maxX) maxX = p.x + POINT_BBOX_PAD;
    if (p.y + POINT_BBOX_PAD > maxY) maxY = p.y + POINT_BBOX_PAD;
  }

  if (!isFinite(minX) || !isFinite(minY)) return null;

  minX = Math.max(0, minX);
  minY = Math.max(0, minY);
  maxX = Math.min(board.imageWidth, maxX);
  maxY = Math.min(board.imageHeight, maxY);

  return {
    x: Math.round(minX),
    y: Math.round(minY),
    w: Math.round(maxX - minX),
    h: Math.round(maxY - minY),
  };
}
"""
```

"""Mutable state, canvas handles, view transforms, draw hook, mask
palette.

Leaf module: imports nothing from the project beyond `pg_tuning.js`.
Every other project module imports from here, and nothing here imports
from the project's feature modules.  That is what lets the graph stay
acyclic.

`board` carries every piece of user-visible state.

`setImage` and `clearImage` inline their board-resetting logic (mask
array, inpaint context rectangle) rather than importing
`pg_masks.clearMasks`.  That preserves this module as a leaf.

`applyCanvasImage` is the autosync target: updates the displayed
image without clearing masks or the inpaint context rect (unless
image dimensions changed).  Used by `pg_autosync.js` when the
daemon's `@thecanvas` spec changes, and by the manual refresh action.

The `lastSync`, `syncing`, and `syncError` fields are set by
`pg_sync.js` — they drive the panel's status line and nothing else.

TWO CANVASES
============
The render surface is split into two stacked canvases:

    #c              image layer: dark fill, image, mask tints
                    (under the rotation transform)
    #overlayCanvas  UI layer: context rect, chrome text, empty-state
                    text (no rotation transform; transparent
                    background; pointer-events:none so all mouse
                    events still land on #c)

The overlay is created and appended here at module load.  Its CSS
(`background:transparent`, `position:absolute; top:0; left:0`,
`pointer-events:none`) is in `pg_base.py`.

The point of the split is that the two layers' input sets are
mostly disjoint:

    image layer reads: board.imageEl/Hash/W/H, view.zoom/panX/panY/
                       rotation, board.masks + selection + hover
    UI  layer reads:   view.zoom/panX/panY, board.imageEl/Hash/W/H,
                       board.inpaintEnabled, board.inpaintContext.*,
                       board.masks.length, board.selectedMaskIndices.length

`view.rotation` is only in the image-layer input set.  Rotating
therefore repaints the image layer only — the context rect and
chrome text never repaint on rotation, which is exactly the property
the previous single-canvas `drawView()` could not exploit.
`board.inpaintContext.*` and `board.hoveredMaskIdx` similarly
belong to disjoint layers, so dragging the context rect or moving
across a mask boundary repaints exactly one canvas.

`pg_view.py` computes a content signature of each layer's input
set per `drawView()` call and repaints a layer only when its sig
changed.  The sig caches live in `_layerSigs`, exported from here so
`resize()` can invalidate them (`canvas.width = …` clears the pixel
buffer regardless of whether the sig would have changed).

MASKS VERSION
=============
`_masksVersion` is a monotonic counter, bumped by `pg_masks.js`
whenever a mask entry's visible contribution changes without any
other sig input changing:

    · a mask's `img.onload` — `loaded` flips false→true, w/h become
      real values.  The mask's pixel data enters the draw for the
      first time.  `board.masks.length` was already 1 before this
      event; no other sig input moves.
    · `setMasks(b64List)` at constant length — entry *identity*
      changes (new Image objects), but `masks.length` and
      `selectedMaskIndices` are unchanged.
    · `replaceMaskAt(idx, b64)` — same.
    · `applyCanvasImage` / `setImage` / `clearImage` invalidate
      `_pixels`/`_tinted` caches on every mask; the tint must be
      rebuilt from the same underlying bytes but against the (new)
      image frame.

It is exported here so `pg_view.py` can include it in the image
sig, and so `pg_state.js`'s own `setImage` / `clearImage` /
`applyCanvasImage` can bump it inline (they mutate `board.masks` or
its caches directly and cannot import `pg_masks.js` without
inverting the leaf-module dependency).

`fittedImageRect()` is memoized on the tuple of inputs that fully
determine its result: `(innerWidth, innerHeight, imageWidth,
imageHeight, zoom, panX, panY)`.  The function runs 2–4 times per
`mousemove` frame (once explicitly in `pg_dispatch`, once inside
`screenToImage`, once inside `screenToImageUnrotated`, once inside
`drawView`), and each call recomputes two divisions, `Math.min`,
six multiplies, and allocates a fresh object.  The cache turns all
but the first into a string compare.

Cache miss allocation cost is unchanged; cache hit is one string
compare plus a field read.  Callers must treat the returned object
as read-only — none of them mutate it, verified across
`pg_view.py`, `pg_view_image.py`, `pg_view_inpaint.py`,
`pg_dispatch.py`, `pg_inpaint.py`."""

STATE_JS = r"""
import {
  VIEW_ZOOM_MIN, VIEW_ZOOM_MAX, VIEW_PAN_MARGIN,
} from "./pg_tuning.js";

/* ============================================================
   Canvas and 2D contexts
   ============================================================
   #c              image layer  (bottom, dark background)
   #overlayCanvas  UI layer     (top, transparent, pointer-events:none)
   ============================================================ */

export const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
export const ctx    = canvas.getContext("2d");

export const overlayCanvas = document.createElement("canvas");
overlayCanvas.id = "overlayCanvas";
document.body.appendChild(overlayCanvas);
export const overlayCtx = overlayCanvas.getContext("2d");

let _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

/* ============================================================
   Draw-sig caches, shared between pg_view.js (writer) and resize()
   (invalidator).  Kept here rather than in pg_view.js so resize()
   can clear them without importing pg_view.js (which imports this
   module — a cycle).
   ============================================================ */

export const _layerSigs = { image: null, overlay: null };

/* ============================================================
   Masks version — see the module docstring, MASKS VERSION.
   ============================================================ */

export let _masksVersion = 0;
export function _bumpMasksVersion() { _masksVersion++; }

/* ============================================================
   View (zoom + pan + rotation)
   ============================================================
   `view.rotation` is a *display-only* angle.  `board.imageWidth`,
   `board.imageHeight`, `board.imageDataUrl`, and `board.imageEl`
   are always the ORIGINAL un-rotated source.  Rotation is applied
   as a 2D canvas transform at draw time (in `pg_view_image.js`),
   not by pre-rendering a rotated copy.

   The inpaint workflow's rotated behavior is produced daemon-side:
   `pg_sync.js` pushes the un-rotated state into Krita scratch layers
   and separately pushes the rotation value; the daemon queries the
   rotation value on demand and, when θ≠0, rotates the canvas and
   selection and defines the context mask as a translated axis-aligned
   rect before submitting to ComfyUI.

   `board.inpaintContext` lives in original-image pixel coords.
   Because the image never moves in that frame, the user's rect
   stays over the same pixels no matter what the rotation is.
   Rotating the view visually rotates the image (which is drawn under
   the rotation transform); the rect is drawn on the overlay layer
   WITHOUT the rotation transform and therefore stays put on screen.
   Its `x/y/w/h` never change except when the user drags a handle in
   `pg_dispatch.js`.  `_applyRotation` is not allowed to touch it.
   ============================================================ */

export const view = {
  zoom: 1,
  panX: 0,
  panY: 0,
  rotation: 0,   // degrees; clockwise on screen
};

export function resetView() {
  view.zoom = 1;
  view.panX = 0;
  view.panY = 0;
}

export function clampPan() {
  if (!board.imageWidth || !board.imageHeight) return;
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  const pad = 40;
  const sx = (cw - 2 * pad) / board.imageWidth;
  const sy = (ch - 2 * pad) / board.imageHeight;
  const baseS = Math.min(sx, sy);
  const s = baseS * view.zoom;

  // Pan clamp uses the ROTATED bounding box, so at non-cardinal
  // angles the user can still pan far enough to see the corners.
  const rad = view.rotation * Math.PI / 180;
  const cos = Math.abs(Math.cos(rad));
  const sin = Math.abs(Math.sin(rad));
  const bw = (board.imageWidth  * cos + board.imageHeight * sin) * s;
  const bh = (board.imageWidth  * sin + board.imageHeight * cos) * s;
  const baseX = (cw - bw) / 2;
  const baseY = (ch - bh) / 2;
  const m = VIEW_PAN_MARGIN;

  const minPanX = m - baseX - bw;
  const maxPanX = cw - m - baseX;
  view.panX = Math.max(minPanX, Math.min(maxPanX, view.panX));

  const minPanY = m - baseY - bh;
  const maxPanY = ch - m - baseY;
  view.panY = Math.max(minPanY, Math.min(maxPanY, view.panY));
}

/* Zoom around the cursor, rotation-safe.  We remember the image
   point under the cursor, change the zoom, then adjust pan so
   the same image point returns to the same screen point. */
export function zoomAt(screenX, screenY, newZoom) {
  const [ix0, iy0] = screenToImage(screenX, screenY);
  view.zoom = Math.max(VIEW_ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(VIEW_ZOOM_MAX, newZoom));
  const [sx1, sy1] = imageToScreen(ix0, iy0);
  view.panX += screenX - sx1;
  view.panY += screenY - sy1;
  clampPan();
}

/* ============================================================
   Rotation
   ============================================================
   `_applyRotation` only sets the display angle.  It does not
   re-render the image, does not touch `board.imageWidth/Height`,
   does not touch `board.inpaintContext`, and does not re-rotate
   mask pixel caches.

   `_rotateImage` is retained as a helper for tests.  `_rotateMask`
   invalidates only the stale rotated-canvas cache; mask pixel data
   always lives in the original image frame.
   ============================================================ */

export function _applyRotation(angle) {
  view.rotation = ((Number(angle) || 0) % 360 + 360) % 360;
  clampPan();
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function _rotateImage(img, angleDeg) {
  if (!img) return null;
  const W = img.naturalWidth || img.width;
  const H = img.naturalHeight || img.height;
  if (!W || !H) return null;

  const rad = (angleDeg % 360) * Math.PI / 180;
  const cos = Math.abs(Math.cos(rad));
  const sin = Math.abs(Math.sin(rad));
  const newW = Math.max(1, Math.round(W * cos + H * sin));
  const newH = Math.max(1, Math.round(W * sin + H * cos));

  const c = document.createElement("canvas");
  c.width = newW;
  c.height = newH;
  const cx = c.getContext("2d");
  cx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  cx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
  cx.translate(newW / 2, newH / 2);
  cx.rotate(rad);
  cx.drawImage(img, -W / 2, -H / 2);
  return c;
}

export function _rotateMask(entry, angle) {
  // Invalidate the rotated-canvas cache.  Mask pixel data always
  // reads `mask.img` in the original image frame.
  entry.rotatedCanvas = null;
  entry.rotatedW = entry.w || 0;
  entry.rotatedH = entry.h || 0;
}

/* ============================================================
   Image loading / clearing
   ============================================================ */

export function setImage(hash, dataUrl, width, height) {
  board.imageHash     = hash;
  board.originalDataUrl = dataUrl;
  board.originalWidth   = width;
  board.originalHeight  = height;
  board.originalImageEl = null;

  board.imageEl      = null;
  board.imageWidth   = 0;
  board.imageHeight  = 0;
  board.imageDataUrl = null;

  board.masks = [];
  board.selectedMaskIndices = [];
  board.hoveredMaskIdx = -1;
  board.inpaintContext = {
    x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0, activeHandle: null,
  };
  _bumpMasksVersion();
  resetView();

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => {
    board.originalImageEl = img;
    board.originalWidth   = img.naturalWidth;
    board.originalHeight  = img.naturalHeight;
    board.imageEl         = img;
    board.imageWidth      = img.naturalWidth;
    board.imageHeight     = img.naturalHeight;
    board.imageDataUrl    = dataUrl;
    _applyRotation(view.rotation);
  };
  img.onerror = () => {
    board.originalImageEl = null;
    _scheduleDraw();
  };
  img.src = dataUrl;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   applyCanvasImage — autosync / manual-refresh target
   ============================================================
   Swap the displayed image in response to a `@thecanvas` resource
   spec change or a manual refresh.  Unlike `setImage`, this:

     * keeps the mask stack (invalidating only their pixel caches so
       the tinted overlays rebuild);
     * keeps the inpaint context rectangle IF the new image has the
       same dimensions, else clears it;
     * keeps view.rotation, view.zoom, view.panX/Y.

   Used by `pg_autosync.js` and by the panel's "Refresh @thecanvas"
   button in `pg_panel_bindings.js`. */
export function applyCanvasImage(hash, dataUrl, width, height) {
  const oldW = board.imageWidth;
  const oldH = board.imageHeight;
  const dimsMatch = (oldW === 0 || oldH === 0
                     || (width === oldW && height === oldH));

  board.imageHash       = hash;
  board.originalDataUrl = dataUrl;
  board.originalWidth   = width;
  board.originalHeight  = height;

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => {
    board.originalImageEl = img;
    board.originalWidth   = img.naturalWidth;
    board.originalHeight  = img.naturalHeight;
    board.imageEl         = img;
    board.imageWidth      = img.naturalWidth;
    board.imageHeight     = img.naturalHeight;
    board.imageDataUrl    = dataUrl;

    for (const m of board.masks) {
      m._pixels = null;
      m._bbox = null;
      m._tinted = null;
      m._tintedKey = null;
    }
    _bumpMasksVersion();

    if (!dimsMatch) {
      board.inpaintContext = {
        x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0, activeHandle: null,
      };
    }

    _scheduleDraw();
  };
  img.onerror = () => _scheduleDraw();
  img.src = dataUrl;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function clearImage() {
  board.imageHash     = null;
  board.originalDataUrl = null;
  board.originalWidth   = 0;
  board.originalHeight  = 0;
  board.originalImageEl = null;

  board.imageEl      = null;
  board.imageWidth   = 0;
  board.imageHeight  = 0;
  board.imageDataUrl = null;

  view.rotation = 0;
  resetView();
  board.masks = [];
  board.selectedMaskIndices = [];
  board.hoveredMaskIdx = -1;
  board.inpaintContext = {
    x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0, activeHandle: null,
  };
  _bumpMasksVersion();
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Mask palette
   ============================================================ */

export const MASK_COLORS = [
  { r: 255, g:  90, b: 105 },
  { r: 120, g: 220, b: 255 },
  { r: 255, g: 200, b:  90 },
  { r: 140, g: 225, b: 160 },
  { r: 180, g: 155, b: 255 },
  { r: 255, g: 165, b: 105 },
  { r: 110, g: 220, b: 210 },
  { r: 220, g: 230, b: 120 },
];

export function maskColor(idx) {
  return MASK_COLORS[((idx % MASK_COLORS.length)
                      + MASK_COLORS.length) % MASK_COLORS.length];
}

/* ============================================================
   The board
   ============================================================ */

export const board = {
  imageHash:     null,
  imageWidth:    0,
  imageHeight:   0,
  imageDataUrl:  null,
  imageEl:       null,

  originalImageEl:  null,
  originalWidth:    0,
  originalHeight:   0,
  originalDataUrl:  null,

  mouse: { x: 0, y: 0, inside: false },

  masks:               [],
  selectedMaskIndices: [],
  hoveredMaskIdx:      -1,

  // Sync state, set by pg_sync.js.  Purely panel-facing.
  lastSync:  null,
  syncing:   false,
  syncError: null,

  inpaintEnabled: false,
  inpaintContext: {
    x: 0, y: 0, w: 0, h: 0,
    activeHandle: null,
  },
};

/* ============================================================
   Image-fit rect — the axis-aligned screen rect the ORIGINAL,
   un-rotated image occupies.  Rotation is applied on top of this
   by the image layer; the rect itself never changes with rotation.

   MEMOIZED on the input tuple.  See the module docstring for the
   rationale.  Callers must not mutate the returned object.
   ============================================================ */

let _firCacheKey = null;
let _firCacheVal = null;

export function fittedImageRect() {
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  if (!board.imageWidth || !board.imageHeight) return null;

  const key = cw + "," + ch + ","
            + board.imageWidth + "," + board.imageHeight + ","
            + view.zoom + "," + view.panX + "," + view.panY;
  if (key === _firCacheKey) return _firCacheVal;

  const pad = 40;
  const sx = (cw - 2 * pad) / board.imageWidth;
  const sy = (ch - 2 * pad) / board.imageHeight;
  const baseS = Math.min(sx, sy);
  const s = baseS * view.zoom;
  const w = board.imageWidth  * s;
  const h = board.imageHeight * s;
  const x0 = (cw - w) / 2 + view.panX;
  const y0 = (ch - h) / 2 + view.panY;

  const val = { x0, y0, w, h, s };
  _firCacheKey = key;
  _firCacheVal = val;
  return val;
}

/* Image → screen.  Rotation is around the image center.  Positive
   angle follows `ctx.rotate` — clockwise in screen (y-down) coords. */
export function imageToScreen(x, y) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [x, y];
  const cx = r.x0 + r.w / 2;
  const cy = r.y0 + r.h / 2;
  const dx = (x - board.imageWidth  / 2) * r.s;
  const dy = (y - board.imageHeight / 2) * r.s;
  const rad = view.rotation * Math.PI / 180;
  const cos = Math.cos(rad);
  const sin = Math.sin(rad);
  const rx = dx * cos - dy * sin;
  const ry = dx * sin + dy * cos;
  return [cx + rx, cy + ry];
}

/* Screen → image.  Inverse of `imageToScreen`. */
export function screenToImage(sx, sy) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [0, 0];
  const cx = r.x0 + r.w / 2;
  const cy = r.y0 + r.h / 2;
  const dx = sx - cx;
  const dy = sy - cy;
  const rad = view.rotation * Math.PI / 180;
  const cos = Math.cos(rad);
  const sin = Math.sin(rad);
  const rx =  dx * cos + dy * sin;
  const ry = -dx * sin + dy * cos;
  return [board.imageWidth  / 2 + rx / r.s,
          board.imageHeight / 2 + ry / r.s];
}

/* Screen -> image, WITHOUT rotation.  Use this for anything anchored
   to the un-rotated fit rect — notably the inpaint context rectangle,
   whose position is fixed on screen even while the image rotates
   underneath it. */
export function screenToImageUnrotated(sx, sy) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [0, 0];
  return [(sx - r.x0) / r.s, (sy - r.y0) / r.s];
}

/* ============================================================
   Draw scheduling
   ============================================================ */

let _drawScheduled = false;
let _drawFn = null;

export function _setDraw(fn) { _drawFn = fn; }

export function _scheduleDraw() {
  if (_drawScheduled) return;
  _drawScheduled = true;
  if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === "function") {
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      _drawScheduled = false;
      if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
    });
  } else {
    setTimeout(() => {
      _drawScheduled = false;
      if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
    }, 16);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Resize — sizes BOTH canvases and clears the sig caches.
   Setting `canvas.width` clears the pixel buffer regardless of
   whether the sig would have changed (redundant resize at identical
   dims), so the sigs MUST be reset here, unconditionally.
   ============================================================ */

export function resize() {
  _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;

  canvas.width  = Math.round(cw * _dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(ch * _dpr);
  canvas.style.width  = cw + "px";
  canvas.style.height = ch + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(_dpr, 0, 0, _dpr, 0, 0);

  overlayCanvas.width  = Math.round(cw * _dpr);
  overlayCanvas.height = Math.round(ch * _dpr);
  overlayCanvas.style.width  = cw + "px";
  overlayCanvas.style.height = ch + "px";
  overlayCtx.setTransform(_dpr, 0, 0, _dpr, 0, 0);

  _layerSigs.image = null;
  _layerSigs.overlay = null;

  clampPan();
  if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
"""
```

```python
"""State synchronizer.

Pushes the playground's current state into the daemon so the docker's
Run button can find it.  Two things travel:

  · pixel blobs — the canvas and the selected mask — pushed into the
    Krita scratch layers `thecanvas` and `theselection` via
    `comfy_set_layer_pixels`.  The daemon reads them from Krita at
    prepare time, same as any other `source="layer"` resource.

  · scalar state — the view rotation and the context rectangle — as
    fields on the `/sync` payload.  The daemon queries them back via
    `/rotation` and `/context` on demand.  No Krita layer is written
    for the context rectangle; the daemon defines `@thecontext` at
    prepare time from these numbers, accounting for rotation.

Rotation is not part of the pixel push.  It travels as a scalar, and
the daemon queries it at prepare and at paste time.  The value's
lifetime is scoped to the playground process: kill the server and the
daemon's `/rotation` call fails, falls back to 0, and no rotation
happens.

Same for the context rect: no `@thecontext` layer is created.  The
daemon queries `/context` at prepare time; if `enabled`, it uses those
coords (rotated, translated into the crop frame) as the context mask;
if not, it falls back to the `@thecontext` layer's own bbox (if any)
or the whole canvas.

Sync cadence:

  · State changes (image load, mask select/deselect, mask add/delete,
    context checkbox toggle, context rect drag) → `scheduleSync()`,
    debounced to `SYNC_DEBOUNCE_MS`.

  · Rotation changes → `syncNow()`, immediate.

Change detection: each piece of payload is hashed before push and
skipped if unchanged.  This keeps a mask-select from re-pushing the
whole canvas, and keeps a rotation-only change from re-pushing
anything.

FAILURE MIRRORING
=================
`/sync` failures are shown persistently in `#statusLine` (via
`board.syncError`, written by `pg_panel_fields.js`).  They are ALSO
mirrored to the playground server's stdout through
`pgkit/panel_core.js`'s `flashStatus` → `./__log` path, but only on
the *transition* from "sync working" to "sync broken":

    · first failure after a success  → one `flashStatus(..., "bad")`
                                       line (transient `#status` popup
                                       + one stdout line)
    · subsequent failures            → silent on stdout (`#statusLine`
                                       still updates the persistent
                                       message in case the reason
                                       changed)
    · success                        → clears the warn-streak flag, so
                                       the next failure warns again

This mirrors autosync's failure handling in `pg_autosync.js`: same
"warn once per streak" cadence, same reset-on-success contract.  The
difference is class: autosync's pull failures are `"warn"` (display
may be stale, everything else works); sync's push failures are
`"bad"` (docker's next Run will operate on stale state).  A
`"warn"` mirror is silenced by `?pgkit_no_mirror_warn=1`; a `"bad"`
one is not — deliberate, because a broken push path is a functional
problem the operator should see.

The class choice also matches interceptor's `_runAction` /
`_discardAction` failures, which use `flashStatus(..., "bad")` for
resume failures.  The two playgrounds now agree on "hard failure →
bad, soft failure → warn"."""

SYNC_JS = r"""
import { board, view } from "./pg_state.js";
import { selectedMaskIdx } from "./pg_masks.js";
import { SYNC_DEBOUNCE_MS } from "./pg_tuning.js";
import { flashStatus } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";

let _timer            = null;
let _lastCanvasHash   = "";
let _lastSelectionB64 = "";
let _lastContextHash  = "";
let _lastRotation     = null;
/* Warn-streak flag for /sync failures.  False after a success,
   set true on the first failure, kept true across subsequent
   failures.  Flipping back to false on success is what lets the
   *next* failure warn again.  See the module docstring,
   FAILURE MIRRORING. */
let _warnedSyncFailure = false;

function _stripDataUrl(b64) {
  return String(b64 || "").replace(/^data:image\/png;base64,/, "");
}

export function scheduleSync() {
  if (_timer) clearTimeout(_timer);
  _timer = setTimeout(_doSync, SYNC_DEBOUNCE_MS);
}

export function syncNow() {
  if (_timer) { clearTimeout(_timer); _timer = null; }
  _doSync();
}

async function _doSync() {
  _timer = null;

  const rotation = board.imageHash ? (view.rotation || 0) : 0;
  const payload  = { rotation };
  let changed = false;

  if (board.imageHash
      && board.imageDataUrl
      && board.imageHash !== _lastCanvasHash) {
    payload.canvas_b64 = _stripDataUrl(board.imageDataUrl);
    _lastCanvasHash = board.imageHash;
    changed = true;
  }

  if (board.imageWidth > 0) {
    const idx = selectedMaskIdx();
    if (idx >= 0) {
      const m = board.masks[idx];
      if (m && m.loaded && m.b64 && m.b64 !== _lastSelectionB64) {
        payload.selection_b64 = m.b64;
        _lastSelectionB64 = m.b64;
        changed = true;
      }
    }
  }

  // Context rect: scalar fields only.  No Krita layer is written.
  // The daemon queries `/context` at inpaint time to build the actual
  // mask in the frame it needs.
  const ctxEnabled = !!board.inpaintEnabled && board.imageWidth > 0;
  const cx = Math.round(board.inpaintContext.x || 0);
  const cy = Math.round(board.inpaintContext.y || 0);
  const cw = Math.round(board.inpaintContext.w || 0);
  const ch = Math.round(board.inpaintContext.h || 0);
  payload.context_enabled = ctxEnabled;
  payload.context_x = cx;
  payload.context_y = cy;
  payload.context_w = cw;
  payload.context_h = ch;

  const ctxHash = JSON.stringify(
    {e: ctxEnabled, x: cx, y: cy, w: cw, h: ch});
  if (ctxHash !== _lastContextHash) {
    _lastContextHash = ctxHash;
    changed = true;
  }

  if (!changed && rotation === _lastRotation) {
    return;
  }
  _lastRotation = rotation;

  board.syncing = true;
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/sync", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      board.lastSync  = Date.now();
      board.syncError = null;
      _warnedSyncFailure = false;
    } else {
      board.syncError = data.message || "sync failed";
      if (!_warnedSyncFailure) {
        _warnedSyncFailure = true;
        flashStatus("sync failed: " + board.syncError, "bad");
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    board.syncError = e.message || "network error";
    if (!_warnedSyncFailure) {
      _warnedSyncFailure = true;
      flashStatus("sync failed: " + board.syncError, "bad");
    }
  } finally {
    board.syncing = false;
  }

  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
}
"""
```

"""The main `drawView()` entry point, sig-dispatched per layer.

TWO LAYERS, TWO SIGNATURES
==========================
`drawView()` computes a content signature for each of the two
stacked canvases and repaints only the layer whose sig changed:

    image sig  covers:  board.imageHash, view.zoom/panX/panY/
                        rotation, image dims, viewport dims,
                        board.hoveredMaskIdx, board.selectedMaskIndices,
                        board.masks.length, _masksVersion
    overlay sig covers: board.imageHash, view.zoom/panX/panY,
                        image dims, viewport dims,
                        board.inpaintEnabled, board.inpaintContext.*,
                        board.masks.length, board.selectedMaskIndices.length

`view.rotation` is only in the image sig.  Rotating therefore
repaints the image layer only — the context rect and chrome text
never repaint on rotation, which is exactly the property the
previous single-canvas `drawView()` could not exploit.

`board.inpaintContext.*` and `board.hoveredMaskIdx` are in
disjoint sigs — dragging the context rect repaints the overlay
layer only; crossing a mask boundary repaints the image layer
only.

Panel state that changes without moving any field in either sig
(e.g. a `mask.img.onload` for a mask already in `board.masks`)
is covered by `_masksVersion`, a monotonic counter incremented in
`pg_masks.js`.  See `pg_state.py`'s MASKS VERSION section.

SIG CACHE
=========
The cached sigs live in `_layerSigs` (imported from `pg_state.js`,
which `resize()` also writes to clear them).  Kept out of this
module's local scope so `resize()` can invalidate without importing
`pg_view.js` (which imports `pg_state.js` — a cycle).

Sigs are null-initialised; `drawView()` first-call always paints
both layers.

CHROME TEXT IS CACHED AS AN OFFSCREEN BLIT
==========================================
The chrome text can't be skipped outright — `_drawOverlayCanvas`
clears its canvas at the top of each overlay repaint.  But
`fillText` re-shapes the whole string, and the string only changes
on: zoom, mask count, selection count, image dims, or
`inpaintEnabled`.  It does NOT change on pan, hover, context-rect
drag, or tint alpha — and those all skip the overlay repaint
entirely at the sig level now.

The cache keys the rendered text; on a hit, the frame blits a
pre-shaped RGBA canvas with one `drawImage`.  On a miss, the string
is measured once, an offscreen canvas is allocated to fit, and
`fillText` runs there.  Cost on hits drops from "full text shaping"
to "one integer key compare + one `drawImage`".

EMPTY-STATE TEXT
================
The "drop an image to begin" text is drawn on the OVERLAY layer, not
the image layer, so the image layer can return immediately when no
image is loaded.  The image layer's dark fill is provided by CSS
(`canvas { background: #0a0e14 }`, see `pgkit/styles.py`)."""

VIEW_JS = r"""
import {
  ctx, overlayCtx, board, view, fittedImageRect, _layerSigs,
  _masksVersion,
} from "./pg_state.js";
import { drawImageLayer } from "./pg_view_image.js";
import { drawInpaintContext } from "./pg_view_inpaint.js";

/* ============================================================
   Signatures
   ============================================================ */

function _viewportKey() {
  return window.innerWidth + "x" + window.innerHeight
       + "@" + (window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
}

function _imageSig() {
  return board.imageHash
       + "|" + board.imageWidth + "x" + board.imageHeight
       + "|" + view.zoom + "|" + view.panX + "|" + view.panY
       + "|" + view.rotation
       + "|" + _viewportKey()
       + "|" + board.hoveredMaskIdx
       + "|" + board.selectedMaskIndices.join(",")
       + "|" + board.masks.length
       + "|" + _masksVersion;
}

function _overlaySig() {
  return board.imageHash
       + "|" + board.imageWidth + "x" + board.imageHeight
       + "|" + view.zoom + "|" + view.panX + "|" + view.panY
       // NOTE: view.rotation deliberately absent — that is the win.
       + "|" + _viewportKey()
       + "|" + (board.inpaintEnabled ? "1" : "0")
       + "|" + board.inpaintContext.x
       + "|" + board.inpaintContext.y
       + "|" + board.inpaintContext.w
       + "|" + board.inpaintContext.h
       + "|" + (board.inpaintContext.activeHandle || "")
       + "|" + board.masks.length
       + "|" + board.selectedMaskIndices.length;
}

/* ============================================================
   Chrome text — the one-line status bar at top-left
   ============================================================
     single mask selected   "MASK N SELECTED"
     multiple selected      "MULTIPLE SELECTED"
     no masks yet           "IMPORT A MASK to begin"
     masks but none picked  "NO MASK SELECTED"

   When inpaint mode is on, " · INPAINT" is appended so the user
   never loses sight of the mode. */

function _chromeText() {
  const selIdx = (board.selectedMaskIndices.length === 1)
    ? board.selectedMaskIndices[0] : -1;
  let ctxLabel;
  if (selIdx >= 0) {
    ctxLabel = "MASK " + (selIdx + 1) + " SELECTED";
  } else if (board.selectedMaskIndices.length > 1) {
    ctxLabel = "MULTIPLE SELECTED";
  } else if (board.masks.length === 0) {
    ctxLabel = "IMPORT A MASK to begin";
  } else {
    ctxLabel = "NO MASK SELECTED";
  }

  if (board.inpaintEnabled) ctxLabel += " \u00b7 INPAINT";

  return "IMAGE " + board.imageWidth + "\u00d7" + board.imageHeight
       + "   \u00b7   ZOOM " + view.zoom.toFixed(2) + "\u00d7"
       + "   \u00b7   " + ctxLabel
       + "   \u00b7   MASKS " + board.masks.length;
}

let _chromeCache = { key: null, canvas: null };

function _drawChromeText() {
  const text = _chromeText();

  let entry = _chromeCache;
  if (entry.key !== text) {
    // Measure once — only on text change, which is rare.
    overlayCtx.save();
    overlayCtx.font = "700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    const w = Math.ceil(overlayCtx.measureText(text).width) + 4;
    overlayCtx.restore();

    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width  = Math.max(1, w);
    c.height = 20;
    const cx = c.getContext("2d");
    cx.font = "700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    cx.fillStyle = "#5a6774";
    cx.textAlign = "left";
    cx.textBaseline = "top";
    cx.fillText(text, 0, 0);

    entry = _chromeCache = { key: text, canvas: c };
  }

  overlayCtx.drawImage(entry.canvas, 14, 14);
}

/* ============================================================
   Layer draws
   ============================================================
   Each clears its own canvas and paints its share.  The image
   layer's dark fill is provided by CSS (`canvas { background:
   #0a0e14 }`); `clearRect` restores transparency and lets the CSS
   background show through.  The overlay's `clearRect` reveals the
   image layer below. */

function _drawImageLayerCanvas() {
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, cw, ch);

  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r || !board.imageEl) return;

  drawImageLayer(r);
}

function _drawOverlayCanvas() {
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  overlayCtx.clearRect(0, 0, cw, ch);

  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r || !board.imageEl) {
    overlayCtx.fillStyle = "#5a6774";
    overlayCtx.font = "700 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    overlayCtx.textAlign = "center";
    overlayCtx.textBaseline = "middle";
    overlayCtx.fillText("drop an image to begin", cw / 2, ch / 2);
    return;
  }

  drawInpaintContext(r);
  _drawChromeText();
}

/* ============================================================
   Public entry point — sig-dispatched
   ============================================================ */

export function drawView() {
  const imgSig = _imageSig();
  const ovlSig = _overlaySig();

  if (imgSig !== _layerSigs.image) {
    _layerSigs.image = imgSig;
    _drawImageLayerCanvas();
  }
  if (ovlSig !== _layerSigs.overlay) {
    _layerSigs.overlay = ovlSig;
    _drawOverlayCanvas();
  }
}
"""

"""The loaded image and the tinted overlay for each selected mask.

The single most stable view file.  Draws on the IMAGE layer (`ctx`,
`#c`), under the view-rotation transform.  The UI layer (context
rect, chrome text) is drawn on `overlayCtx` by `pg_view_inpaint.py`
and `pg_view.py` respectively — see `pg_state.py`'s TWO CANVASES
note.

Every layer here is drawn against the fitted image rect `r` (from
`pg_state.fittedImageRect`), wrapped in the same rotation transform
that both the image and the mask tint share.  The context rect on
the overlay layer is deliberately NOT wrapped in that transform, so
it stays visually fixed while the image rotates underneath.

Mask overlays iterate `board.selectedMaskIndices` directly rather
than allocating a `Set` and iterating the whole mask array.  Every
mutator of `selectedMaskIndices` (`toggleMaskSelection`,
`addMaskToSelection`, `replaceMaskSelection`, `clearMaskSelection`,
`selectAllMasks`, the delete handlers in `pg_panel_lists.js` and
`pg_panel_bindings.js`, `_kritaImportMasksAction`,
`_maskFromRectAction`, `_pickMaskAction`, `setMasks`) keeps the
array in ascending order, so direct iteration preserves the previous
draw order — mask index ascending — while avoiding a per-frame
allocation."""

VIEW_IMAGE_JS = r"""
import { ctx, board, maskColor, view } from "./pg_state.js";
import { maskPixelData } from "./pg_pixels.js";

/* ============================================================
   Tinted mask overlay
   ============================================================
   One tinted canvas per mask, cached on the mask entry.  The key
   includes the color so that when `maskColor(idx)` shifts (which it
   does when a mask's index changes because another mask was deleted),
   the tint is rebuilt. */

function _tintedMask(mask, color) {
  const key = color.r + "," + color.g + "," + color.b;
  if (mask._tinted && mask._tintedKey === key) return mask._tinted;
  const px = maskPixelData(mask);
  if (!px) return null;

  const W = mask.rotatedCanvas ? mask.rotatedW : mask.w;
  const H = mask.rotatedCanvas ? mask.rotatedH : mask.h;
  if (!W || !H) return null;

  const off = document.createElement("canvas");
  off.width = W; off.height = H;
  const octx = off.getContext("2d");
  const imgData = octx.createImageData(W, H);
  const out = imgData.data;

  for (let i = 0; i < px.length; i += 4) {
    const m = px[i] / 255;
    const a = px[i + 3] / 255;
    out[i]     = color.r;
    out[i + 1] = color.g;
    out[i + 2] = color.b;
    out[i + 3] = Math.round(255 * m * a);
  }
  octx.putImageData(imgData, 0, 0);

  mask._tinted = off;
  mask._tintedKey = key;
  return off;
}

/* ============================================================
   The image layer
   ============================================================
   The image, its border, and every selected-mask overlay are
   drawn against the *un-rotated* fit rect `r`, wrapped in a
   `translate(cx,cy); rotate(rad); translate(-cx,-cy)` transform.
   That gives the visual rotation without changing any image
   dimensions or the fit scale.

   The overlay loop iterates `board.selectedMaskIndices` directly.
   The array is kept in ascending order by every mutator, so
   iteration order matches the previous
   `for i in 0..n-1, skip unless selected` loop.  Skipping the
   `new Set(...)` allocation removes the only per-frame object
   allocation in this function. */

export function drawImageLayer(r) {
  const cx = r.x0 + r.w / 2;
  const cy = r.y0 + r.h / 2;
  const rad = view.rotation * Math.PI / 180;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.translate(cx, cy);
  ctx.rotate(rad);
  ctx.translate(-cx, -cy);

  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
  ctx.drawImage(board.imageEl, r.x0, r.y0, r.w, r.h);

  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e2836";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(r.x0 + 0.5, r.y0 + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1);

  for (const i of board.selectedMaskIndices) {
    const m = board.masks[i];
    if (!m || !m.loaded) continue;
    const tinted = _tintedMask(m, maskColor(i));
    if (!tinted) continue;
    const isHovered = (i === board.hoveredMaskIdx);
    ctx.save();
    ctx.globalAlpha = isHovered ? 0.55 : 0.40;
    ctx.drawImage(tinted, r.x0, r.y0, r.w, r.h);
    ctx.restore();
  }

  ctx.restore();
}
