"""Panel: bbox list, buttons, ratio dropdown, state sync.

`board.viewer.model` is hardcoded to `"PixArtMS_Sigma_XL_2_512"` in
`pg_state.js` — drawatoon is a 512-px model, the model choice is not
user-facing.  The ratio dropdown is the only Frame control the user
sees.
"""

PANEL_JS = r"""
import {
  board, setImage, applyCanvasImage, clearImage,
  addBbox, deleteBbox, clearAllBboxes, seedDefault, selectBbox,
  resetViewerToFit,
} from "./pg_state.js";
import {
  uploadImageFile, importFromKrita, checkKritaStatus,
  fetchActiveState, fetchResourceImage,
} from "./pg_client.js";
import { fetchSelectedLayer } from "./pg_autosync.js";
import { flashStatus } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";
import { pgkitNotifyAll } from "./pgkit/remote_client.js";

const PLAYGROUND_ID = "layout";
const SLOT_ID       = "@thelayout";

// Mirror of pixart_res table keys.  Kept in sync with
// kritomatic_nodes/PixArt/conf.py — node uses exact dims, this list
// is only used to populate the dropdown and compute display aspect
// via float(ratio).
const RATIO_KEYS = [
  "0.25", "0.26", "0.27", "0.28",
  "0.32", "0.33", "0.35", "0.40",
  "0.42", "0.48", "0.50", "0.52",
  "0.57", "0.60", "0.68", "0.72",
  "0.78", "0.82", "0.88", "0.94",
  "1.00", "1.07", "1.13", "1.21",
  "1.29", "1.38", "1.46", "1.67",
  "1.75", "2.00", "2.09", "2.40",
  "2.50", "2.89", "3.00", "3.11",
  "3.62", "3.75", "3.88", "4.00",
];

/* ============================================================
   State sync
   ============================================================ */

let _syncTimer = null;
let _lastStateSnapshot = "";

function _stateSnapshot() {
  return JSON.stringify({
    t: board.textBboxes,
    c: board.characterBboxes,
    r: board.referenceEmbeddings,
    d: [board.imageWidth, board.imageHeight],
    v: board.viewer,
  });
}

function _buildPayload() {
  const toWire = (list) => list.map(b => [
    b.x, b.y, b.x + b.w, b.y + b.h,
  ]);

  return {
    op: "set",
    state: {
      text_bboxes:          toWire(board.textBboxes),
      character_bboxes:     toWire(board.characterBboxes),
      reference_embeddings: board.referenceEmbeddings.map(r => r || null),
      image_dims:           [board.imageWidth, board.imageHeight],
      viewer: {
        x: board.viewer.x,
        y: board.viewer.y,
        w: board.viewer.w,
        h: board.viewer.h,
        model: board.viewer.model,
        ratio: board.viewer.ratio,
      },
    },
  };
}

function _scheduleStateSync() {
  if (_syncTimer) clearTimeout(_syncTimer);
  _syncTimer = setTimeout(_doStateSync, 250);
}

async function _doStateSync() {
  _syncTimer = null;
  const snap = _stateSnapshot();
  if (snap === _lastStateSnapshot) return;

  try {
    const res = await fetch("/state", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify(_buildPayload()),
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      _lastStateSnapshot = snap;
      const v = (data.version || "").slice(0, 8);
      const el = document.getElementById("stateVersion");
      if (el) el.textContent = v || "—";
      const sl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
      if (sl) {
        sl.textContent = "synced \u00b7 v" + v;
        sl.className = "ok";
      }
    } else {
      const sl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
      if (sl) {
        sl.textContent = "sync failed: " + (data.message || "unknown");
        sl.className = "bad";
      }
    }
  } catch (e) {
    const sl = document.getElementById("statusLine");
    if (sl) {
      sl.textContent = "sync failed: " + e.message;
      sl.className = "bad";
    }
  }
  pgkitNotifyAll();
}

window._layoutOnDragEnd = _scheduleStateSync;

/* ============================================================
   Bbox list
   ============================================================ */

function _renderBboxList() {
  const list = document.getElementById("bboxList");
  if (!list) return;
  list.innerHTML = "";

  if (board.textBboxes.length === 0 && board.characterBboxes.length === 0) {
    const e = document.createElement("div");
    e.className = "empty";
    e.textContent = board.imageEl
      ? "no bboxes yet \u2014 click + Text region or + Character"
      : "load an image first";
    list.appendChild(e);
    return;
  }

  const _row = (kind, idx, bbox) => {
    const isSel = board.selectedKind === kind && board.selectedIdx === idx;
    const row = document.createElement("div");
    row.className = "bboxRow" + (isSel ? " selected" : "");
    if (isSel) {
      row.style.borderColor = kind === 'text'
        ? "rgba(120,220,255,0.85)"
        : "rgba(255,200,90,0.85)";
    }

    const sw = document.createElement("span");
    sw.className = "bboxSwatch";
    sw.style.background = kind === 'text'
      ? "rgb(120,220,255)"
      : "rgb(255,200,90)";
    row.appendChild(sw);

    const lbl = document.createElement("span");
    lbl.className = "bboxLabel";
    lbl.textContent = (kind === 'text' ? "Text " : "Char ") + (idx + 1);
    row.appendChild(lbl);

    const dims = document.createElement("span");
    dims.className = "bboxDims";
    const pctW = Math.round(bbox.w * 100);
    const pctH = Math.round(bbox.h * 100);
    dims.textContent = pctW + "% \u00d7 " + pctH + "%";
    row.appendChild(dims);

    const del = document.createElement("button");
    del.className = "bboxDel";
    del.textContent = "\u00d7";
    del.title = "Remove bbox";
    del.addEventListener("click", (ev) => {
      ev.stopPropagation();
      deleteBbox(kind, idx);
      _renderBboxList();
      _scheduleStateSync();
    });
    row.appendChild(del);

    row.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectBbox(kind, idx);
      _renderBboxList();
    });

    list.appendChild(row);
  };

  for (let i = 0; i < board.textBboxes.length; i++) {
    _row('text', i, board.textBboxes[i]);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < board.characterBboxes.length; i++) {
    _row('character', i, board.characterBboxes[i]);
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Panel sync
   ============================================================ */

export function syncPanelFields() {
  const e = {
    imageInfo:      document.getElementById("imageInfo"),
    addText:        document.getElementById("addTextBboxBtn"),
    addChar:        document.getElementById("addCharacterBboxBtn"),
    seed:           document.getElementById("seedDefaultBtn"),
    clear:          document.getElementById("clearBboxesBtn"),
    viewerRatio:    document.getElementById("viewerRatio"),
  };

  if (e.imageInfo) {
    const text = board.imageEl
      ? board.imageWidth + " \u00d7 " + board.imageHeight
        + "   [" + String(board.imageHash).slice(0, 8) + "\u2026]"
      : "No image loaded";
    if (e.imageInfo.textContent !== text) e.imageInfo.textContent = text;
  }

  if (e.viewerRatio && document.activeElement !== e.viewerRatio) {
    if (e.viewerRatio.value !== board.viewer.ratio) {
      e.viewerRatio.value = board.viewer.ratio;
    }
  }

  const hasImage = !!board.imageEl;
  if (e.addText) e.addText.disabled = !hasImage;
  if (e.addChar) e.addChar.disabled = !hasImage;
  if (e.seed)    e.seed.disabled    = !hasImage;
  if (e.clear)   e.clear.disabled   =
    !(board.textBboxes.length + board.characterBboxes.length);
}

/* ============================================================
   Buttons
   ============================================================ */

function _pickImageAction() {
  const input = document.createElement("input");
  input.type = "file";
  input.accept = "image/*";
  input.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    const file = input.files && input.files[0];
    if (!file) return;
    flashStatus("uploading\u2026", "");
    try {
      const info = await uploadImageFile(file);
      const dataUrl = await _fileToDataUrl(file);
      setImage(info.hash, dataUrl, info.width, info.height);
      flashStatus("image loaded", "ok");
      _scheduleStateSync();
      _renderBboxList();
    } catch (e) {
      flashStatus("upload failed: " + e.message, "bad");
    }
  });
  input.click();
}

function _fileToDataUrl(file) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = () => resolve(String(reader.result || ""));
    reader.onerror = () => reject(new Error("could not read file"));
    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  });
}

function _clearImageAction() {
  clearImage();
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

async function _importImageFromKritaAction() {
  flashStatus("importing from Krita\u2026", "");
  const res = await importFromKrita({});
  if (!res.success) {
    flashStatus("import failed: " + (res.message || "unknown"), "bad");
    return;
  }
  setImage(res.hash, res.data_url, res.width, res.height);
  flashStatus("imported " + res.width + "\u00d7" + res.height, "ok");
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

async function _refreshCanvasAction() {
  flashStatus("refreshing " + SLOT_ID + "\u2026", "");
  const state = await fetchActiveState();
  if (!state || state.daemon_reachable === false) {
    flashStatus(SLOT_ID + " refresh failed: daemon unreachable", "bad");
    return;
  }
  const playgrounds = (state.data && state.data.playgrounds) || [];
  const entry = playgrounds.find(p => p.id === PLAYGROUND_ID);
  const slots = (entry && entry.layer_slots) || [];
  const slot = slots.find(s => s.id === SLOT_ID);
  if (!slot) {
    flashStatus(SLOT_ID + " not registered", "warn");
    return;
  }
  const selector = slot.selector
    || { source: "active", layer_name: null };
  await fetchSelectedLayer(selector);
}

function _addTextBboxAction() {
  if (!board.imageEl) return;
  const n = board.textBboxes.length;
  addBbox('text', {
    x: 0.10,
    y: Math.min(0.85, 0.02 + n * 0.15),
    w: 0.80,
    h: 0.10,
  });
  selectBbox('text', board.textBboxes.length - 1);
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

function _addCharacterBboxAction() {
  if (!board.imageEl) return;
  const n = board.characterBboxes.length;
  addBbox('character', {
    x: Math.max(0.05, 0.30 - n * 0.05),
    y: 0.15,
    w: 0.40,
    h: 0.75,
  });
  selectBbox('character', board.characterBboxes.length - 1);
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

function _seedDefaultAction() {
  if (!board.imageEl) return;
  seedDefault();
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

function _clearAllAction() {
  clearAllBboxes();
  _renderBboxList();
  _scheduleStateSync();
}

async function _kritaStatusAction() {
  const res = await checkKritaStatus();
  const el = document.getElementById("kritaStatus");
  if (!el) return;
  if (res.reachable) {
    el.textContent = "\u2713 reachable";
    el.className = "ok";
  } else {
    el.textContent = "\u2717 not reachable";
    el.className = "bad";
  }
}

/* ============================================================
   Install
   ============================================================ */

function _showDropOverlay(on) {
  const el = document.getElementById("dropOverlay");
  if (el) el.classList.toggle("visible", on);
}

function _installDropOverlay() {
  if (document.getElementById("dropOverlay")) return;
  const el = document.createElement("div");
  el.id = "dropOverlay";
  el.textContent = "Drop an image";
  document.body.appendChild(el);
}

function _installViewerDropdowns() {
  const ratioSel = document.getElementById("viewerRatio");
  if (!ratioSel) return;

  if (ratioSel.options.length === 0) {
    for (const k of RATIO_KEYS) {
      const opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = k;
      opt.textContent = k;
      ratioSel.appendChild(opt);
    }
  }
  ratioSel.value = board.viewer.ratio;

  ratioSel.addEventListener("change", () => {
    board.viewer.ratio = ratioSel.value;
    resetViewerToFit();
    _scheduleStateSync();
    _renderBboxList();
  });
}

export function installPanelBindings() {
  const ids = {
    pickImage:  "pickImageBtn",
    clearImage: "clearImageBtn",
    importImg:  "importImageBtn",
    refresh:    "refreshCanvasBtn",
    addText:    "addTextBboxBtn",
    addChar:    "addCharacterBboxBtn",
    seed:       "seedDefaultBtn",
    clearAll:   "clearBboxesBtn",
    kritaCheck: "kritaCheckBtn",
  };
  const el = {};
  for (const k in ids) el[k] = document.getElementById(ids[k]);

  if (el.pickImage)   el.pickImage.addEventListener("click", _pickImageAction);
  if (el.clearImage)  el.clearImage.addEventListener("click", _clearImageAction);
  if (el.importImg)   el.importImg.addEventListener("click", _importImageFromKritaAction);
  if (el.refresh)     el.refresh.addEventListener("click", _refreshCanvasAction);
  if (el.addText)     el.addText.addEventListener("click", _addTextBboxAction);
  if (el.addChar)     el.addChar.addEventListener("click", _addCharacterBboxAction);
  if (el.seed)        el.seed.addEventListener("click", _seedDefaultAction);
  if (el.clearAll)    el.clearAll.addEventListener("click", _clearAllAction);
  if (el.kritaCheck)  el.kritaCheck.addEventListener("click", _kritaStatusAction);

  _installViewerDropdowns();
  _installDropOverlay();
  let _dragDepth = 0;
  window.addEventListener("dragenter", () => {
    _dragDepth++;
    _showDropOverlay(true);
  });
  window.addEventListener("dragleave", () => {
    _dragDepth--;
    if (_dragDepth <= 0) _showDropOverlay(false);
  });
  window.addEventListener("dragover", (e) => e.preventDefault());
  window.addEventListener("drop", async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    _dragDepth = 0;
    _showDropOverlay(false);
    const file = e.dataTransfer && e.dataTransfer.files
                 && e.dataTransfer.files[0];
    if (file && file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
      flashStatus("uploading\u2026", "");
      try {
        const info = await uploadImageFile(file);
        const dataUrl = await _fileToDataUrl(file);
        setImage(info.hash, dataUrl, info.width, info.height);
        _renderBboxList();
        _scheduleStateSync();
      } catch (e) {
        flashStatus("upload failed: " + e.message, "bad");
      }
    }
  });

  _bootPull().catch(() => {});
}

async function _bootPull() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch("/state", {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: "{}",
    });
    const data = await res.json();
    if (data.success) {
      const v = (data.version || "").slice(0, 8);
      const el = document.getElementById("stateVersion");
      if (el) el.textContent = v || "—";
      _lastStateSnapshot = _stateSnapshot();
    }
  } catch (_) {}
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
}

export function layoutBootSync() {
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
  _kritaStatusAction();
}

export function onDrawComplete() {
  _renderBboxList();
  syncPanelFields();
}
"""

```python
"""Layout state: image, viewer, bboxes, view, drags.

Leaf module — no imports from other project modules.

Coordinate systems
==================
  · Canvas image pixels     — what `screenToImage()` returns. Range [0, W]×[0, H].
  · Canvas-normalized       — [0, 1] of canvas image (x / W, y / H).
  · Viewer-normalized       — [0, 1] of the viewer rectangle. What the model receives.

The viewer is stored as `{x, y, w, h}` in canvas-normalized coords.
Bboxes are stored as `{x, y, w, h}` in viewer-normalized coords. So
dragging the viewer carries all bboxes with it (their canvas position
is `viewer.pos + bbox.pos * viewer.size`); dragging a bbox moves it
within the frame while the frame stays put.

Image loading has two paths:
  · `setImage` — full reset. Clear bboxes, reset viewer to fit, reset
    view. Used when the user explicitly loads a new image (pick file,
    import from Krita).
  · `applyCanvasImage` — partial update. Preserve bboxes, reset viewer
    only when image dims change, preserve view. Used by autosync and
    the manual "Refresh @thelayout" button.
"""

STATE_JS = r"""
import {
  VIEW_ZOOM_MIN, VIEW_ZOOM_MAX, VIEW_PAN_MARGIN,
} from "./pg_tuning.js";

export const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
export const ctx    = canvas.getContext("2d");

let _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;

export const view = { zoom: 1, panX: 0, panY: 0 };

export function resetView() {
  view.zoom = 1;
  view.panX = 0;
  view.panY = 0;
}

export function clampPan() {
  if (!board.imageWidth || !board.imageHeight) return;
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  const pad = 40;
  const sx = (cw - 2 * pad) / board.imageWidth;
  const sy = (ch - 2 * pad) / board.imageHeight;
  const s = Math.min(sx, sy) * view.zoom;
  const w = board.imageWidth  * s;
  const h = board.imageHeight * s;
  const baseX = (cw - w) / 2;
  const baseY = (ch - h) / 2;
  const m = VIEW_PAN_MARGIN;
  view.panX = Math.max(m - baseX - w, Math.min(cw - m - baseX, view.panX));
  view.panY = Math.max(m - baseY - h, Math.min(ch - m - baseY, view.panY));
}

export function zoomAt(sx, sy, nz) {
  const r0 = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r0) return;
  const ix = (sx - r0.x0) / r0.s;
  const iy = (sy - r0.y0) / r0.s;
  view.zoom = Math.max(VIEW_ZOOM_MIN, Math.min(VIEW_ZOOM_MAX, nz));
  const r1 = fittedImageRect();
  view.panX += sx - (r1.x0 + ix * r1.s);
  view.panY += sy - (r1.y0 + iy * r1.s);
  clampPan();
}

/* ============================================================
   Board
   ============================================================ */

export const board = {
  imageHash:    null,
  imageWidth:   0,
  imageHeight:  0,
  imageEl:      null,
  imageDataUrl: null,

  // Viewer rectangle: normalized [0, 1] of canvas.
  viewer: {
    x: 0.05, y: 0.05, w: 0.9, h: 0.9,
    model: "PixArtMS_Sigma_XL_2_512",
    ratio: "1.00",
  },

  // Bboxes are normalized [0, 1] OF VIEWER, not of canvas.
  textBboxes:          [],
  characterBboxes:     [],
  referenceEmbeddings: [],

  selectedKind:  null,
  selectedIdx:   -1,
  hoveredKind:   null,
  hoveredIdx:    -1,

  dragActive:    false,
  dragHandle:    null,
  dragKind:      null,
  dragIdx:       -1,
  dragStartBbox: null,
  dragStartIx:   0,
  dragStartIy:   0,

  viewerDragActive:  false,
  viewerDragHandle:  null,
  viewerDragStart:   null,
  viewerDragStartIx: 0,
  viewerDragStartIy: 0,

  mouse: { x: 0, y: 0, inside: false },
};

/* ============================================================
   Viewer aspect / fit helpers
   ============================================================ */

export function viewerAspect() {
  const r = parseFloat(board.viewer.ratio);
  return (isFinite(r) && r > 0) ? r : 1.0;
}

export function resetViewerToFit() {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const r = viewerAspect();
  const cw = board.imageWidth;
  const ch = board.imageHeight;
  if (!cw || !ch) return;

  // Try 90% of the height first; fall back to 90% of width if too wide.
  const targetPxH_fromH = 0.9 * ch;
  const targetPxW_fromH = targetPxH_fromH * r;
  if (targetPxW_fromH <= 0.9 * cw) {
    v.h = 0.9;
    v.w = targetPxW_fromH / cw;
  } else {
    v.w = 0.9;
    v.h = (0.9 * cw) / (r * ch);
  }
  v.x = (1 - v.w) / 2;
  v.y = (1 - v.h) / 2;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Image loading
   ============================================================ */

export function setImage(hash, dataUrl, width, height) {
  board.imageHash    = hash;
  board.imageDataUrl = dataUrl;
  board.imageWidth   = width;
  board.imageHeight  = height;
  board.imageEl      = null;

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload  = () => { board.imageEl = img;  _scheduleDraw(); };
  img.onerror = () => { board.imageEl = null; _scheduleDraw(); };
  img.src = dataUrl;

  resetView();
  board.textBboxes          = [];
  board.characterBboxes     = [];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx  = -1;
  board.hoveredKind  = null;
  board.hoveredIdx   = -1;
  resetViewerToFit();
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function applyCanvasImage(hash, dataUrl, width, height) {
  const dimsMatch = (
    board.imageWidth === width && board.imageHeight === height
  );

  board.imageHash    = hash;
  board.imageDataUrl = dataUrl;
  board.imageWidth   = width;
  board.imageHeight  = height;

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = () => {
    board.imageEl = img;
    if (!dimsMatch) {
      // New aspect/size invalidates viewer position; reset it.
      resetViewerToFit();
    }
    _scheduleDraw();
  };
  img.onerror = () => { board.imageEl = null; _scheduleDraw(); };
  img.src = dataUrl;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function clearImage() {
  board.imageHash    = null;
  board.imageDataUrl = null;
  board.imageWidth   = 0;
  board.imageHeight  = 0;
  board.imageEl      = null;
  resetView();
  board.textBboxes          = [];
  board.characterBboxes     = [];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx  = -1;
  board.hoveredKind  = null;
  board.hoveredIdx   = -1;
  resetViewerToFit();
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Bbox CRUD
   ============================================================ */

function _listFor(kind) {
  return kind === 'text' ? board.textBboxes : board.characterBboxes;
}

export function addBbox(kind, bbox) {
  const list = _listFor(kind);
  list.push({ ...bbox });
  if (kind === 'character') board.referenceEmbeddings.push(null);
  _scheduleDraw();
  return list.length - 1;
}

export function deleteBbox(kind, idx) {
  const list = _listFor(kind);
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= list.length) return false;
  list.splice(idx, 1);
  if (kind === 'character') board.referenceEmbeddings.splice(idx, 1);
  if (board.selectedKind === kind && board.selectedIdx === idx) {
    board.selectedKind = null;
    board.selectedIdx = -1;
  } else if (board.selectedKind === kind && board.selectedIdx > idx) {
    board.selectedIdx -= 1;
  }
  if (board.hoveredKind === kind && board.hoveredIdx === idx) {
    board.hoveredKind = null;
    board.hoveredIdx = -1;
  } else if (board.hoveredKind === kind && board.hoveredIdx > idx) {
    board.hoveredIdx -= 1;
  }
  _scheduleDraw();
  return true;
}

export function setBbox(kind, idx, bbox) {
  const list = _listFor(kind);
  if (idx < 0 || idx >= list.length) return false;
  list[idx] = { ...bbox };
  _scheduleDraw();
  return true;
}

export function clearAllBboxes() {
  board.textBboxes          = [];
  board.characterBboxes     = [];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx = -1;
  board.hoveredKind = null;
  board.hoveredIdx = -1;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function seedDefault() {
  board.textBboxes = [{ x: 0.10, y: 0.02, w: 0.80, h: 0.10 }];
  board.characterBboxes = [{ x: 0.30, y: 0.15, w: 0.40, h: 0.75 }];
  board.referenceEmbeddings = [null];
  board.selectedKind = null;
  board.selectedIdx = -1;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function selectBbox(kind, idx) {
  if (kind !== 'text' && kind !== 'character') {
    board.selectedKind = null;
    board.selectedIdx = -1;
  } else {
    board.selectedKind = kind;
    board.selectedIdx = idx;
  }
  _scheduleDraw();
}

/* ============================================================
   Coordinate conversions
   ============================================================ */

/* canvas image pixels → viewer-normalized [0,1] */
export function canvasPxToViewerNorm(cx, cy) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vPxX = v.x * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxY = v.y * board.imageHeight;
  const vPxW = v.w * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxH = v.h * board.imageHeight;
  if (!vPxW || !vPxH) return [0, 0];
  return [(cx - vPxX) / vPxW, (cy - vPxY) / vPxH];
}

/* viewer-normalized [0,1] → canvas image pixels */
export function viewerNormToCanvasPx(vnx, vny) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vPxX = v.x * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxY = v.y * board.imageHeight;
  const vPxW = v.w * board.imageWidth;
  const vPxH = v.h * board.imageHeight;
  return [vPxX + vnx * vPxW, vPxY + vny * vPxH];
}

/* ============================================================
   Image-fit rect — memoized
   ============================================================ */

let _firKey = null;
let _firVal = null;

export function fittedImageRect() {
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  if (!board.imageWidth || !board.imageHeight) return null;

  const key = cw + "," + ch + "," + board.imageWidth + ","
            + board.imageHeight + "," + view.zoom + ","
            + view.panX + "," + view.panY;
  if (key === _firKey) return _firVal;

  const pad = 40;
  const sx = (cw - 2 * pad) / board.imageWidth;
  const sy = (ch - 2 * pad) / board.imageHeight;
  const s = Math.min(sx, sy) * view.zoom;
  const w = board.imageWidth  * s;
  const h = board.imageHeight * s;
  const x0 = (cw - w) / 2 + view.panX;
  const y0 = (ch - h) / 2 + view.panY;

  _firKey = key;
  _firVal = { x0, y0, w, h, s };
  return _firVal;
}

export function imageToScreen(x, y) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [x, y];
  return [r.x0 + x * r.s, r.y0 + y * r.s];
}

export function screenToImage(sx, sy) {
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return [0, 0];
  return [(sx - r.x0) / r.s, (sy - r.y0) / r.s];
}

/* ============================================================
   Draw scheduling
   ============================================================ */

let _drawScheduled = false;
let _drawFn = null;

export function _setDraw(fn) { _drawFn = fn; }

export function _scheduleDraw() {
  if (_drawScheduled) return;
  _drawScheduled = true;
  const fire = () => {
    _drawScheduled = false;
    if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
  };
  if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === "function") requestAnimationFrame(fire);
  else setTimeout(fire, 16);
}

export function resize() {
  _dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  canvas.width  = Math.round(cw * _dpr);
  canvas.height = Math.round(ch * _dpr);
  canvas.style.width  = cw + "px";
  canvas.style.height = ch + "px";
  ctx.setTransform(_dpr, 0, 0, _dpr, 0, 0);
  clampPan();
  if (_drawFn) _drawFn();
}
window.addEventListener("resize", resize);
"""

export const VIEW_ZOOM_MAX   = 32.0;
export const VIEW_PAN_MARGIN = 40;

/* Minimum bbox size in normalized units (2% of image dimension). */
export const BBOX_MIN_SIZE = 0.02;

/* Handle hit tolerance in screen pixels. */
export const HANDLE_TOL_PX = 10;

"""Main draw entry point."""

VIEW_JS = r"""
import { ctx, board, view, fittedImageRect } from "./pg_state.js";
import { drawImageLayer } from "./pg_view_image.js";

function _chromeText() {
  return "IMAGE " + board.imageWidth + "\u00d7" + board.imageHeight
       + "   \u00b7   ZOOM " + view.zoom.toFixed(2) + "\u00d7"
       + "   \u00b7   TEXT " + board.textBboxes.length
       + "   \u00b7   CHAR " + board.characterBboxes.length;
}

let _chromeCache = { key: null, canvas: null };

function _drawChrome() {
  const text = _chromeText();
  let entry = _chromeCache;
  if (entry.key !== text) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.font = "700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    const w = Math.ceil(ctx.measureText(text).width) + 4;
    ctx.restore();

    const c = document.createElement("canvas");
    c.width  = Math.max(1, w);
    c.height = 20;
    const cx = c.getContext("2d");
    cx.font = "700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    cx.fillStyle = "#5a6774";
    cx.textAlign = "left";
    cx.textBaseline = "top";
    cx.fillText(text, 0, 0);
    entry = _chromeCache = { key: text, canvas: c };
  }
  ctx.drawImage(entry.canvas, 14, 14);
}

export function drawView() {
  const cw = window.innerWidth, ch = window.innerHeight;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0a0e14";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, cw, ch);

  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r || !board.imageEl) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "#5a6774";
    ctx.font = "700 12px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
    ctx.textAlign = "center";
    ctx.textBaseline = "middle";
    ctx.fillText(
      "import an image, then place text and character boxes",
      cw / 2, ch / 2,
    );
    return;
  }

  drawImageLayer(r);
  _drawChrome();

"""The loaded image, the viewer mask, bboxes, and the viewer frame.

Render order:
  1. Image
  2. Dim outside viewer (4 rects in canvas margin + viewer exterior)
  3. Bboxes (inside viewer, so never dimmed)
  4. Viewer outline + corner handles
  5. Image border
"""

VIEW_IMAGE_JS = r"""
import { ctx, board, viewerAspect } from "./pg_state.js";
import { bboxScreenRect, bboxHandles } from "./pg_dispatch.js";

const COLORS = {
  text: {
    normal:  "rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.70)",
    hover:   "rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.90)",
    selected: "rgba(120, 220, 255, 1.00)",
    fill:    "rgba(120, 220, 255, 0.06)",
  },
  character: {
    normal:  "rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.70)",
    hover:   "rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.90)",
    selected: "rgba(255, 200, 90, 1.00)",
    fill:    "rgba(255, 200, 90, 0.06)",
  },
};

function _drawOneBbox(kind, idx, bbox, isSelected, isHovered) {
  const r = bboxScreenRect(bbox);
  if (!r) return;
  const pal = COLORS[kind];
  const stroke = isSelected ? pal.selected
              : isHovered  ? pal.hover
              : pal.normal;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = pal.fill;
  ctx.fillRect(r.x0, r.y0, r.x1 - r.x0, r.y1 - r.y0);

  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.85)";
  ctx.lineWidth = isSelected ? 6.0 : 3.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(r.x0, r.y0, r.x1 - r.x0, r.y1 - r.y0);
  ctx.stroke();

  ctx.strokeStyle = stroke;
  ctx.lineWidth = isSelected ? 2.8 : 2.0;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(r.x0, r.y0, r.x1 - r.x0, r.y1 - r.y0);
  ctx.stroke();

  const label = (kind === 'text' ? 'TEXT ' : 'CHAR ') + (idx + 1);
  ctx.font = "700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = stroke;
  ctx.textBaseline = "bottom";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  ctx.fillText(label, r.x0 + 3, r.y0 - 3);

  if (isSelected) {
    const hs = bboxHandles(bbox);
    if (hs) {
      for (const h of hs) {
        const HS = 7;
        ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.85)";
        ctx.fillRect(h.x - HS - 2, h.y - HS - 2, (HS + 2) * 2, (HS + 2) * 2);
        ctx.fillStyle = stroke;
        ctx.fillRect(h.x - HS, h.y - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
        ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)";
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        ctx.strokeRect(h.x - HS, h.y - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
      }
    }
  }

  ctx.restore();
}

function _dimOutsideViewer(r) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vx0 = r.x0 + v.x * r.w;
  const vy0 = r.y0 + v.y * r.h;
  const vx1 = r.x0 + (v.x + v.w) * r.w;
  const vy1 = r.y0 + (v.y + v.h) * r.h;

  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(6, 8, 12, 0.55)";

  // Top strip (canvas area above viewer)
  if (vy0 > r.y0) {
    ctx.fillRect(r.x0, r.y0, r.w, vy0 - r.y0);
  }
  // Bottom strip
  if (vy1 < r.y0 + r.h) {
    ctx.fillRect(r.x0, vy1, r.w, r.y0 + r.h - vy1);
  }
  // Left strip (between viewer top and bottom)
  if (vx0 > r.x0) {
    ctx.fillRect(r.x0, vy0, vx0 - r.x0, vy1 - vy0);
  }
  // Right strip
  if (vx1 < r.x0 + r.w) {
    ctx.fillRect(vx1, vy0, r.x0 + r.w - vx1, vy1 - vy0);
  }
  ctx.restore();
}

function _drawViewerFrame(r) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const vx0 = r.x0 + v.x * r.w;
  const vy0 = r.y0 + v.y * r.h;
  const vx1 = r.x0 + (v.x + v.w) * r.w;
  const vy1 = r.y0 + (v.y + v.h) * r.h;

  ctx.save();

  // Halo stroke
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.85)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 5.5;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(vx0, vy0, vx1 - vx0, vy1 - vy0);
  ctx.stroke();

  // Bright stroke
  ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)";
  ctx.lineWidth = 2.0;
  ctx.setLineDash([10, 5]);
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.rect(vx0, vy0, vx1 - vx0, vy1 - vy0);
  ctx.stroke();
  ctx.setLineDash([]);

  // Corner handles
  const HS = 8;
  const corners = [
    [vx0, vy0], [vx1, vy0],
    [vx0, vy1], [vx1, vy1],
  ];
  for (const [hx, hy] of corners) {
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(8, 10, 14, 0.9)";
    ctx.fillRect(hx - HS - 2, hy - HS - 2, (HS + 2) * 2, (HS + 2) * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 1.0)";
    ctx.fillRect(hx - HS, hy - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
    ctx.strokeStyle = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)";
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2;
    ctx.strokeRect(hx - HS, hy - HS, HS * 2, HS * 2);
  }

  // Frame label
  ctx.font = "700 11px 'JetBrains Mono', monospace";
  ctx.fillStyle = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95)";
  ctx.textBaseline = "top";
  ctx.textAlign = "left";
  const ratio = v.ratio;
  ctx.fillText("FRAME " + ratio + ":1", vx0 + 4, vy0 - 16);

  ctx.restore();
}

export function drawImageLayer(r) {
  ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled = true;
  ctx.imageSmoothingQuality = "high";
  ctx.drawImage(board.imageEl, r.x0, r.y0, r.w, r.h);

  _dimOutsideViewer(r);

  for (let i = 0; i < board.textBboxes.length; i++) {
    _drawOneBbox('text', i, board.textBboxes[i],
                 board.selectedKind === 'text' && board.selectedIdx === i,
                 board.hoveredKind === 'text' && board.hoveredIdx === i);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < board.characterBboxes.length; i++) {
    _drawOneBbox('character', i, board.characterBboxes[i],
                 board.selectedKind === 'character' && board.selectedIdx === i,
                 board.hoveredKind === 'character' && board.hoveredIdx === i);
  }

  _drawViewerFrame(r);

  // Faint canvas border on top
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#1e2836";
  ctx.lineWidth = 1;
  ctx.strokeRect(r.x0 + 0.5, r.y0 + 0.5, r.w - 1, r.h - 1);
}
"""

```python
"""Viewer rectangle: hit testing, drag, resize.

The viewer is a rectangle on the @thelayout canvas that defines the
region that will actually be generated. It is:
  · sized by the selected ratio (aspect-ratio-locked)
  · draggable from its interior
  · resizable from any of its four corners
  · always containing the bboxes (bboxes are viewer-normalized)

All functions operate on `board.viewer` (canvas-normalized coords) and
the viewer drag state (`board.viewerDrag*`). Rendering lives in
`pg_view_image.py`; dispatch wiring lives in `pg_dispatch.py`.
"""

VIEWER_JS = r"""
import { board, viewerAspect } from "./pg_state.js";

export const VIEWER_HANDLE_TOL_PX = 10;
export const VIEWER_MIN_SIZE = 0.05;

export function getViewerHandles() {
  const v = board.viewer;
  return [
    { name: 'nw', x: v.x,       y: v.y },
    { name: 'ne', x: v.x + v.w, y: v.y },
    { name: 'sw', x: v.x,       y: v.y + v.h },
    { name: 'se', x: v.x + v.w, y: v.y + v.h },
  ];
}

export function viewerCursorFor(handle) {
  if (handle === 'move') return 'move';
  if (handle === 'nw' || handle === 'se') return 'nwse-resize';
  if (handle === 'ne' || handle === 'sw') return 'nesw-resize';
  return 'default';
}

/* sx, sy are screen pixels; r is fittedImageRect(). */
export function hitTestViewerHandle(sx, sy, r) {
  if (!r) return null;
  const tol = VIEWER_HANDLE_TOL_PX;
  for (const h of getViewerHandles()) {
    const hpx = r.x0 + h.x * r.w;
    const hpy = r.y0 + h.y * r.h;
    if (Math.abs(sx - hpx) <= tol && Math.abs(sy - hpy) <= tol) {
      return h.name;
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* cx, cy are canvas image pixels. */
export function hitTestViewerInterior(cx, cy) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const x1 = v.x * board.imageWidth;
  const y1 = v.y * board.imageHeight;
  const x2 = (v.x + v.w) * board.imageWidth;
  const y2 = (v.y + v.h) * board.imageHeight;
  return cx >= x1 && cx <= x2 && cy >= y1 && cy <= y2;
}

/* Move the viewer by (dxNorm, dyNorm) in canvas-normalized coords. */
export function applyViewerMove(dxNorm, dyNorm) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const start = board.viewerDragStart;
  v.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - v.w, start.x + dxNorm));
  v.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(1 - v.h, start.y + dyNorm));
}

/* Resize from a corner handle. Aspect ratio is preserved. */
export function applyViewerResize(handle, mouseCx, mouseCy) {
  const v = board.viewer;
  const r = viewerAspect();
  const cw = board.imageWidth;
  const ch = board.imageHeight;
  if (!cw || !ch) return;

  const mx = mouseCx / cw;
  const my = mouseCy / ch;

  let anchorX, anchorY, rawW, rawH;
  if (handle === 'se') {
    anchorX = v.x;       anchorY = v.y;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, mx - anchorX);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, my - anchorY);
  } else if (handle === 'nw') {
    anchorX = v.x + v.w; anchorY = v.y + v.h;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorX - mx);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorY - my);
  } else if (handle === 'ne') {
    anchorX = v.x;       anchorY = v.y + v.h;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, mx - anchorX);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorY - my);
  } else if (handle === 'sw') {
    anchorX = v.x + v.w; anchorY = v.y;
    rawW = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, anchorX - mx);
    rawH = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, my - anchorY);
  } else {
    return;
  }

  // Aspect constraint: rawW * cw / (rawH * ch) = r
  // Choose the dimension that keeps both within the user's drag.
  const newH_by_w = rawW * cw / (r * ch);
  let newW, newH;
  if (newH_by_w <= rawH) {
    newW = rawW;
    newH = newH_by_w;
  } else {
    newH = rawH;
    newW = rawH * r * ch / cw;
  }

  // Compute new position from anchor + size
  let newX, newY;
  if (handle === 'se')      { newX = v.x;      newY = v.y; }
  else if (handle === 'nw') { newX = anchorX - newW; newY = anchorY - newH; }
  else if (handle === 'ne') { newX = v.x;      newY = anchorY - newH; }
  else /* sw */             { newX = anchorX - newW; newY = v.y; }

  // Clamp position to canvas; if clamped, shrink proportionally.
  if (newX < 0) {
    newW = anchorX;
    newH = newW * cw / (r * ch);
    newX = 0;
    newY = (handle === 'sw') ? v.y : anchorY - newH;
  }
  if (newY < 0) {
    newH = anchorY;
    newW = newH * r * ch / cw;
    newY = 0;
    newX = (handle === 'ne') ? v.x : anchorX - newW;
  }
  if (newX + newW > 1) {
    newW = 1 - newX;
    newH = newW * cw / (r * ch);
  }
  if (newY + newH > 1) {
    newH = 1 - newY;
    newW = newH * r * ch / cw;
  }

  v.x = Math.max(0, newX);
  v.y = Math.max(0, newY);
  v.w = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, newW);
  v.h = Math.max(VIEWER_MIN_SIZE, newH);
}
"""

```python
"""Playground registry client — announce presence to the kritomatic daemon.

Called once at startup (retry loop, ~30s budget), once at shutdown
(best-effort), and once per browser-side self-heal trigger.

Wire commands:

    playground_register    { id, name, url, port, layer_slots: [...] }
    playground_unregister  { id }

Wire format: the daemon's socket server returns
`{"status": "success"|"error", "message": str, "data": {...}}`.
Checks key on `status`, not `success`.

Each registered playground declares one or more **layer slots** on
register.  A slot is `{"id": "@name", "label": str|None,
"auto_select_layer": str|None}`.  The daemon stores per-slot
selectors; the docker renders one row per (playground, slot); the
playground reads its own slot's selector from `comfy_status` and
re-fetches the displayed layer whenever it changes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import socket
import time


DAEMON_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
DAEMON_PORT = 12346


def _send(command: dict, timeout: float = 5.0) -> dict:
    sock = None
    try:
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        sock.settimeout(timeout)
        sock.connect((DAEMON_HOST, DAEMON_PORT))
        sock.sendall((json.dumps(command) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))

        buf = b""
        while b"\n" not in buf:
            chunk = sock.recv(65536)
            if not chunk:
                break
            buf += chunk

        if not buf:
            return {"status": "error", "message": "empty response"}
        line = buf.split(b"\n", 1)[0]
        return json.loads(line.decode("utf-8"))
    except (socket.timeout, ConnectionRefusedError, OSError) as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": str(e)}
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"bad response: {e}"}
    finally:
        if sock is not None:
            try:
                sock.close()
            except OSError:
                pass


def _response_is_success(resp: dict) -> bool:
    if not isinstance(resp, dict):
        return False
    if resp.get("status") == "success":
        return True
    if resp.get("success") is True:
        return True
    return False


def _build_register_cmd(
    playground_id: str, name: str, url: str, port: int,
    layer_slots,
) -> dict:
    cmd = {
        "type":        "playground_register",
        "id":          playground_id,
        "name":        name,
        "url":         url,
        "port":        int(port),
        "layer_slots": list(layer_slots or []),
    }
    return cmd


def register(
    playground_id: str,
    name: str,
    url: str,
    port: int,
    layer_slots=None,
    retry_s: float = 30.0,
) -> bool:
    """Register with the daemon, retrying up to `retry_s`.

    Returns True on success.  A playground that fails to register
    still works — it just doesn't appear in the docker.
    """
    cmd = _build_register_cmd(
        playground_id, name, url, port, layer_slots,
    )
    deadline = time.monotonic() + retry_s
    last_msg = "unknown error"
    while True:
        resp = _send(cmd, timeout=2.0)
        if _response_is_success(resp):
            return True
        last_msg = (
            (resp.get("message") if isinstance(resp, dict) else None)
            or last_msg
        )
        if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
            print(
                f"[playground] register failed after {retry_s:.0f}s: "
                f"{last_msg}",
                flush=True,
            )
            return False
        time.sleep(1.0)


def reregister_once(
    playground_id: str, name: str, url: str, port: int,
    layer_slots=None,
) -> bool:
    """Single-attempt registration.  Used by the browser self-heal path.

    Never retries, never sleeps.
    """
    cmd = _build_register_cmd(
        playground_id, name, url, port, layer_slots,
    )
    resp = _send(cmd, timeout=2.0)
    return _response_is_success(resp)


def unregister(playground_id: str) -> None:
    """Best-effort unregister.  Idempotent.  Never raises."""
    try:
        _send(
            {"type": "playground_unregister", "id": playground_id},
            timeout=2.0,
        )
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[playground] unregister on exit failed: {e}", flush=True)

"""Copy of inpaint/krita_client.py — minimal TCP client to the
kritomatic daemon.  Unchanged."""

import json
import socket
from typing import Callable, Optional


DAEMON_HOST = "127.0.0.1"
DAEMON_PORT = 12346


def is_reachable(timeout: float = 1.5) -> bool:
    sock = None
    try:
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        sock.settimeout(timeout)
        sock.connect((DAEMON_HOST, DAEMON_PORT))
        return True
    except OSError:
        return False
    finally:
        if sock is not None:
            try: sock.close()
            except OSError: pass


def send(command: dict, timeout: float = 60.0) -> dict:
    sock = None
    try:
        sock = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        sock.settimeout(timeout)
        sock.connect((DAEMON_HOST, DAEMON_PORT))
        sock.sendall((json.dumps(command) + "\n").encode("utf-8"))

        buf = b""
        while b"\n" not in buf:
            chunk = sock.recv(65536)
            if not chunk: break
            buf += chunk

        if not buf:
            return {"status": "error", "message": "empty response from daemon"}

        line = buf.split(b"\n", 1)[0]
        return json.loads(line.decode("utf-8"))
    except socket.timeout:
        return {"status": "error", "message": "daemon timeout"}
    except ConnectionRefusedError:
        return {"status": "error", "message": "kritomatic daemon unreachable"}
    except json.JSONDecodeError as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"bad daemon response: {e}"}
    except OSError as e:
        return {"status": "error", "message": f"daemon error: {e}"}
    finally:
        if sock is not None:
            try: sock.close()
            except OSError: pass

import os
import sys

_HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
_PLAYGROUNDS = os.path.dirname(_HERE)

try:
    sys.path.remove(_HERE)
except ValueError:
    pass
if _PLAYGROUNDS not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0, _PLAYGROUNDS)

from multimask import multimask_html, multimask_server

from pgkit.server import serve as kit_serve


HTML_FILE    = "multimask.html"
PORT         = 8776
OPEN_BROWSER = True


def descriptor():
    """Return the run_all.py descriptor for this playground."""
    return {
        "name":           "multimask",
        "port":           PORT,
        "html_file":      HTML_FILE,
        "html_render":    multimask_html.render,
        "routes":         multimask_server.ROUTES,
        "raw_routes":     multimask_server.RAW_ROUTES,
        "module_sources": multimask_html.module_sources(),
    }


def main():
    html = multimask_html.render()
    with open(HTML_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html)
    print(f"Wrote {HTML_FILE}")
    print(f"  routes   : {', '.join(sorted(list(multimask_server.ROUTES) + list(multimask_server.RAW_ROUTES)))}")
    print(f"  state    : http://127.0.0.1:{PORT}/state")

    kit_serve(
        port           = PORT,
        open_browser   = OPEN_BROWSER,
        html_file      = HTML_FILE,
        routes         = multimask_server.ROUTES,
        raw_routes     = multimask_server.RAW_ROUTES,
        module_sources = multimask_html.module_sources(),
        hub_name       = "multimask",
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```python
"""HTTP routes for the multimask playground.

  POST /state               set (from browser) or get (from node)
  POST /version             version only (for IS_CHANGED)
  POST /mask                fetch a mask by hash; transformed by
                            inpaint's crop frame if available
  POST /export_graph        build the API-format JSON
  POST /fetch_history       fetch the last ComfyUI run
  POST /import_image        fetch active document composite from Krita
  POST /import_masks        fetch selected mask or paint layer(s)
  POST /krita_status        daemon reachable?
  POST /upload_image        raw body (image file)
  POST /active_state        daemon comfy_status
  POST /resource_image      resolve a spec to a PNG data URL

MASK TRANSFORM
==============
When inpaint's playground is running, the daemon rotates and crops
`@thecanvas`, `@theselection`, and `@thecontext` before submitting to
ComfyUI.  To stay in the same coordinate frame, the area masks that
`MultiAreaConditioning` receives must undergo the same rotate+crop.
That transformation happens HERE, not in the browser (which must keep
un-rotated state for display) and not in the node (which is
playground-agnostic).

Mechanism: `/mask` queries inpaint's `/crop_frame` (cached for 1 s),
then applies `rotate(-theta) + crop(cropX, cropY, cropW, cropH)` via
PIL.  Cache key is `(hash, theta, cropX, cropY, cropW, cropH)` so a
given mask at a given frame isn't re-transformed.

When inpaint is down (or `/crop_frame` returns null), no transform
happens — the mask is served as stored.  Matches the daemon's
behavior, which also falls back to un-rotated when inpaint is
unreachable."""

import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import threading
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from io import BytesIO
from urllib.parse import unquote

from PIL import Image

from . import krita_client


_state_lock = threading.Lock()
_state     = None
_masks     = {}
_version   = ""

COMFY_URL = os.environ.get("COMFYUI_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8188").rstrip("/")

INPAINT_URL = os.environ.get(
    "MULTIMASK_INPAINT_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8774",
).rstrip("/")


# Crop-frame cache — one query per second at most.  `MultiAreaConditioning`
# calls `/mask` per-area in quick succession during one execute; caching
# collapses N fetches into one.
_crop_frame_lock = threading.Lock()
_crop_frame_cache = {"frame": None, "at": 0.0}
CROP_FRAME_TTL = 1.0


# Mask transform cache — keyed by (hash, frame signature).  Bounded by
# `_MASK_TRANSFORM_CACHE_MAX`; oldest evicted on overflow.
_mask_transform_lock = threading.Lock()
_mask_transform_cache: dict = {}
_MASK_TRANSFORM_CACHE_MAX = 64


def _log(msg):
    print(f"[multimask] {msg}", flush=True)


def _default_globals():
    return {
        "combine_mode":            "combine",
        "use_base_setarea":        False,
        "base_area_width":         1024,
        "base_area_height":        1024,
        "default_strength":        0.9,
        "default_set_cond_area":   "default",
        "tagger_mode":             "replace",
        "tagger_model":            "wd-v1-4-moat-tagger-v2",
        "tagger_threshold":        0.35,
        "tagger_char_threshold":   0.85,
        "bbox":                    True,
        "resize":                  True,
        "mask_w":                  1024,
        "mask_h":                  1024,
        "mask_channel":            "red",
    }


def _compute_version(state):
    canonical = json.dumps(state, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def _public_state():
    if _state is None:
        return {"globals": _default_globals(), "areas": []}
    return _state


def _fetch_active_state():
    try:
        resp = krita_client.send({"type": "comfy_status"}, timeout=10.0)
    except Exception:
        return {}
    if not isinstance(resp, dict) or resp.get("status") != "success":
        return {}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  /state, /version
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def handle_state(payload):
    global _state, _version
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {"success": False, "message": "expected a JSON object"}

    if payload.get("op") == "set":
        raw_state = payload.get("state") or {}
        new_masks = payload.get("masks") or {}

        globs = _default_globals()
        globs.update(raw_state.get("globals") or {})
        state = {
            "globals": globs,
            "areas":   list(raw_state.get("areas") or []),
        }
        new_version = _compute_version(state)

        with _state_lock:
            _state   = state
            _version = new_version
            for h, b64 in new_masks.items():
                if isinstance(h, str) and isinstance(b64, str):
                    _masks[h] = b64
        _log(f"state set: {len(state['areas'])} area(s), "
             f"v{new_version[:8]}")
        return {"success": True, "version": new_version}

    with _state_lock:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "version": _version,
            **_public_state(),
        }


def handle_version(_payload):
    with _state_lock:
        return {"success": True, "version": _version}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  Crop-frame + mask transform
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _fetch_crop_frame_uncached():
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            INPAINT_URL + "/crop_frame",
            data=b"{}", method="POST",
        )
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=0.5) as r:
            data = json.loads(r.read())
        if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data.get("success"):
            return None
        return data.get("frame")
    except (urllib.error.URLError, OSError, ValueError):
        return None


def _fetch_crop_frame_cached():
    with _crop_frame_lock:
        now = time.monotonic()
        if now - _crop_frame_cache["at"] < CROP_FRAME_TTL:
            return _crop_frame_cache["frame"]
    frame = _fetch_crop_frame_uncached()
    with _crop_frame_lock:
        _crop_frame_cache["frame"] = frame
        _crop_frame_cache["at"] = time.monotonic()
    return frame


def _frame_signature(frame):
    if frame is None:
        return None
    return (
        round(float(frame.get("theta", 0.0)) % 360.0, 3),
        int(frame.get("cropX", 0)),
        int(frame.get("cropY", 0)),
        int(frame.get("cropW", 0)),
        int(frame.get("cropH", 0)),
    )


def _transform_mask_b64(b64: str, frame) -> str:
    """Rotate + crop the mask to align with the daemon's prepared frame.

    Assumes the incoming mask is at W×H (the same coordinate frame as
    `@thecanvas` and `@theselection` before prepare).  Applies the same
    transform the daemon applies to those:

      · theta ≠ 0  →  rotate by theta (CW) about the canvas center,
                      producing a W'×H' image
      · always     →  crop to (cropX, cropY, cropW, cropH)
    """
    if frame is None:
        return b64

    theta = float(frame.get("theta", 0.0)) % 360.0
    W = int(frame.get("W", 0))
    H = int(frame.get("H", 0))
    cropX = int(frame.get("cropX", 0))
    cropY = int(frame.get("cropY", 0))
    cropW = int(frame.get("cropW", 0))
    cropH = int(frame.get("cropH", 0))

    if cropW <= 0 or cropH <= 0:
        return b64

    try:
        raw = base64.b64decode(b64)
        img = Image.open(BytesIO(raw)).convert("L")
    except Exception as e:
        _log(f"mask decode failed: {e}")
        return b64

    # Ensure native W×H before rotating.
    if W > 0 and H > 0 and img.size != (W, H):
        img = img.resize((W, H), Image.LANCZOS)

    if theta != 0:
        # PIL rotates CCW for positive angles; the playground and
        # QTransform (daemon) rotate CW on screen.  Negate theta.
        img = img.rotate(
            -theta, expand=True,
            resample=Image.BICUBIC, fillcolor=0,
        )

    img = img.crop((cropX, cropY, cropX + cropW, cropY + cropH))

    buf = BytesIO()
    img.save(buf, "PNG")
    return base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode("ascii")


def _transform_mask_cached(h: str, b64: str) -> str:
    frame = _fetch_crop_frame_cached()
    sig = _frame_signature(frame)
    if sig is None:
        return b64

    key = (h, sig)
    with _mask_transform_lock:
        cached = _mask_transform_cache.get(key)
        if cached is not None:
            return cached

    transformed = _transform_mask_b64(b64, frame)

    with _mask_transform_lock:
        if len(_mask_transform_cache) >= _MASK_TRANSFORM_CACHE_MAX:
            oldest = next(iter(_mask_transform_cache))
            _mask_transform_cache.pop(oldest, None)
        _mask_transform_cache[key] = transformed

    return transformed


def handle_mask(payload):
    h = (payload or {}).get("hash", "")
    with _state_lock:
        b64 = _masks.get(h)
    if b64 is None:
        return {"success": False, "message": f"unknown mask hash {h!r}"}

    transformed = _transform_mask_cached(h, b64)
    return {"success": True, "hash": h, "b64": transformed}


def handle_active_state(_payload):
    data = _fetch_active_state()
    return {"success": True, "data": data}

_STUB_NODES = {
    "clip": {
        "class_type": "CheckpointLoaderSimple",
        "inputs": {"ckpt_name": "PLACEHOLDER__reconnect_CLIP.safetensors"},

    "base_positive": {

def _bool(v, d=False):
    if isinstance(v, bool): return v
    if isinstance(v, str):  return v.lower() in ("true", "yes", "on", "1")
    if isinstance(v, (int, float)): return bool(v)
    return d

def _float(v, d):
    try: return float(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError): return d

def _int(v, d):
    try: return int(v)
    except (TypeError, ValueError): return d

def _build_expansion_json(state, area_filter=""):

    combine_mode          = _str(globs.get("combine_mode"), "combine")

    base_h                = _int(globs.get("base_area_height"), 1024)

    default_set_cond_area = _str(globs.get("default_set_cond_area"), "default")

    if tagger_mode not in ("replace", "concat"):

    tagger_char_thresh = _float(globs.get("tagger_char_threshold"), 0.85)

    current = ["__base_positive__", 0]
    if use_base_setarea:

            "class_type": "ConditioningSetArea",

                "conditioning": current,

                "x": 0, "y": 0, "strength": 1.0,

        current = ["base_setarea", 0]

    needs_bbox = False

def handle_export_graph(payload):
    area_filter = ""
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        area_filter = payload.get("area_filter") or ""

    with _state_lock:
        state   = _public_state()
        version = _version

    graph, final, notes = _build_expansion_json(state, area_filter)
    return {
        "success":            True,
        "version":            version,
        "area_count":         len(state.get("areas") or []),
        "area_filter":        area_filter,
        "final_conditioning": final,
        "graph":              graph,
        "notes":              notes,
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  /fetch_history
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def _comfy_get(path, timeout=10.0):
    url = COMFY_URL + path
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, method="GET")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        return json.loads(r.read())


def handle_fetch_history(payload):
    try:
        try:
            history = _comfy_get("/history?max_items=1")
        except Exception:
            history = _comfy_get("/history")

        if not history:
            return {"success": False, "message": "ComfyUI history is empty"}

        if len(history) > 1:
            last_id = list(history.keys())[-1]
            history = {last_id: history[last_id]}

        prompt_id = next(iter(history))
        details   = history[prompt_id]

        diag = _diagnose_history(details)

        return {
            "success":    True,
            "comfy_url":  COMFY_URL,
            "prompt_id":  prompt_id,
            "prompt":     details.get("prompt"),
            "outputs":    details.get("outputs"),
            "status":     details.get("status"),
            "meta":       details.get("meta"),
            "diagnostic": diag,
        }
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"ComfyUI returned HTTP {e.code}"}
    except urllib.error.URLError as e:
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"could not reach ComfyUI at {COMFY_URL}: "
                           f"{e.reason}"}
    except Exception as e:
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"unexpected error: {e}"}


def _diagnose_history(details):
    prompt = details.get("prompt") or []
    graph = {}
    if isinstance(prompt, list) and len(prompt) >= 3:
        if isinstance(prompt[2], dict):
            graph = prompt[2]

    by_class    = {}
    cliptexts   = []
    multi_area  = None
    for nid, ndef in graph.items():
        if not isinstance(ndef, dict):
            continue
        ct = ndef.get("class_type", "?")
        by_class[ct] = by_class.get(ct, 0) + 1
        if ct == "CLIPTextEncode":
            txt = (ndef.get("inputs") or {}).get("text", "")
            if isinstance(txt, str):
                cliptexts.append({"node": nid, "text": txt[:300]})
        if ct == "MultiAreaConditioning":
            multi_area = {
                "node":   nid,
                "inputs": ndef.get("inputs") or {},
            }

    output_node_ids = list((details.get("outputs") or {}).keys())
    status          = details.get("status") or {}
    status_str      = status.get("status_str")
    status_messages = status.get("messages") or []

    return {
        "submitted_node_count": len(graph),
        "by_class":             by_class,
        "cliptexts":            cliptexts,
        "multi_area_node":      multi_area,
        "output_node_ids":      output_node_ids,
        "status_str":           status_str,
        "status_messages":      status_messages,
        "note": (
            "ComfyUI's /history returns the SUBMITTED graph, not the "
            "EXPANDED one."
        ),
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  /krita_status, /import_image, /import_masks, /resource_image
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def handle_krita_status(_payload):
    return {"success": True, "reachable": krita_client.is_reachable()}


def handle_import_image(payload):
    name = (payload or {}).get("name") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
    cmd = {"type": "get_document_composite_b64"}
    if name:
        cmd["name"] = name

    response = krita_client.send(cmd, timeout=60.0)
    if response.get("status") != "success":
        return {"success": False,
                "message": response.get("message") or "daemon rejected"}

    data = response.get("data") or {}
    data_url = data.get("data_url")
    if not data_url:
        return {"success": False, "message": "daemon returned no data_url"}
    if not data_url.startswith("data:image/png;base64,"):
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"unexpected data_url prefix: {data_url[:30]!r}"}

    try:
        png_bytes = base64.b64decode(data_url.split(",", 1)[1])
        img = Image.open(BytesIO(png_bytes))
        w, h = img.size
    except Exception as e:
        return {"success": False, "message": f"decode failed: {e}"}

    hash_hex = hashlib.sha256(png_bytes).hexdigest()[:16]
    return {
        "success":   True,
        "hash":      hash_hex,
        "width":     w,
        "height":    h,
        "data_url":  data_url,
        "filename":  data.get("name") or "krita_composite",
    }


def handle_import_masks(payload):
    cmd = {"type": "import_krita_masks_b64"}
    if isinstance(payload, dict):
        if payload.get("layer_names"):
            cmd["layer_names"] = str(payload["layer_names"])
        if "include_paint_alpha" in payload:
            cmd["include_paint_alpha"] = bool(payload["include_paint_alpha"])

    response = krita_client.send(cmd, timeout=60.0)
    if response.get("status") != "success":
        return {"success": False,
                "message": response.get("message") or "daemon rejected"}

    data = response.get("data") or {}
    return {
        "success":        True,
        "masks":          data.get("masks") or [],
        "skipped":        data.get("skipped") or [],
        "selection_path": data.get("selection_path") or "unknown",
        "message":        response.get("message") or "",
    }


def handle_resource_image(payload):
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        return {"success": False, "message": "expected a JSON object"}

    source = payload.get("source", "active")
    layer_name = payload.get("layer_name")

    if source == "active":
        return handle_import_image({})
    if source == "layer":
        if not layer_name:
            return {"success": False,
                    "message": "layer_name is required when source=layer"}
        response = krita_client.send(
            {"type": "get_layer_pixels_b64", "name": str(layer_name)},
            timeout=30.0,
        )
        if response.get("status") != "success":
            return {"success": False,
                    "message": response.get("message") or "daemon rejected"}
        data = response.get("data") or {}
        data_url = data.get("data_url")
        if not data_url:
            return {"success": False,
                    "message": "daemon returned no data_url for layer"}
        return {
            "success": True,
            "hash": "layer_" + str(layer_name),
            "width": data.get("width"),
            "height": data.get("height"),
            "data_url": data_url,
            "filename": str(layer_name),
        }
    return {
        "success": False,
        "message": (
            f"source={source!r} cannot be displayed as an image."
        ),
    }


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  /upload_image
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def handle_upload_image(headers, body):
    if not body:
        return {"success": False, "message": "empty upload"}

    raw_filename = (headers.get("X-Filename", "")
                    or headers.get("x-filename", ""))
    filename = unquote(raw_filename) if raw_filename else "image"

    try:
        img = Image.open(BytesIO(body))
        w, h = img.size
    except Exception as e:
        return {"success": False,
                "message": f"could not decode image: {e}"}

    if img.format and img.format.upper() != "PNG":
        buf = BytesIO()
        img.save(buf, "PNG")
        png_bytes = buf.getvalue()
    else:
        png_bytes = body

    hash_hex = hashlib.sha256(png_bytes).hexdigest()[:16]
    data_url = ("data:image/png;base64,"
                + base64.b64encode(png_bytes).decode("ascii"))
    return {
        "success":  True,
        "hash":     hash_hex,
        "width":    w,
        "height":   h,
        "data_url": data_url,
        "filename": filename,
    }


ROUTES = {
    "/state":              handle_state,
    "/version":            handle_version,
    "/mask":               handle_mask,
    "/export_graph":       handle_export_graph,
    "/fetch_history":      handle_fetch_history,
    "/import_image":       handle_import_image,
    "/import_masks":       handle_import_masks,
    "/krita_status":       handle_krita_status,
    "/active_state":       handle_active_state,
    "/resource_image":     handle_resource_image,
}

RAW_ROUTES = {
    "/upload_image": handle_upload_image,
}

"""The area list: creation, mutation, selection.

`hoverArea` uses `_scheduleDrawView` (canvas-only) instead of
`_scheduleDraw` (full draw).  Hover affects only `drawImageLayer`'s
`globalAlpha` — no panel field or card row reads `board.hoveredAreaId`
— so a full `draw()` on every mask-boundary crossing would rebuild the
entire area-card DOM for nothing.  See `pg_state.py`'s TWO SCHEDULERS.

`selectArea` keeps `_scheduleDraw` (full).  Selection is
canvas-visible (alpha bump on the selected area, chrome label change)
AND flows into pgkit entities via `syncAreaList` → `pgkitNotifyEntities`,
so a full draw is correct.  Every `selectArea` caller in
`pg_dispatch.js` and `pg_panel_bindings.js` also calls `draw()`
explicitly right after, so the scheduled `_scheduleDraw` is redundant
but harmless — kept as a safety net for any future caller that
forgets the explicit follow-up."""

AREAS_JS = r"""
import { board, _scheduleDraw, _scheduleDrawView } from "./pg_state.js";

function _makeId() {
  return Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 10);
}

function _makeMaskEntry(b64) {
  const img = new Image();
  const entry = {
    b64, img, w: 0, h: 0, loaded: false,
    _pixels: null, _tinted: null, _tintedKey: null,
  };
  img.onload = () => {
    entry.w = img.width;
    entry.h = img.height;
    entry.loaded = true;
    _scheduleDraw();
  };
  img.onerror = () => _scheduleDraw();
  img.src = "data:image/png;base64," + b64;
  return entry;
}

function _nextAreaName() {
  const used = new Set(board.areas.map(a => a.name));
  while (used.has("area_" + board.nextAreaNum)) board.nextAreaNum++;
  const name = "area_" + board.nextAreaNum;
  board.nextAreaNum++;
  return name;
}

export function areaById(id) {
  for (const a of board.areas) if (a.id === id) return a;
  return null;
}

export function addAreaFromB64(b64, opts) {
  opts = opts || {};
  const id = opts.id || _makeId();
  const name = opts.name || _nextAreaName();
  const area = {
    id, name,
    prompt:    opts.prompt || "",
    useTagger: !!opts.useTagger,
    mask:      _makeMaskEntry(b64),
    // null = inherit from board.globals
    strength:              opts.strength              ?? null,
    set_cond_area:         opts.set_cond_area         ?? null,
    mask_channel:          opts.mask_channel          ?? null,
    bbox:                  opts.bbox                  ?? null,
    resize:                opts.resize                ?? null,
    tagger_mode:           opts.tagger_mode           ?? null,
    tagger_model:          opts.tagger_model          ?? null,
    tagger_threshold:      opts.tagger_threshold      ?? null,
    tagger_char_threshold: opts.tagger_char_threshold ?? null,
  };
  board.areas.push(area);
  _scheduleDraw();
  return id;
}

export function removeArea(id) {
  const idx = board.areas.findIndex(a => a.id === id);
  if (idx < 0) return false;
  board.areas.splice(idx, 1);
  if (board.selectedAreaId === id) board.selectedAreaId = null;
  if (board.hoveredAreaId  === id) board.hoveredAreaId  = null;
  _scheduleDraw();
  return true;
}

export function updateArea(id, patch) {
  const a = areaById(id);
  if (!a) return false;
  for (const k in patch) {
    if (k in a) a[k] = patch[k];
  }
  _scheduleDraw();
  return true;
}

export function selectArea(id) {
  board.selectedAreaId = id;
  _scheduleDraw();
}

export function hoverArea(id) {
  if (board.hoveredAreaId !== id) {
    board.hoveredAreaId = id;
    // Canvas-only: hover changes only `drawImageLayer`'s globalAlpha.
    // See the module docstring.
    _scheduleDrawView();
  }
}
"""
```

```python
"""@thecanvas auto-sync for multimask.

Polls the daemon's `comfy_status` every 500 ms while the tab is
visible and, whenever the `@thecanvas` resource spec in
`config.resources` changes, re-fetches the corresponding pixels and
swaps in the returned image via `applyCanvasImage` (which preserves
the area list).

The trigger is a spec change, not a composite change.  Generation
does NOT trigger a refresh; only an explicit `@thecanvas`
re-selection does.

Pause on tab-hide: `document.visibilityState` is checked before every
reschedule.  A hidden tab does not poll at all.  On visibility-change
back to `"visible"`, the pending timer is cancelled and an immediate
poll runs.

Boot-time: on the first poll, if `@thecanvas` is non-null and no
image is loaded yet, fetch it.  Otherwise leave the current image
alone."""

AUTOSYNC_JS = r"""
import { board, applyCanvasImage } from "./pg_state.js";
import { fetchActiveState, fetchResourceImage } from "./pg_client.js";
import { flashStatus } from "./pgkit/panel_core.js";
import { pgkitNotifyEntities } from "./pgkit/remote_client.js";

const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 500;

let _lastSpec = null;
let _bootstrapped = false;
let _running = false;
let _timer = null;

function _specOf(cfg) {
  const res = (cfg && cfg.resources) || {};
  const spec = res["@thecanvas"];
  if (!spec || typeof spec !== "object") return null;
  return {
    source: spec.source || "active",
    layer_name: spec.layer_name || null,
  };
}

function _hashSpec(spec) {
  return spec === null ? "" : JSON.stringify(spec);
}

async function _fetchAndSet(spec) {
  flashStatus("refreshing @thecanvas\u2026", "");
  const img = await fetchResourceImage(spec);
  if (!img || !img.success) {
    flashStatus(
      "@thecanvas refresh failed: "
      + ((img && img.message) || "unknown"),
      "bad",
    );
    return;
  }
  if (!img.data_url) {
    flashStatus("@thecanvas refresh: no data_url", "bad");
    return;
  }
  applyCanvasImage(
    img.hash || ("thecanvas_" + Date.now()),
    img.data_url,
    img.width,
    img.height,
  );
  const label = spec.source === "layer" ? spec.layer_name : spec.source;
  flashStatus("@thecanvas \u2192 " + label, "ok");
  pgkitNotifyEntities();
  import("./pg_dispatch.js").then(m => m.draw()).catch(() => {});
}

async function _poll() {
  _timer = null;
  if (_running) return;
  _running = true;
  try {
    const resp = await fetchActiveState();
    if (!resp || !resp.success) return;
    const cfg = (resp.data && resp.data.config) || null;
    const spec = _specOf(cfg);
    const specHash = _hashSpec(spec);

    if (!_bootstrapped) {
      _bootstrapped = true;
      _lastSpec = specHash;
      if (spec !== null && !board.imageHash) {
        await _fetchAndSet(spec);
      }
      return;
    }

    if (specHash === _lastSpec) return;
    _lastSpec = specHash;
    if (spec === null) return;
    await _fetchAndSet(spec);
  } finally {
    _running = false;
    _schedule();
  }
}

function _schedule() {
  if (document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
  if (_timer !== null) clearTimeout(_timer);
  _timer = setTimeout(_poll, POLL_INTERVAL_MS);
}

export function startAutosync() {
  if (_timer !== null) return;

  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", () => {
    if (document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    if (_timer !== null) {
      clearTimeout(_timer);
      _timer = null;
    }
    if (!_running) _poll();
  });

  _timer = setTimeout(_poll, 200);
}
"""
```

export async function uploadImageFile(file) {

  if (!payload.success) throw new Error(payload.message || "upload failed");

"""draw() and canvas event listeners.

Drag modes: pan (space+drag or middle).  Zoom at cursor on wheel.
Alt+click selects an area.  Clean click on a mask selects it.
Click on empty deselects.  No rotation, no context drag."""

DISPATCH_JS = r"""
import {
  canvas, board, view, screenToImage, fittedImageRect,
  clampPan, zoomAt, resetView,
} from "./pg_state.js";
import { hitTestAreaAtPoint } from "./pg_pixels.js";
import { selectArea, hoverArea } from "./pg_areas.js";
import { drawView } from "./pg_view.js";
import { syncAreaList } from "./pg_panel_lists.js";
import { syncPanelFields } from "./pg_panel_fields.js";

export function draw() {
  drawView();
  syncPanelFields();
  syncAreaList();
}

let _panActive = false;
let _panStartSx = 0, _panStartSy = 0;
let _panStartX = 0, _panStartY = 0;
let _spaceDown = false;

canvas.addEventListener("mousedown", (e) => {
  const active = document.activeElement;
  if (active && active !== canvas
      && (active.tagName === "INPUT"
          || active.tagName === "TEXTAREA"
          || active.tagName === "SELECT")) {
    active.blur();
  }

  if (e.button === 1 || (e.button === 0 && _spaceDown)) {
    e.preventDefault();
    _panActive = true;
    _panStartSx = e.clientX;
    _panStartSy = e.clientY;
    _panStartX = view.panX;
    _panStartY = view.panY;
    canvas.style.cursor = "grabbing";
    return;
  }

  if (e.button !== 0) return;

  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx = e.clientX - rect.left, sy = e.clientY - rect.top;
  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) return;

  const [ix, iy] = screenToImage(sx, sy);
  const overImage = ix >= 0 && ix <= board.imageWidth
                 && iy >= 0 && iy <= board.imageHeight;
  const hitId = overImage ? hitTestAreaAtPoint(ix, iy) : null;

  if (e.altKey) {
    if (hitId) { selectArea(hitId); draw(); }
    return;
  }

  selectArea(hitId);
  draw();
});

window.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx = e.clientX - rect.left, sy = e.clientY - rect.top;

  if (_panActive) {
    view.panX = _panStartX + (e.clientX - _panStartSx);
    view.panY = _panStartY + (e.clientY - _panStartSy);
    clampPan();
    drawView();
    return;
  }

  if (_spaceDown) { canvas.style.cursor = "grab"; return; }

  const r = fittedImageRect();
  if (!r) { hoverArea(null); canvas.style.cursor = "default"; return; }

  const [ix, iy] = screenToImage(sx, sy);
  const overImage = ix >= 0 && ix <= board.imageWidth
                 && iy >= 0 && iy <= board.imageHeight;
  const hitId = overImage ? hitTestAreaAtPoint(ix, iy) : null;

  hoverArea(hitId);
  canvas.style.cursor = hitId ? "pointer" : "default";
});

window.addEventListener("mouseup", () => {
  if (_panActive) {
    _panActive = false;
    canvas.style.cursor = _spaceDown ? "grab" : "default";
  }
});

canvas.addEventListener("wheel", (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
  const mx = e.clientX - rect.left, my = e.clientY - rect.top;
  const dy = e.deltaY * (e.deltaMode === 1 ? 16
                       : e.deltaMode === 2 ? 100
                       : 1);
  const factor = Math.exp(-dy * 0.0015);
  zoomAt(mx, my, view.zoom * factor);
  drawView();
}, { passive: false });

window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  const t = e.target;
  if (t && (t.tagName === "INPUT" || t.tagName === "TEXTAREA"
            || t.tagName === "SELECT")) return;

  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
    _spaceDown = true;
    if (!_panActive) canvas.style.cursor = "grab";
    e.preventDefault();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "Home" || e.key === "0") {
    e.preventDefault();
    resetView();
    drawView();
    return;
  }
  if (e.key === "Escape") {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectArea(null);
    draw();
    return;
  }
  const n = parseInt(e.key, 10);
  if (n >= 1 && n <= 9 && board.areas.length >= n) {
    e.preventDefault();
    selectArea(board.areas[n - 1].id);
    draw();
  }
});

window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === " " || e.key === "Spacebar") {
    _spaceDown = false;
    if (!_panActive) canvas.style.cursor = "default";
  }
});

canvas.style.cursor = "default";
"""
```
